exampleEn: She treats every patient with compassion.
exampleRu: Она относится к каждому пациенту с состраданием.
exampleUz: U har bir bemorga rahm-shafqat bilan munosabatda bo'ladi.
definitionEn: a feeling of caring about someone who is suffering

exampleEn: There was some resentment among the team.
exampleRu: В команде была некоторая обида.
exampleUz: Jamoada biroz xafagarchilik bor edi.
definitionEn: a feeling of anger about something unfair

exampleEn: A melancholy mood settled over the room.
exampleRu: В комнате воцарилось меланхоличное настроение.
exampleUz: Xonada g'amgin kayfiyat hukm surdi.
definitionEn: a feeling of quiet sadness

exampleEn: The win sent the fans into euphoria.
exampleRu: Победа привела болельщиков в состояние эйфории.
exampleUz: G'alaba muxlislarni yoqimli hayajonga soldi.
definitionEn: a feeling of extreme happiness and excitement

exampleEn: She felt apprehensive about the interview.
exampleRu: Она чувствовала тревогу перед собеседованием.
exampleUz: U suhbatdan oldin xavotirda edi.
definitionEn: worried about something that might happen

exampleEn: I use my computer every day for work.
exampleRu: Я использую компьютер каждый день для работы.
exampleUz: Men har kuni ish uchun kompyuterimdan foydalanaman.
definitionEn: an electronic machine used to store and process information

exampleEn: The screen of my phone is cracked.
exampleRu: Экран моего телефона треснул.
exampleUz: Telefonimning ekrani yorilgan.
definitionEn: the flat part of a device that shows pictures and text

exampleEn: Please choose a strong password.
exampleRu: Пожалуйста, выберите надежный пароль.
exampleUz: Iltimos, mustahkam parol tanlang.
definitionEn: a secret word or code used to prove who you are

exampleEn: This application helps you learn languages.
exampleRu: Это приложение помогает изучать языки.
exampleUz: Bu ilova tillarni o'rganishga yordam beradi.
definitionEn: a computer program made for a specific task

exampleEn: You should upgrade your software regularly.
exampleRu: Вам следует регулярно обновлять программное обеспечение.
exampleUz: Dasturiy ta'minotni muntazam yangilashingiz kerak.
definitionEn: to change something to a newer or better version

exampleEn: A software malfunction delayed the launch.
exampleRu: Сбой программного обеспечения задержал запуск.
exampleUz: Dasturiy ta'minotdagi nosozlik ishga tushirishni kechiktirdi.
definitionEn: when a machine stops working correctly

exampleEn: The algorithm sorts data in seconds.
exampleRu: Алгоритм сортирует данные за секунды.
exampleUz: Algoritm ma'lumotlarni soniyalar ichida saralaydi.
definitionEn: a set of steps a computer follows to solve a problem

exampleEn: The app uses end-to-end encryption.
exampleRu: Приложение использует сквозное шифрование.
exampleUz: Ilova uchidan-uchigacha shifrlashdan foydalanadi.
definitionEn: turning information into a secret code to keep it safe

exampleEn: Planned obsolescence forces people to buy new devices.
exampleRu: Запланированное устаревание вынуждает людей покупать новые устройства.
exampleUz: Rejalashtirilgan eskirish odamlarni yangi qurilma sotib olishga majbur qiladi.
definitionEn: the state of no longer being used or needed

exampleEn: Please drink more water.
exampleRu: Пожалуйста, пей больше воды.
exampleUz: Iltimos, ko'proq suv iching.
definitionEn: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it

exampleEn: This soup is delicious.
exampleRu: Этот суп очень вкусный.
exampleUz: Bu sho'rva juda mazali.
definitionEn: having a very pleasant taste

exampleEn: I am very hungry now.
exampleRu: Я сейчас очень голоден.
exampleUz: Men hozir juda ochman.
definitionEn: feeling that you need or want to eat

exampleEn: This ice cream has a great flavor.
exampleRu: У этого мороженого отличный вкус.
exampleUz: Bu muzqaymoqning ta'mi juda yaxshi.
definitionEn: the particular taste of a food or drink

exampleEn: She shared her favorite recipe with me.
exampleRu: Она поделилась со мной своим любимым рецептом.
exampleUz: U sevimli retseptini men bilan bo'lishdi.
definitionEn: a set of instructions for cooking a dish

exampleEn: We had leftovers for dinner.
exampleRu: На ужин у нас были остатки еды.
exampleUz: Kechki ovqatga bizda qoldiq ovqat bor edi.
definitionEn: food that was not eaten and is kept for later

exampleEn: I love spicy food.
exampleRu: Я люблю острую еду.
exampleUz: Men achchiq taomlarni yaxshi ko'raman.
definitionEn: having a strong, hot taste from spices

exampleEn: Italian cuisine is famous worldwide.
exampleRu: Итальянская кухня известна во всём мире.
exampleUz: Italyan pazandachiligi butun dunyoda mashhur.
definitionEn: a style of cooking typical of a country or region

exampleEn: Take your time to savor the meal.
exampleRu: Не торопись, насладись едой.
exampleUz: Ovqatdan shoshilmasdan zavqlaning.
definitionEn: to enjoy the taste or feeling of something slowly

exampleEn: Garnish the dish with fresh herbs.
exampleRu: Укрась блюдо свежей зеленью.
exampleUz: Taomni yangi ko'katlar bilan bezang.
definitionEn: a small piece of food added to decorate a dish

exampleEn: Rice is a staple food in many countries.
exampleRu: Рис — основной продукт питания во многих странах.
exampleUz: Guruch ko'plab mamlakatlarda asosiy oziq-ovqatdir.
definitionEn: a basic food that people eat regularly

exampleEn: This wine will please any palate.
exampleRu: Это вино понравится любому вкусу.
exampleUz: Bu vino har qanday ta'm sezgisiga yoqadi.
definitionEn: a person's ability to taste and enjoy different flavors

exampleEn: Use a map to find the hotel.
exampleRu: Используй карту, чтобы найти отель.
exampleUz: Mehmonxonani topish uchun xaritadan foydalaning.
definitionEn: a drawing that shows where places are

exampleEn: It was a long journey.
exampleRu: Это было долгое путешествие.
exampleUz: Bu uzoq sayohat edi.
definitionEn: the act of travelling from one place to another

exampleEn: Paris is our final destination.
exampleRu: Париж — наш конечный пункт назначения.
exampleUz: Parij bizning yakuniy manzilimiz.
definitionEn: the place where someone is going

exampleEn: You should exchange currency at the airport.
exampleRu: Тебе стоит обменять валюту в аэропорту.
exampleUz: Aeroportda valyuta almashtirishingiz kerak.
definitionEn: the money used in a particular country

exampleEn: Our flight had a two-hour delay.
exampleRu: Наш рейс задержался на два часа.
exampleUz: Bizning reysimiz ikki soatga kechikdi.
definitionEn: extra time before something happens, later than planned

exampleEn: We had a six-hour layover in Dubai.
exampleRu: У нас была шестичасовая пересадка в Дубае.
exampleUz: Bizda Dubayda olti soatlik oraliq to'xtash bor edi.
definitionEn: a short stop between flights or parts of a trip

exampleEn: Her wanderlust took her to forty countries.
exampleRu: Её страсть к путешествиям привела её в сорок стран.
exampleUz: Uning sayohat ishtiyoqi uni qirq mamlakatga olib bordi.
definitionEn: a strong wish to travel and see new places

exampleEn: His salary increased this year.
exampleRu: В этом году его зарплата выросла.
exampleUz: Bu yil uning oylik maoshi oshdi.
definitionEn: money a person is paid regularly for their work

exampleEn: They negotiated a better contract.
exampleRu: Они договорились о более выгодном контракте.
exampleUz: Ular yaxshiroq shartnoma bo'yicha muzokara olib borishdi.
definitionEn: to talk with someone to reach an agreement

exampleEn: He decided to resign from his position.
exampleRu: Он решил уйти в отставку со своей должности.
exampleUz: U o'z lavozimidan iste'foga chiqishga qaror qildi.
definitionEn: to officially leave a job

exampleEn: Her workload doubled this quarter.
exampleRu: Её рабочая нагрузка удвоилась в этом квартале.
exampleUz: Uning ish yuki bu chorakda ikki baravar oshdi.
definitionEn: the amount of work a person has to do

exampleEn: She became a successful entrepreneur at twenty-five.
exampleRu: Она стала успешным предпринимателем в двадцать пять лет.
exampleUz: U yigirma besh yoshida muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkorga aylandi.
definitionEn: a person who starts and runs their own business

exampleEn: A good manager knows how to delegate tasks.
exampleRu: Хороший руководитель умеет делегировать задачи.
exampleUz: Yaxshi rahbar vazifalarni topshirishni biladi.
definitionEn: to give part of your work or authority to someone else

exampleEn: Two hundred workers were made redundant.
exampleRu: Двести рабочих были сокращены.
exampleUz: Ikki yuz ishchi ishdan bo'shatildi.
definitionEn: no longer needed, especially describing a job that is cut

exampleEn: She is proficient in three languages.
exampleRu: Она владеет тремя языками.
exampleUz: U uch tilni yaxshi biladi.
definitionEn: very good at doing something

exampleEn: The child was afraid of the dark.
exampleRu: Ребёнок боялся темноты.
exampleUz: Bola qorong'ulikdan qo'rqar edi.
definitionEn: feeling fear about something

exampleEn: Try to stay calm during the exam.
exampleRu: Постарайся оставаться спокойным во время экзамена.
exampleUz: Imtihon paytida xotirjam bo'lishga harakat qiling.
definitionEn: not worried, upset, or excited

exampleEn: My parents are proud of me.
exampleRu: Мои родители гордятся мной.
exampleUz: Ota-onam men bilan faxrlanishadi.
definitionEn: feeling pleased about something you or others achieved

exampleEn: She felt anxious before the interview.
exampleRu: Она чувствовала тревогу перед собеседованием.
exampleUz: U suhbatdan oldin tashvishlanardi.
definitionEn: feeling worried or nervous about something

exampleEn: He felt jealous of his brother's success.
exampleRu: Он завидовал успеху своего брата.
exampleUz: U akasining muvaffaqiyatiga hasad qildi.
definitionEn: feeling upset because someone has something you want

exampleEn: I felt a wave of relief after the test.
exampleRu: После теста я почувствовал облегчение.
exampleUz: Test tugagach, men yengillik his qildim.
definitionEn: a feeling of comfort after worry or pain ends

exampleEn: She was embarrassed by her mistake.
exampleRu: Она смутилась из-за своей ошибки.
exampleUz: U xatosidan uyaldi.
definitionEn: feeling shy or uncomfortable because of a mistake

exampleEn: He felt overwhelmed by all the work.
exampleRu: Он был подавлен из-за всей этой работы.
exampleUz: U barcha ish tufayli ezilib ketdi.
definitionEn: feeling like there is more than you can handle

exampleEn: Her resilience helped her overcome the loss.
exampleRu: Её стойкость помогла ей пережить утрату.
exampleUz: Uning chidamliligi yo'qotishni yengishga yordam berdi.
definitionEn: the ability to recover quickly from difficulties

exampleEn: She seemed indifferent to the criticism.
exampleRu: Она казалась равнодушной к критике.
exampleUz: U tanqidga befarq ko'rinardi.
definitionEn: not interested or caring about something

exampleEn: The internet connection is slow today.
exampleRu: Сегодня интернет-соединение медленное.
exampleUz: Bugun internet aloqasi sekin.
definitionEn: the worldwide system that connects computers together

exampleEn: I need to download this file.
exampleRu: Мне нужно скачать этот файл.
exampleUz: Menga bu faylni yuklab olishim kerak.
definitionEn: to copy a file from the internet onto your device

exampleEn: This software needs an update.
exampleRu: Этому программному обеспечению нужно обновление.
exampleUz: Bu dasturiy ta'minotni yangilash kerak.
definitionEn: the programs that run on a computer

exampleEn: Charge your device overnight.
exampleRu: Заряжай своё устройство на ночь.
exampleUz: Qurilmangizni tunda quvvatlantiring.
definitionEn: a small machine made for a particular purpose

exampleEn: Please upload your resume here.
exampleRu: Пожалуйста, загрузите своё резюме сюда.
exampleUz: Iltimos, rezyumeni shu yerga yuklang.
definitionEn: to send a file from your device to the internet

exampleEn: The email contained hidden malware.
exampleRu: Письмо содержало скрытое вредоносное ПО.
exampleUz: Xat yashirin zararli dasturni o'z ichiga olgan edi.
definitionEn: harmful software made to damage a computer

exampleEn: Video calls use a lot of bandwidth.
exampleRu: Видеозвонки используют много пропускной способности сети.
exampleUz: Video qo'ng'iroqlar ko'p tarmoq o'tkazuvchanligini talab qiladi.
definitionEn: the amount of data that can be sent over a connection

exampleEn: The platform was built to be scalable.
exampleRu: Платформа была построена так, чтобы быть масштабируемой.
exampleUz: Platforma kengaytiriladigan qilib qurilgan.
definitionEn: able to grow bigger without losing quality

exampleEn: The server has built-in redundancy for safety.
exampleRu: У сервера есть встроенное резервирование для безопасности.
exampleUz: Serverda xavfsizlik uchun o'rnatilgan zaxira tizimi bor.
definitionEn: an extra copy kept in case the main one fails

exampleEn: Low latency is essential for online gaming.
exampleRu: Низкая задержка важна для онлайн-игр.
exampleUz: Onlayn o'yinlar uchun past kechikish muhim.
definitionEn: a short delay before something happens, like data sending

exampleEn: We planted a tree in the garden.
exampleRu: Мы посадили дерево в саду.
exampleUz: Biz bog'da daraxt ektik.
definitionEn: a tall plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves

exampleEn: The river flows through the city.
exampleRu: Река протекает через город.
exampleUz: Daryo shahar orqali oqadi.
definitionEn: a large natural stream of water flowing to the sea

exampleEn: We climbed the mountain last summer.
exampleRu: Прошлым летом мы поднялись на гору.
exampleUz: O'tgan yozda biz tog'ga chiqdik.
definitionEn: a very high, natural hill of land

exampleEn: The weather is nice today.
exampleRu: Сегодня хорошая погода.
exampleUz: Bugun ob-havo yaxshi.
definitionEn: the condition outside, like rain, sun, or wind

exampleEn: They walked through the forest.
exampleRu: Они шли через лес.
exampleUz: Ular o'rmon orqali yurishdi.
definitionEn: a large area covered with trees

exampleEn: The climate here is very dry.
exampleRu: Климат здесь очень сухой.
exampleUz: Bu yerdagi iqlim juda quruq.
definitionEn: the usual weather pattern of a place over time

exampleEn: The region suffered a severe drought.
exampleRu: Регион пострадал от сильной засухи.
exampleUz: Hudud qattiq qurg'oqchilikdan aziyat chekdi.
definitionEn: a long period with little or no rain

exampleEn: The park protects local wildlife.
exampleRu: Парк защищает местную дикую природу.
exampleUz: Bog' mahalliy yovvoyi tabiatni himoya qiladi.
definitionEn: wild animals living in their natural environment

exampleEn: Air pollution is a serious problem.
exampleRu: Загрязнение воздуха — серьёзная проблема.
exampleUz: Havoning ifloslanishi jiddiy muammo.
definitionEn: harmful substances that damage air, water, or land

exampleEn: The coral reef is a fragile ecosystem.
exampleRu: Коралловый риф — хрупкая экосистема.
exampleUz: Marjon rifi nozik ekotizimdir.
definitionEn: all the living things in an area and how they interact

exampleEn: The rainforest has incredible biodiversity.
exampleRu: В тропическом лесу невероятное биоразнообразие.
exampleUz: Yomg'ir o'rmonida ajoyib biologik xilma-xillik mavjud.
definitionEn: the variety of different plants and animals in a place

exampleEn: We need more sustainable farming methods.
exampleRu: Нам нужны более устойчивые методы земледелия.
exampleUz: Bizga barqaror dehqonchilik usullari kerak.
definitionEn: able to continue for a long time without harming nature

exampleEn: Deforestation destroys animal habitats.
exampleRu: Вырубка лесов уничтожает среду обитания животных.
exampleUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishi hayvonlarning yashash muhitini yo'q qiladi.
definitionEn: the natural home of an animal or plant

exampleEn: Soil erosion threatens local farms.
exampleRu: Эрозия почвы угрожает местным фермам.
exampleUz: Tuproq eroziyasi mahalliy fermer xo'jaliklariga tahdid solmoqda.
definitionEn: the slow wearing away of land by wind or water

exampleEn: The organization focuses on wildlife conservation.
exampleRu: Организация занимается охраной дикой природы.
exampleUz: Tashkilot yovvoyi tabiatni muhofaza qilish bilan shug'ullanadi.
definitionEn: the protection of nature and natural resources

exampleEn: I like to shop on weekends.
exampleRu: Я люблю ходить по магазинам по выходным.
exampleUz: Men dam olish kunlari xarid qilishni yaxshi ko'raman.
definitionEn: a place where you can buy things

exampleEn: The price of this jacket is too high.
exampleRu: Цена этой куртки слишком высока.
exampleUz: Bu kurtkaning narxi juda yuqori.
definitionEn: the amount of money needed to buy something

exampleEn: These shoes are very cheap.
exampleRu: Эти туфли очень дешёвые.
exampleUz: Bu poyabzallar juda arzon.
definitionEn: costing very little money

exampleEn: Keep your receipt in case you need a refund.
exampleRu: Сохрани чек на случай возврата денег.
exampleUz: Pul qaytarish kerak bo'lsa, chekni saqlab qo'ying.
definitionEn: a piece of paper proving that you paid for something

exampleEn: What size do you need?
exampleRu: Какой размер тебе нужен?
exampleUz: Sizga qanday o'lcham kerak?
definitionEn: how big or small something is

exampleEn: I got a 20% discount on this item.
exampleRu: Я получил скидку 20% на этот товар.
exampleUz: Men bu mahsulotga 20% chegirma oldim.
definitionEn: a reduction in the usual price

exampleEn: The store offered a full refund.
exampleRu: Магазин предложил полный возврат денег.
exampleUz: Do'kon to'liq pul qaytarishni taklif qildi.
definitionEn: money given back after a purchase is returned

exampleEn: This phone has a two-year warranty.
exampleRu: На этот телефон даётся двухлетняя гарантия.
exampleUz: Bu telefonga ikki yillik kafolat beriladi.
definitionEn: a company's promise to fix a product if it breaks

exampleEn: We found a great bargain at the market.
exampleRu: Мы нашли отличную сделку на рынке.
exampleUz: Biz bozorda ajoyib arzon xarid topdik.
definitionEn: something bought for less than its usual value

exampleEn: She made an online purchase yesterday.
exampleRu: Вчера она сделала покупку онлайн.
exampleUz: U kecha onlayn xarid qildi.
definitionEn: to buy something

exampleEn: Consumer rights are protected by law.
exampleRu: Права потребителей защищены законом.
exampleUz: Iste'molchilar huquqlari qonun bilan himoyalangan.
definitionEn: a person who buys and uses goods or services

exampleEn: The retailer offers free shipping.
exampleRu: Розничный продавец предлагает бесплатную доставку.
exampleUz: Chakana sotuvchi bepul yetkazib berishni taklif qiladi.
definitionEn: a business that sells goods directly to customers

exampleEn: A surcharge applies for credit card payments.
exampleRu: За оплату кредитной картой взимается доплата.
exampleUz: Kredit karta orqali to'lov uchun qo'shimcha to'lov olinadi.
definitionEn: an extra amount of money added to the usual price

exampleEn: That candy bar was an impulse buy.
exampleRu: Этот шоколадный батончик был спонтанной покупкой.
exampleUz: Bu shokolad to'satdan xarid edi.
definitionEn: something bought suddenly without planning to

exampleEn: Tourists often haggle over souvenir prices.
exampleRu: Туристы часто торгуются о ценах на сувениры.
exampleUz: Sayohatchilar ko'pincha suvenir narxlari ustida savdolashishadi.
definitionEn: to argue about a price in order to lower it

exampleEn: You need your passport to travel abroad.
exampleRu: Тебе нужен паспорт, чтобы поехать за границу.
exampleUz: Chet elga sayohat qilish uchun sizga pasport kerak.
definitionEn: an official document that proves who you are and lets you travel to other countries

exampleEn: I made a reservation at a nice restaurant.
exampleRu: Я забронировал столик в хорошем ресторане.
exampleUz: Men yaxshi restoranda bron qildim.
definitionEn: an arrangement made in advance to keep something, like a room or table, for you

exampleEn: The bus was full of passengers.
exampleRu: Автобус был полон пассажиров.
exampleUz: Avtobus yo'lovchilarga to'la edi.
definitionEn: a person travelling in a vehicle who is not driving it

exampleEn: The tour offered an immersive cultural experience.
exampleRu: Тур предложил полное погружение в культуру.
exampleUz: Tur madaniyatga to'liq singib ketish tajribasini taklif qildi.
definitionEn: making you feel like you are really part of an experience

exampleEn: My boss is very kind.
exampleRu: Мой начальник очень добрый.
exampleUz: Mening boshlig'im juda mehribon.
definitionEn: the person who is in charge of you at work

exampleEn: I finished my task on time.
exampleRu: Я закончил свою задачу вовремя.
exampleUz: Men vazifamni vaqtida tugatdim.
definitionEn: a piece of work that needs to be done

exampleEn: My supervisor reviewed my report.
exampleRu: Мой руководитель проверил мой отчёт.
exampleUz: Nazoratchim hisobotimni ko'rib chiqdi.
definitionEn: a person who watches over and directs the work of others

exampleEn: The old photos made her feel nostalgic.
exampleRu: Старые фотографии вызвали у неё ностальгию.
exampleUz: Eski suratlar unda sog'inch hissini uyg'otdi.
definitionEn: feeling a mix of happiness and sadness when thinking about the past

exampleEn: The cafe has free wifi.
exampleRu: В кафе есть бесплатный вайфай.
exampleUz: Kafeda bepul wi-fi bor.
definitionEn: a way to connect to the internet without using wires

exampleEn: The sun is shining brightly today.
exampleRu: Сегодня солнце светит ярко.
exampleUz: Bugun quyosh yorqin porlayapti.
definitionEn: the star that gives the Earth light and heat during the day

exampleEn: We saw many animals at the zoo.
exampleRu: Мы увидели много животных в зоопарке.
exampleUz: Biz hayvonot bog'ida ko'p hayvonlarni ko'rdik.
definitionEn: a living thing that can move and feel, but is not a plant

exampleEn: This species is found only in Africa.
exampleRu: Этот вид встречается только в Африке.
exampleUz: Bu tur faqat Afrikada uchraydi.
definitionEn: a group of animals or plants that are similar and can breed together

exampleEn: Many species are at risk of extinction.
exampleRu: Многие виды находятся под угрозой вымирания.
exampleUz: Ko'plab turlar yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida.
definitionEn: the state of no longer existing, when the last of a kind dies

exampleEn: Deforestation is destroying the rainforest quickly.
exampleRu: Вырубка лесов быстро уничтожает тропический лес.
exampleUz: O'rmonlarni qirqish yomg'ir o'rmonini tez yo'q qilmoqda.
definitionEn: the cutting down of a large number of trees over a wide area

exampleEn: I don't have enough money today.
exampleRu: У меня сегодня недостаточно денег.
exampleUz: Bugun menda yetarli pul yo'q.
definitionEn: the coins and paper notes used to pay for things

exampleEn: Can I pay by card?
exampleRu: Могу я заплатить картой?
exampleUz: Karta bilan to'lasam bo'ladimi?
definitionEn: to give money in exchange for something

exampleEn: The customer asked for a refund.
exampleRu: Клиент попросил вернуть деньги.
exampleUz: Mijoz pulni qaytarishni so'radi.

exampleRu: Она кажется довольной своей простой жизнью.

exampleRu: Он впал в уныние после потери работы.

exampleRu: Это была трогательная сцена в фильме.

exampleRu: Она грустно улыбнулась старой фотографии.

exampleRu: Мне нужна новая клавиатура для компьютера.

exampleRu: Не забудь зарядку от телефона.

definitionEn: a message that appears to inform you of something

exampleEn: Please install the latest update.
exampleRu: Пожалуйста, установи последнее обновление.
exampleUz: Iltimos, oxirgi yangilanishni o'rnating.
definitionEn: a new version of software with improvements

exampleEn: Click the button to continue.
exampleRu: Нажми на кнопку, чтобы продолжить.
exampleUz: Davom etish uchun tugmani bosing.
definitionEn: to press a button on a mouse or on a screen

exampleEn: Move the mouse to select the file.
exampleRu: Подвигай мышь, чтобы выбрать файл.
exampleUz: Faylni tanlash uchun sichqonchani harakatlantiring.
definitionEn: a small device used to control a pointer on a screen

exampleEn: The website's server crashed last night.
exampleRu: Сервер сайта вышел из строя прошлой ночью.
exampleUz: Veb-saytning serveri kecha ishdan chiqdi.
definitionEn: a powerful computer that provides data to other computers

exampleEn: Which browser do you use?
exampleRu: Каким браузером ты пользуешься?
exampleUz: Qaysi brauzerdan foydalanasiz?
definitionEn: a program used to look at websites

exampleEn: The firewall blocked the suspicious traffic.
exampleRu: Файрвол заблокировал подозрительный трафик.
exampleUz: Himoya devori shubhali trafikni bloklaydi.
definitionEn: a system that protects a computer network from unauthorized access

exampleEn: The app has a simple, clean interface.
exampleRu: У приложения простой, чистый интерфейс.
exampleUz: Ilovaning oddiy va toza interfeysi bor.
definitionEn: the way a person interacts with a computer program

exampleEn: All customer info is stored in a database.
exampleRu: Вся информация о клиентах хранится в базе данных.
exampleUz: Barcha mijoz ma'lumotlari ma'lumotlar bazasida saqlanadi.
definitionEn: an organized collection of information stored on a computer

exampleEn: I save my photos to the cloud.
exampleRu: Я сохраняю свои фотографии в облаке.
exampleUz: Men suratlarimni bulutga saqlayman.
definitionEn: online storage where you can keep files, accessed over the internet

exampleEn: The company invested more in cybersecurity.
exampleRu: Компания вложила больше средств в кибербезопасность.
exampleUz: Kompaniya kiberxavfsizlikka ko'proq mablag' sarfladi.
definitionEn: protection of computer systems from digital attacks

exampleEn: Interoperability between devices improved this year.
exampleRu: Совместимость между устройствами улучшилась в этом году.
exampleUz: Bu yil qurilmalar o'rtasidagi o'zaro moslashuvchanlik yaxshilandi.
definitionEn: the ability of different systems to work together

exampleEn: The new server has higher throughput.
exampleRu: У нового сервера более высокая пропускная способность.
exampleUz: Yangi serverning o'tkazish qobiliyati yuqoriroq.
definitionEn: the amount of data processed in a given time

exampleEn: Virtualization allows one server to run many systems.
exampleRu: Виртуализация позволяет одному серверу запускать много систем.
exampleUz: Virtuallashtirish bitta serverda ko'p tizimlarni ishga tushirish imkonini beradi.
definitionEn: creating a virtual version of a computer system

exampleEn: This function was deprecated in the new version.
exampleRu: Эта функция была признана устаревшей в новой версии.
exampleUz: Bu funksiya yangi versiyada eskirgan deb topildi.
definitionEn: to officially mark something as outdated and discourage its use

exampleEn: The app uses asynchronous requests for speed.
exampleRu: Приложение использует асинхронные запросы для скорости.
exampleUz: Ilova tezlik uchun asinxron so'rovlardan foydalanadi.
definitionEn: not happening at the same time, working independently

exampleEn: The team refactored the old codebase.
exampleRu: Команда провела рефакторинг старой кодовой базы.
exampleUz: Jamoa eski kod bazasini qayta ishlab chiqdi.
definitionEn: to restructure code without changing what it does

exampleEn: Server provisioning takes only a few minutes now.
exampleRu: Подготовка сервера теперь занимает всего несколько минут.
exampleUz: Endi server resurslarini taqsimlash bir necha daqiqa vaqt oladi.
definitionEn: the process of setting up IT resources for use

exampleEn: The system is resilient to sudden failures.
exampleRu: Система устойчива к внезапным сбоям.
exampleUz: Tizim to'satdan yuzaga keladigan nosozliklarga chidamli.
definitionEn: able to keep working well even after problems occur

exampleEn: The antivirus uses heuristic analysis to find threats.
exampleRu: Антивирус использует эвристический анализ для обнаружения угроз.
exampleUz: Antivirus tahdidlarni aniqlash uchun evristik tahlildan foydalanadi.
definitionEn: a practical method for solving problems that isn't guaranteed perfect but works well

exampleEn: The sky turned orange at sunset.
exampleRu: Небо стало оранжевым на закате.
exampleUz: Quyosh botganda osmon apelsin rangiga aylandi.
definitionEn: the space above the earth where clouds and the sun are seen

exampleEn: We stayed inside because of the rain.
exampleRu: Мы остались внутри из-за дождя.
exampleUz: Yomg'ir tufayli biz uyda qoldik.
definitionEn: water that falls from clouds

exampleEn: The children played in the snow.
exampleRu: Дети играли в снегу.
exampleUz: Bolalar qorda o'ynashdi.
definitionEn: soft white frozen water that falls from the sky in winter

exampleEn: A strong wind blew the leaves away.
exampleRu: Сильный ветер сдул листья.
exampleUz: Kuchli shamol barglarni uchirib ketdi.
definitionEn: air moving quickly outside

exampleEn: We swam in the sea all afternoon.
exampleRu: Мы плавали в море весь день.
exampleUz: Biz butun kun dengizda suzdik.
definitionEn: a large area of salt water

exampleEn: She picked flowers from the garden.
exampleRu: Она сорвала цветы в саду.
exampleUz: U bog'dan gullar terib oldi.
definitionEn: the colorful part of a plant that often smells nice

exampleEn: The children played on the green grass.
exampleRu: Дети играли на зелёной траве.
exampleUz: Bolalar yashil o'tda o'ynashdi.
definitionEn: the short green plants that cover the ground

exampleEn: We saw many stars in the night sky.
exampleRu: Мы увидели много звёзд на ночном небе.
exampleUz: Biz tungi osmonda ko'plab yulduzlarni ko'rdik.
definitionEn: a bright point of light seen in the sky at night

exampleEn: The coastline stretches for miles.
exampleRu: Береговая линия тянется на многие мили.
exampleUz: Qirg'oq chizig'i ko'p milya davomida cho'ziladi.
definitionEn: the edge of land where it meets the sea

exampleEn: The volcano erupted after years of silence.
exampleRu: Вулкан извергся после многих лет молчания.
exampleUz: Vulqon ko'p yillik sukunatdan keyin otildi.
definitionEn: a mountain that can explode with hot melted rock

exampleEn: The glacier is melting due to warming.
exampleRu: Ледник тает из-за потепления.
exampleUz: Muzlik isish tufayli erimoqda.
definitionEn: a huge mass of ice that moves slowly

exampleEn: The Grand Canyon is a famous natural wonder.
exampleRu: Гранд-Каньон — известное природное чудо.
exampleUz: Grand-Kanyon mashhur tabiiy mo'jiza.
definitionEn: a deep valley with steep sides, often formed by a river

exampleEn: Wetlands provide homes for many birds.
exampleRu: Заболоченные местности являются домом для многих птиц.
exampleUz: Botqoqli hududlar ko'plab qushlar uchun uy vazifasini bajaradi.
definitionEn: land that is always wet or covered in water

exampleEn: The Amazon rainforest is home to millions of species.
exampleRu: Тропический лес Амазонки — дом для миллионов видов.
exampleUz: Amazonka tropik o'rmoni millionlab turlarga uy bo'lib xizmat qiladi.
definitionEn: a thick forest found in areas with heavy rainfall

exampleEn: The earthquake destroyed many buildings.
exampleRu: Землетрясение разрушило много зданий.
exampleUz: Zilzila ko'plab binolarni vayron qildi.
definitionEn: a sudden shaking of the ground

exampleEn: Cows were grazing in the meadow.
exampleRu: Коровы паслись на лугу.
exampleUz: Sigirlar o'tloqda o'tlab yurishardi.
definitionEn: a field covered in grass and wild flowers

exampleEn: The village sits in a green valley.
exampleRu: Деревня находится в зелёной долине.
exampleUz: Qishloq yashil vodiyda joylashgan.
definitionEn: low land between hills or mountains, often with a river

exampleEn: Overfishing has depleted fish populations.
exampleRu: Чрезмерный вылов истощил популяции рыбы.
exampleUz: Ortiqcha ovlash baliq populyatsiyasini tugatdi.
definitionEn: to use up a resource until little is left

exampleEn: The desert has an arid climate.
exampleRu: В пустыне засушливый климат.
exampleUz: Sahroda quruq iqlim hukm suradi.
definitionEn: having very little rain, dry

exampleEn: The terrain here is very rocky.
exampleRu: Местность здесь очень каменистая.
exampleUz: Bu yerdagi relyef juda toshloq.
definitionEn: the physical features of an area of land

exampleEn: Permafrost is melting in parts of Siberia.
exampleRu: Вечная мерзлота тает в некоторых районах Сибири.
exampleUz: Sibirning ba'zi hududlarida abadiy muzlik erimoqda.
definitionEn: ground that stays frozen all year round

exampleEn: Bees and flowers live in symbiosis.
exampleRu: Пчёлы и цветы живут в симбиозе.
exampleUz: Asalarilar va gullar simbiozda yashaydi.
definitionEn: a close relationship between two different living things that benefits both

exampleEn: The map shows the topography of the region.
exampleRu: Карта показывает топографию региона.
exampleUz: Xarita hududning topografiyasini ko'rsatadi.
definitionEn: the physical arrangement of the natural features of an area

exampleEn: The city gets its water from an underground aquifer.
exampleRu: Город получает воду из подземного водоносного слоя.
exampleUz: Shahar suvni yer osti suv qatlamidan oladi.
definitionEn: a layer of rock underground that holds water

exampleEn: The region has a temperate climate.
exampleRu: В регионе умеренный климат.
exampleUz: Hududda mo''tadil iqlim mavjud.
definitionEn: having a mild climate, not too hot or too cold

exampleEn: I want to buy a new jacket.
exampleRu: Я хочу купить новую куртку.
exampleUz: Men yangi kurtka sotib olmoqchiman.
definitionEn: to get something by paying money for it

exampleEn: They sell fresh vegetables here.
exampleRu: Здесь продают свежие овощи.
exampleUz: Bu yerda yangi sabzavotlar sotiladi.
definitionEn: to give something to someone in exchange for money

exampleEn: The store closes at nine.
exampleRu: Магазин закрывается в девять.
exampleUz: Do'kon soat to'qqizda yopiladi.
definitionEn: a place where goods are sold

exampleEn: I left my wallet at home.
exampleRu: Я оставил кошелёк дома.
exampleUz: Hamyonimni uyda qoldirdim.
definitionEn: a small flat case for carrying money and cards

exampleEn: I found a coin on the ground.
exampleRu: Я нашёл монету на земле.
exampleUz: Yerdan tanga topdim.
definitionEn: a small round piece of metal used as money

exampleEn: She gave me a birthday gift.
exampleRu: Она подарила мне подарок на день рождения.
exampleUz: U menga tug'ilgan kun sovg'asini berdi.
definitionEn: something given to someone without payment

exampleEn: Put the groceries in the bag.
exampleRu: Положи продукты в пакет.
exampleUz: Oziq-ovqatlarni sumkaga soling.
definitionEn: a container made of soft material, used to carry things

exampleEn: We spent the whole day at the mall.
exampleRu: Мы провели весь день в торговом центре.
exampleUz: Biz butun kunni savdo markazida o'tkazdik.
definitionEn: a large building with many shops inside

exampleEn: I used a voucher to get a discount.
exampleRu: Я использовал купон, чтобы получить скидку.
exampleUz: Chegirma olish uchun kupondan foydalandim.
definitionEn: a piece of paper that can be exchanged for goods or a discount

exampleEn: She browsed the furniture catalog.
exampleRu: Она просматривала каталог мебели.
exampleUz: U mebel katalogini ko'zdan kechirdi.
definitionEn: a list of items available to buy, often with pictures

exampleEn: We buy products at wholesale prices.
exampleRu: Мы покупаем товары по оптовым ценам.
exampleUz: Biz mahsulotlarni ulgurji narxlarda sotib olamiz.
definitionEn: selling goods in large quantities at lower prices

exampleEn: This is a very popular clothing brand.
exampleRu: Это очень популярный бренд одежды.
exampleUz: Bu juda mashhur kiyim brendi.
definitionEn: the name of a product made by a particular company

exampleEn: The store checked its inventory before the sale.
exampleRu: Магазин проверил свои товарные запасы перед распродажей.
exampleUz: Do'kon sotuvdan oldin o'z inventarini tekshirdi.
definitionEn: the full list or amount of goods a business has

exampleEn: I want to exchange this shirt for a bigger size.
exampleRu: Я хочу обменять эту рубашку на больший размер.
exampleUz: Men bu ko'ylakni kattaroq o'lchamga almashtirmoqchiman.
definitionEn: to give one thing and receive another in return

exampleEn: We have a small budget for gifts this year.
exampleRu: В этом году у нас небольшой бюджет на подарки.
exampleUz: Bu yil bizda sovg'alar uchun kichik byudjet bor.
definitionEn: a plan for how much money you can spend

exampleEn: This shop sells high quality shoes.
exampleRu: Этот магазин продаёт обувь высокого качества.
exampleUz: Bu do'kon yuqori sifatli poyabzal sotadi.
definitionEn: how good or bad something is

exampleEn: The store adds a 30% markup to each product.
exampleRu: Магазин добавляет 30% наценки к каждому товару.
exampleUz: Do'kon har bir mahsulotga 30% narx qo'shimchasi qo'shadi.
definitionEn: the amount added to the cost price to set the selling price

exampleEn: The company improved its procurement process.
exampleRu: Компания улучшила процесс закупок.
exampleUz: Kompaniya xarid qilish jarayonini yaxshiladi.
definitionEn: the process of obtaining goods or services for a business

exampleEn: E-commerce has grown rapidly in recent years.
exampleRu: Электронная торговля быстро росла в последние годы.
exampleUz: So'nggi yillarda elektron tijorat tez rivojlandi.
definitionEn: buying and selling goods over the internet

exampleEn: Everything is 70% off during the liquidation sale.
exampleRu: Во время распродажи при ликвидации всё продаётся со скидкой 70%.
exampleUz: Tugatish savdosi davomida hamma narsa 70% chegirma bilan sotiladi.
definitionEn: selling off all stock, usually because a business is closing

exampleEn: Bright colors entice customers into the shop.
exampleRu: Яркие цвета привлекают покупателей в магазин.
exampleUz: Yorqin ranglar mijozlarni do'konga jalb qiladi.
definitionEn: to attract someone by offering something appealing

exampleEn: The warehouse has an overstock of winter coats.
exampleRu: На складе избыток зимних пальто.
exampleUz: Omborda qishki paltolarning ortiqcha zaxirasi bor.
definitionEn: more goods than can be sold, extra stock

exampleEn: These points are redeemable for a free coffee.
exampleRu: Эти баллы можно обменять на бесплатный кофе.
exampleUz: Bu ballarni bepul qahvaga almashtirish mumkin.
definitionEn: able to be exchanged for something of value

exampleEn: The bank confirmed the transaction.
exampleRu: Банк подтвердил транзакцию.
exampleUz: Bank tranzaksiyani tasdiqladi.
definitionEn: an act of buying or selling something

exampleEn: The company has a monopoly on this market.
exampleRu: Компания имеет монополию на этом рынке.
exampleUz: Kompaniya bu bozorda monopoliyaga ega.
definitionEn: complete control of a product or service by one company

exampleEn: That's a really cool jacket!
exampleRu: Это действительно классная куртка!
exampleUz: Bu chindan ham zo'r kurtka!
definitionEn: (informal) very good or impressive

exampleEn: We had an awesome time at the party.
exampleRu: Мы классно провели время на вечеринке.
exampleUz: Bizda ziyofatda ajoyib vaqt o'tdi.
definitionEn: (informal) extremely good or impressive

exampleEn: I'm gonna call you later.
exampleRu: Я тебе позже позвоню.
exampleUz: Men senga keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchiman.
definitionEn: (informal, spoken) short way of saying 'going to'

exampleEn: Let's just chill at home tonight.
exampleRu: Давай просто отдохнём дома сегодня вечером.
exampleUz: Keling, bugun kechqurun uyda dam olaylik.
definitionEn: (informal) to relax and not worry

exampleEn: I'm totally broke until payday.
exampleRu: Я совсем на мели до зарплаты.
exampleUz: Ish haqi kunigacha men butunlay pulsizman.
definitionEn: (informal) having no money

exampleEn: Is this website legit?
exampleRu: Этот сайт настоящий (не мошенничество)?
exampleUz: Bu vebsayt haqiqiymi?
definitionEn: (informal) real, genuine, or honest

exampleEn: He got salty after losing the game.
exampleRu: Он обиделся после проигрыша в игре.
exampleUz: U o'yinda yutqazgandan keyin xafa bo'ldi.
definitionEn: (informal) angry or annoyed, especially about something small

exampleEn: I'm lowkey excited for the weekend.
exampleRu: Я немного взволнован в ожидании выходных.
exampleUz: Men dam olish kunlari uchun biroz hayajonlanyapman.
definitionEn: (informal) slightly, or without wanting to show it openly

exampleEn: This cafe has a really nice vibe.
exampleRu: В этом кафе действительно приятная атмосфера.
exampleUz: Bu kafening kayfiyati chindan ham yoqimli.
definitionEn: (informal) the general feeling or atmosphere of a place or situation

exampleEn: This exam was a piece of cake.
exampleRu: Этот экзамен был проще простого.
exampleUz: Bu imtihon juda oson edi.
definitionEn: (idiom) something very easy to do

exampleEn: Break a leg at your performance tonight!
exampleRu: Ни пуха ни пера на сегодняшнем выступлении!
exampleUz: Bugungi chiqishingizga omad tilayman!
definitionEn: (idiom) a way to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance

exampleEn: No worries, we can reschedule the meeting.
exampleRu: Без проблем, мы можем перенести встречу.
exampleUz: Hech qisi yo'q, uchrashuvni qayta rejalashtirishimiz mumkin.
definitionEn: (idiom) used to say something is not a problem

exampleEn: I need to hit the books before the exam.
exampleRu: Мне нужно сесть за учёбу перед экзаменом.
exampleUz: Imtihondan oldin darslarga o'tirishim kerak.
definitionEn: (idiom) to begin studying seriously

exampleEn: She stayed home because she felt under the weather.
exampleRu: Она осталась дома, потому что неважно себя чувствовала.
exampleUz: U o'zini yomon his qilgani uchun uyda qoldi.
definitionEn: (idiom) feeling slightly ill

exampleEn: Come on, spill the beans — what happened?
exampleRu: Давай, колись — что случилось?
exampleUz: Qani, sirni oshkor qil — nima bo'ldi?
definitionEn: (idiom) to tell a secret

exampleEn: I'll just bite the bullet and start the diet tomorrow.
exampleRu: Я просто стисну зубы и начну диету завтра.
exampleUz: Men shunchaki qiyinchilikka dosh berib, ertaga parhezni boshlayman.
definitionEn: (idiom) to force yourself to do something unpleasant that you have been avoiding

exampleEn: Don't cut corners when it comes to safety.
exampleRu: Не экономь на качестве, когда речь идёт о безопасности.
exampleUz: Xavfsizlik masalasida sifatni pasaytirmang.
definitionEn: (idiom) to do something in the easiest or cheapest way, often lowering quality

exampleEn: Stop beating around the bush and tell me the truth.
exampleRu: Хватит ходить вокруг да около, скажи мне правду.
exampleUz: Gapni cho'zmasdan, menga haqiqatni ayting.
definitionEn: (idiom) to avoid talking directly about the main subject

exampleEn: There has been a substantial increase in prices.
exampleRu: Произошёл существенный рост цен.
exampleUz: Narxlarda katta o'sish yuz berdi.
definitionEn: large in amount or degree; important

exampleEn: This is a significant achievement.
exampleRu: Это значительное достижение.
exampleUz: Bu muhim yutuq.
definitionEn: important enough to be noticed or to have an effect

exampleEn: Climate change is a global phenomenon.
exampleRu: Изменение климата — глобальное явление.
exampleUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi global hodisadir.
definitionEn: a fact or event, especially one that is unusual

exampleEn: He was late; consequently, he missed the bus.
exampleRu: Он опоздал, следовательно, пропустил автобус.
exampleUz: U kechikdi, natijada avtobusga ulgurmadi.
definitionEn: as a result of something; therefore

exampleEn: Furthermore, the study shows positive results.
exampleRu: Более того, исследование показывает положительные результаты.
exampleUz: Bundan tashqari, tadqiqot ijobiy natijalarni ko'rsatmoqda.
definitionEn: in addition to what has already been said

exampleEn: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.
exampleRu: Шёл дождь, но тем не менее мы вышли на улицу.
exampleUz: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, shunga qaramay biz tashqariga chiqdik.
definitionEn: in spite of what has just been said

exampleEn: We need adequate time to finish the project.
exampleRu: Нам нужно достаточно времени, чтобы закончить проект.
exampleUz: Loyihani tugatish uchun bizga yetarli vaqt kerak.
definitionEn: enough or good enough for a particular purpose

exampleEn: This took considerable effort.
exampleRu: Это потребовало значительных усилий.
exampleUz: Bu sezilarli kuch talab qildi.
definitionEn: large in amount or degree

exampleEn: The company will undertake a new project next year.
exampleRu: В следующем году компания возьмётся за новый проект.
exampleUz: Kompaniya kelasi yil yangi loyihani amalga oshiradi.
definitionEn: to make oneself responsible for a task and begin doing it

exampleEn: Technology facilitates communication between people.
exampleRu: Технологии способствуют общению между людьми.
exampleUz: Texnologiya odamlar o'rtasidagi muloqotni qulaylashtiradi.
definitionEn: to make a process or action easier

exampleEn: The results demonstrate clear progress.
exampleRu: Результаты демонстрируют явный прогресс.
exampleUz: Natijalar aniq taraqqiyotni namoyish qiladi.
definitionEn: to clearly show that something exists or is true

exampleEn: Everyone should contribute to the group project.
exampleRu: Каждый должен внести вклад в групповой проект.
exampleUz: Har kim guruh loyihasiga hissa qo'shishi kerak.
definitionEn: to give something, especially money or help, to a common effort

exampleEn: These are two distinct issues.
exampleRu: Это две разные проблемы.
exampleUz: Bular ikkita alohida masala.
definitionEn: recognizably different in nature from something else

exampleEn: The population here is predominantly young.
exampleRu: Население здесь преимущественно молодое.
exampleUz: Bu yerdagi aholi asosan yosh.
definitionEn: for the most part; mainly

exampleEn: The committee comprises five members.
exampleRu: Комитет состоит из пяти членов.
exampleUz: Qo'mita besh a'zodan tashkil topgan.
definitionEn: to consist of or be made up of

exampleEn: From my perspective, this decision was wrong.
exampleRu: С моей точки зрения, это решение было ошибочным.
exampleUz: Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, bu qaror noto'g'ri edi.
definitionEn: a particular way of considering something

exampleEn: This statistic surprised everyone at the meeting.
exampleRu: Этот статистический показатель удивил всех на встрече.
exampleUz: Bu statistika uchrashuvdagi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
definitionEn: a fact or piece of data from a study of a large amount of numerical data

exampleEn: Tensions between the two countries began to escalate.
exampleRu: Напряжённость между двумя странами начала обостряться.
exampleUz: Ikki davlat o'rtasidagi keskinlik kuchaya boshladi.
definitionEn: to become or make something greater or more serious

exampleEn: The benefits of the plan outweigh the risks.
exampleRu: Преимущества плана перевешивают риски.
exampleUz: Rejaning foydalari xavflardan ustun keladi.
definitionEn: to be greater or more important than something else

exampleEn: Can you justify your decision to the board?
exampleRu: Можешь ли ты обосновать своё решение перед советом?
exampleUz: Qarorlaringizni kengashga asoslab bera olasizmi?
definitionEn: to show or prove that something is right or reasonable

exampleEn: The two factors correlate closely in the data.
exampleRu: Эти два фактора тесно соотносятся в данных.
exampleUz: Ikki omil ma'lumotlarda yaqindan bog'liq.
definitionEn: to have a mutual relationship, so that one thing changes when the other does

exampleEn: That's a plausible explanation for the delay.
exampleRu: Это правдоподобное объяснение задержки.
exampleUz: Bu kechikish uchun ishonarli tushuntirish.
definitionEn: seeming reasonable or probable

exampleEn: Many experts advocate for stricter regulations.
exampleRu: Многие эксперты выступают за более строгие правила.
exampleUz: Ko'p mutaxassislar qattiqroq qoidalar tarafdori.
definitionEn: to publicly support or recommend a particular cause or policy

exampleEn: He lived an austere life with few possessions.
exampleRu: Он вёл аскетичную жизнь, почти без имущества.
exampleUz: U kam mulk bilan sodda hayot kechirdi.
definitionEn: severe or strict in manner or appearance; having no comforts

exampleEn: A benevolent leader always cares about the people.
exampleRu: Доброжелательный лидер всегда заботится о людях.
exampleUz: Xayrixoh yetakchi doim odamlar haqida qayg'uradi.
definitionEn: well-meaning and kindly

exampleEn: She gave a candid answer to the difficult question.
exampleRu: Она дала откровенный ответ на сложный вопрос.
exampleUz: U qiyin savolga samimiy javob berdi.
definitionEn: truthful and straightforward; frank

exampleEn: He spoke with deference to his elders.
exampleRu: Он говорил с уважением к старшим.
exampleUz: U kattalarga hurmat bilan gapirdi.
definitionEn: humble submission and respect

exampleEn: He is very frugal with his money.
exampleRu: Он очень бережлив со своими деньгами.
exampleUz: U o'z puliga juda tejamkor.
definitionEn: sparing or careful regarding money

exampleEn: That was a genuine mistake, not a lie.
exampleRu: Это была искренняя ошибка, а не ложь.
exampleUz: Bu haqiqiy xato edi, yolg'on emas.
definitionEn: truly what something is said to be; sincere

exampleEn: Bad weather hindered our progress up the mountain.
exampleRu: Плохая погода мешала нашему продвижению в гору.
exampleUz: Yomon ob-havo tog'ga chiqishimizga to'sqinlik qildi.
definitionEn: to create difficulty for someone, making progress harder

exampleEn: A judge must remain impartial at all times.
exampleRu: Судья всегда должен оставаться беспристрастным.
exampleUz: Sudya har doim xolis bo'lishi kerak.
definitionEn: treating all sides or parties equally; not biased

exampleEn: He gave a lucid explanation of the problem.
exampleRu: Он дал ясное объяснение проблемы.
exampleUz: U muammoni ravshan tushuntirdi.
definitionEn: expressed clearly; easy to understand

exampleEn: She's still a novice at cooking.
exampleRu: В готовке она пока новичок.
exampleUz: U hali oshpazlikda yangi boshlovchi.
definitionEn: a person new to a particular activity

exampleEn: We need a pragmatic solution, not an ideal one.
exampleRu: Нам нужно прагматичное решение, а не идеальное.
exampleUz: Bizga ideal emas, pragmatik yechim kerak.
definitionEn: dealing with things sensibly and realistically

exampleEn: I'm in a real quandary about which job to accept.
exampleRu: Я в настоящем затруднении, какую работу принять.
exampleUz: Qaysi ishni qabul qilish borasida qiyin ahvoldaman.
definitionEn: a state of uncertainty over what to do in a difficult situation

exampleEn: I'm skeptical about that claim.
exampleRu: Я скептически отношусь к этому утверждению.
exampleUz: Men bu da'voga shubha bilan qarayman.
definitionEn: not easily convinced; having doubts

exampleEn: She has a tenacious spirit and never gives up.
exampleRu: У неё упорный характер, она никогда не сдаётся.
exampleUz: Uning qat'iyatli ruhi bor, u hech qachon taslim bo'lmaydi.
definitionEn: tending to keep a firm hold; persistent

exampleEn: People in this culture venerate their ancestors.
exampleRu: В этой культуре люди почитают своих предков.
exampleUz: Bu madaniyatda odamlar ajdodlarini e'zozlashadi.
definitionEn: to regard with great respect; revere

exampleEn: The story has a whimsical, dreamlike charm.
exampleRu: У истории есть причудливое, сказочное очарование.
exampleUz: Hikoyada injiq, tushdagidek jozibadorlik bor.
definitionEn: playfully quaint or fanciful, especially in an appealing way

exampleEn: She is a remarkably articulate speaker.
exampleRu: Она удивительно красноречивый оратор.
exampleUz: U ajoyib darajada ravon gapiruvchi notiq.
definitionEn: able to express thoughts and feelings clearly and effectively

exampleEn: His argument was coherent and well organized.
exampleRu: Его аргументация была связной и хорошо организованной.
exampleUz: Uning dalili izchil va yaxshi tuzilgan edi.
definitionEn: logical and consistent; easy to follow

exampleEn: She is a diligent student who always does her homework.
exampleRu: Она усердная студентка, которая всегда делает домашнее задание.
exampleUz: U doim uy vazifasini bajaradigan tirishqoq talaba.
definitionEn: having or showing care and conscientiousness in one's work

exampleEn: Success remained elusive despite years of effort.
exampleRu: Успех оставался неуловимым, несмотря на годы усилий.
exampleUz: Yillar davomida harakat qilishga qaramay, muvaffaqiyat qo'lga kiritilmadi.
definitionEn: difficult to find, catch, or achieve

exampleEn: She has an innate talent for music.
exampleRu: У неё врождённый талант к музыке.
exampleUz: Uning musiqaga tug'ma iste'dodi bor.
definitionEn: inborn; natural rather than learned

exampleEn: They survived on a meager income for years.
exampleRu: Они годами жили на скудный доход.
exampleUz: Ular yillar davomida kam daromadda yashashdi.
definitionEn: lacking in quantity or quality

exampleEn: It's prudent to save money for emergencies.
exampleRu: Благоразумно откладывать деньги на непредвиденные случаи.
exampleUz: Favqulodda holatlar uchun pul jamg'arish oqilona.
definitionEn: acting with or showing care and thought for the future

exampleEn: The economy has been stagnant for two years.
exampleRu: Экономика находится в застое уже два года.
exampleUz: Iqtisodiyot ikki yildan beri turg'un holatda.
definitionEn: showing no activity; not developing or progressing

exampleEn: The study is based on empirical evidence.
exampleRu: Исследование основано на эмпирических данных.
exampleUz: Tadqiqot empirik dalillarga asoslangan.
definitionEn: based on observation or experience rather than theory

exampleEn: The research methodology was carefully explained.
exampleRu: Методология исследования была подробно объяснена.
exampleUz: Tadqiqot metodologiyasi batafsil tushuntirildi.
definitionEn: a system of methods used in a particular area of study

exampleEn: Temperature is an important variable in this experiment.
exampleRu: Температура — важная переменная в этом эксперименте.
exampleUz: Harorat bu tajribada muhim o'zgaruvchan miqdordir.
definitionEn: an element, feature, or factor that is liable to change

exampleEn: The results correspond closely to our predictions.
exampleRu: Результаты близко соответствуют нашим прогнозам.
exampleUz: Natijalar bashoratlarimizga yaqindan mos keladi.
definitionEn: to be in agreement or conformity

exampleEn: The two events occurred simultaneously.
exampleRu: Оба события произошли одновременно.
exampleUz: Ikkala voqea bir vaqtda sodir bo'ldi.
definitionEn: happening or existing at the same time

exampleEn: Subsequent studies confirmed the original results.
exampleRu: Последующие исследования подтвердили первоначальные результаты.
exampleUz: Keyingi tadqiqotlar dastlabki natijalarni tasdiqladi.
definitionEn: coming after something in time

exampleEn: These are only preliminary findings.
exampleRu: Это лишь предварительные результаты.
exampleUz: Bular faqat dastlabki natijalar.
definitionEn: denoting an action or event preceding a more important one

exampleEn: Women constitute half of the workforce today.
exampleRu: Сегодня женщины составляют половину рабочей силы.
exampleUz: Bugungi kunda ayollar ish kuchining yarmini tashkil qiladi.
definitionEn: to be a part of a whole; to form or make up something

exampleEn: This word derives from a Latin root.
exampleRu: Это слово происходит от латинского корня.
exampleUz: Bu so'z lotincha ildizdan kelib chiqqan.
definitionEn: to obtain something from a specified source

exampleEn: Trust is integral to any good relationship.
exampleRu: Доверие — неотъемлемая часть любых хороших отношений.
exampleUz: Ishonch har qanday yaxshi munosabatlarning ajralmas qismidir.
definitionEn: necessary to make a whole complete; essential

exampleEn: That's an interesting notion worth exploring.
exampleRu: Это интересная идея, стоящая изучения.
exampleUz: Bu o'rganishga arziydigan qiziqarli tushuncha.
definitionEn: a conception of or belief about something

exampleEn: It's a strange paradox that more choice can mean less happiness.
exampleRu: Странный парадокс: больше выбора может означать меньше счастья.
exampleUz: Ko'proq tanlov kamroq baxt degani bo'lishi g'alati paradoksdir.
definitionEn: a statement that seems self-contradictory but may be true

exampleEn: Presumably, he already knows about the change.
exampleRu: Предположительно, он уже знает об изменении.
exampleUz: Ehtimol, u o'zgarish haqida allaqachon biladi.
definitionEn: used to convey that what is asserted is very likely though not known for certain

exampleEn: The rule seems completely arbitrary to me.
exampleRu: Это правило кажется мне совершенно произвольным.
exampleUz: Bu qoida menga butunlay o'zboshimchalik kabi tuyuladi.
definitionEn: based on random choice rather than any reason or system

exampleEn: The dates coincide with the local festival.
exampleRu: Даты совпадают с местным фестивалем.
exampleUz: Sanalar mahalliy festival bilan to'g'ri keladi.
definitionEn: to occur at the same time; to correspond

exampleEn: It's hard to conceive of such a complex plan.
exampleRu: Трудно постичь столь сложный план.
exampleUz: Bunday murakkab rejani tasavvur qilish qiyin.
definitionEn: to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind

exampleEn: We can deduce the answer from the given data.
exampleRu: Мы можем вывести ответ из данных.
exampleUz: Berilgan ma'lumotlardan javobni xulosa qilishimiz mumkin.
definitionEn: to reach a conclusion by reasoning from given facts

exampleEn: This disease is especially prevalent in the region.
exampleRu: Эта болезнь особенно распространена в регионе.
exampleUz: Bu kasallik hududda ayniqsa keng tarqalgan.
definitionEn: widespread in a particular area or at a particular time

exampleEn: The new data reinforce our original theory.
exampleRu: Новые данные подкрепляют нашу первоначальную теорию.
exampleUz: Yangi ma'lumotlar bizning dastlabki nazariyamizni mustahkamlaydi.
definitionEn: to strengthen or support something, especially a belief

exampleEn: There's a wide spectrum of opinions on this issue.
exampleRu: По этому вопросу существует широкий спектр мнений.
exampleUz: Bu masalada fikrlarning keng diapazoni mavjud.
definitionEn: a wide range of related qualities, ideas, or activities

exampleEn: What is the underlying cause of this problem?
exampleRu: Какова первопричина этой проблемы?
exampleUz: Bu muammoning asosiy sababi nima?
definitionEn: existing beneath or below something; the true cause of something not immediately obvious

exampleEn: Is this really a viable option for the company?
exampleRu: Действительно ли это осуществимый вариант для компании?
exampleUz: Bu kompaniya uchun haqiqatan ham amalga oshirish mumkin bo'lgan variantmi?
definitionEn: capable of working successfully; feasible

exampleEn: It's hard to differentiate between the two theories.
exampleRu: Трудно провести различие между этими двумя теориями.
exampleUz: Ikki nazariya orasidagi farqni ajratish qiyin.
definitionEn: to recognize or ascertain what makes something different

exampleEn: We have a tentative plan for next month.
exampleRu: У нас есть предварительный план на следующий месяц.
exampleUz: Bizda kelasi oy uchun vaqtinchalik reja bor.
definitionEn: not certain or fixed; provisional

exampleEn: Scientists attribute the change to rising temperatures.
exampleRu: Учёные связывают это изменение с ростом температуры.
exampleUz: Olimlar o'zgarishni haroratning ko'tarilishiga bog'laydi.
definitionEn: to regard something as being caused by something else

exampleEn: There is overwhelming evidence for this theory.
exampleRu: Существуют неопровержимые доказательства этой теории.
exampleUz: Bu nazariya uchun haddan tashqari ko'p dalillar mavjud.
definitionEn: very great in amount or effect

exampleEn: The school will implement a new policy next term.
exampleRu: Школа внедрит новую политику в следующем семестре.
exampleUz: Maktab keyingi semestrda yangi siyosatni joriy qiladi.
definitionEn: to put a decision or plan into effect

exampleEn: Teachers assess students' progress every term.
exampleRu: Учителя оценивают успеваемость учеников каждый семестр.
exampleUz: O'qituvchilar har semestrda o'quvchilar taraqqiyotini baholaydi.
definitionEn: to evaluate or estimate the nature or quality of something

exampleEn: She is a conscientious worker who never cuts corners.
exampleRu: Она добросовестный работник, который никогда не халтурит.
exampleUz: U hech qachon sifatni pasaytirmaydigan vijdonli xodim.
definitionEn: wishing to do what is right, especially to do one's work well

exampleEn: Debt can accumulate quickly if you don't pay it off.
exampleRu: Долг может быстро накапливаться, если его не выплачивать.
exampleUz: Agar uni to'lamasangiz, qarz tez to'planib qolishi mumkin.
definitionEn: to gather together or increase in quantity over time

exampleEn: The government will allocate more funds to education.
exampleRu: Правительство выделит больше средств на образование.
exampleUz: Hukumat ta'limga ko'proq mablag' ajratadi.
definitionEn: to give a share of something for a particular purpose

exampleEn: She compiled a list of useful sources for the essay.
exampleRu: Она составила список полезных источников для эссе.
exampleUz: U inshо uchun foydali manbalar ro'yxatini tuzdi.
definitionEn: to collect information from different sources and put it together

exampleEn: The new product must conform to safety standards.
exampleRu: Новый продукт должен соответствовать стандартам безопасности.
exampleUz: Yangi mahsulot xavfsizlik standartlariga mos kelishi kerak.
definitionEn: to behave according to socially accepted rules or standards

exampleEn: A red flag on the beach denotes danger.
exampleRu: Красный флаг на пляже означает опасность.
exampleUz: Plyajdagi qizil bayroq xavfni anglatadi.
definitionEn: to be a sign of or indicate something

exampleEn: His influence began to diminish over time.
exampleRu: Его влияние со временем начало уменьшаться.
exampleUz: Uning ta'siri vaqt o'tishi bilan kamaya boshladi.
definitionEn: to become or make something smaller or less

exampleEn: One kilometer is roughly equivalent to 0.6 miles.
exampleRu: Один километр примерно эквивалентен 0,6 мили.
exampleUz: Bir kilometr taxminan 0,6 milga teng.
definitionEn: equal in value, amount, or meaning

exampleEn: Prices for oil fluctuate depending on global demand.
exampleRu: Цены на нефть колеблются в зависимости от мирового спроса.
exampleUz: Neft narxlari jahon talabiga qarab o'zgarib turadi.
definitionEn: to change frequently in level or amount

exampleEn: Fear of failure can inhibit creativity.
exampleRu: Страх неудачи может подавлять творчество.
exampleUz: Muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan qo'rqish ijodkorlikka to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.
definitionEn: to prevent or slow down a process or action

exampleEn: The company is known for its innovative products.
exampleRu: Компания известна своими инновационными продуктами.
exampleUz: Kompaniya innovatsion mahsulotlari bilan mashhur.
definitionEn: introducing new ideas or methods

exampleEn: She remained aloof during the meeting.
exampleRu: Она держалась отстранённо на встрече.
exampleUz: U yig'ilishda o'zini olib qochdi.
definitionEn: not friendly or forthcoming; cool and distant

exampleEn: I feel ambivalent about moving to a new city.
exampleRu: Я испытываю противоречивые чувства насчёт переезда в новый город.
exampleUz: Yangi shaharga ko'chib o'tish haqida ikkilanuvchan his qilyapman.
definitionEn: having mixed or contradictory feelings about something

exampleEn: He has a cynical view of politics.
exampleRu: У него циничный взгляд на политику.
exampleUz: Uning siyosatga sinik qarashi bor.
definitionEn: believing that people are only motivated by self-interest

exampleEn: A discerning reader will notice the subtle irony.
exampleRu: Проницательный читатель заметит тонкую иронию.
exampleUz: Didli o'quvchi nozik kinoyani payqaydi.
definitionEn: having good judgment, especially about art or quality

exampleEn: The professor gave an enigmatic smile and said nothing more.
exampleRu: Профессор загадочно улыбнулся и больше ничего не сказал.
exampleUz: Professor sirli tabassum qilib, boshqa hech narsa demadi.
definitionEn: difficult to understand or interpret; mysterious

exampleEn: He is fastidious about keeping his desk perfectly organized.
exampleRu: Он дотошен в том, чтобы держать стол идеально организованным.
exampleUz: U stolini mukammal tartibda saqlashda juda talabchan.
definitionEn: very attentive to detail and hard to please

exampleEn: She's a gregarious person who loves meeting new people.
exampleRu: Она общительный человек, который любит знакомиться с новыми людьми.
exampleUz: U yangi odamlar bilan tanishishni yaxshi ko'radigan kirishimli inson.
definitionEn: fond of company; sociable

exampleEn: His impetuous decision cost him the job.
exampleRu: Его опрометчивое решение стоило ему работы.
exampleUz: Uning shoshqaloq qarori ish joyiga tushishiga sabab bo'ldi.
definitionEn: acting quickly without thinking carefully first

exampleEn: His laconic reply left everyone wondering what he really meant.
exampleRu: Его лаконичный ответ заставил всех гадать, что он на самом деле имел в виду.
exampleUz: Uning qisqa javobi hammani u nimani nazarda tutgani haqida o'ylantirib qo'ydi.
definitionEn: using very few words; brief and to the point

exampleEn: He remained obstinate despite everyone's advice.
exampleRu: Он оставался упрямым, несмотря на советы всех.
exampleUz: Hammaning maslahatiga qaramay, u qaysar bo'lib qoldi.
definitionEn: refusing to change one's opinion or behavior

exampleEn: Scientists noticed an anomaly in the data set.
exampleRu: Учёные заметили аномалию в наборе данных.
exampleUz: Olimlar ma'lumotlar to'plamida anomaliyani payqashdi.
definitionEn: something that is different from what is normal or expected

exampleEn: The new law acted as a catalyst for social change.
exampleRu: Новый закон стал катализатором социальных перемен.
exampleUz: Yangi qonun ijtimoiy o'zgarishlar uchun turtki bo'ldi.
definitionEn: something that causes an important change or event to happen

exampleEn: Reading regularly improves cognitive development in children.
exampleRu: Регулярное чтение улучшает когнитивное развитие детей.
exampleUz: Muntazam kitob o'qish bolalarning kognitiv rivojlanishini yaxshilaydi.
definitionEn: relating to the mental processes of thinking, knowing, and understanding

exampleEn: The minister met with her European counterparts.
exampleRu: Министр встретилась со своими европейскими коллегами.
exampleUz: Vazir o'zining yevropalik hamkasblari bilan uchrashdi.
definitionEn: a person or thing holding the same position or serving the same purpose as another

exampleEn: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
exampleRu: Между этими двумя отчётами есть расхождение.
exampleUz: Ikki hisobot o'rtasida nomuvofiqlik bor.
definitionEn: a difference between two things that should be the same

exampleEn: Medicine is a domain that requires years of study.
exampleRu: Медицина — это область, требующая многолетнего изучения.
exampleUz: Tibbiyot ko'p yillik o'qishni talab qiladigan soha.
definitionEn: an area of knowledge, activity, or interest

exampleEn: Let's consider a hypothetical situation for a moment.
exampleRu: Давайте на минуту рассмотрим гипотетическую ситуацию.
exampleUz: Keling, bir lahza faraziy vaziyatni ko'rib chiqaylik.
definitionEn: based on an idea or situation that is imagined, not necessarily real

exampleEn: The incidence of the disease has decreased in recent years.
exampleRu: Заболеваемость этой болезнью снизилась за последние годы.
exampleUz: So'nggi yillarda kasallikning uchrash darajasi pasaydi.
definitionEn: the number of times something, especially something bad, happens

exampleEn: There is an inherent risk in any investment.
exampleRu: В любых инвестициях есть неотъемлемый риск.
exampleUz: Har qanday investitsiyada tabiiy xavf mavjud.
definitionEn: existing as a natural or basic part of something

exampleEn: It's the norm to shake hands when meeting someone new.
exampleRu: Обычная практика — пожимать руку при знакомстве с кем-то новым.
exampleUz: Yangi odam bilan tanishganda qo'l siqishish odatiy holdir.
definitionEn: a situation or type of behavior that is usual, expected, or typical

exampleEn: He told a joke to break the ice at the meeting.
exampleRu: Он рассказал шутку, чтобы растопить лёд на встрече.
exampleUz: U yig'ilishda muzni eritish uchun latifa aytdi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to say or do something to make people feel more relaxed

exampleEn: You need to make up your mind before Friday.
exampleRu: Тебе нужно принять решение до пятницы.
exampleUz: Sen jumagacha qaror qabul qilishing kerak.
definitionEn: (idiom) to make a decision

exampleEn: We usually hang out at the park after school.
exampleRu: Мы обычно тусуемся в парке после школы.
exampleUz: Biz odatda maktabdan keyin parkda vaqt o'tkazamiz.
definitionEn: (idiom) to spend time relaxing or socializing with someone

exampleEn: You haven't tried sushi? Give it a try!
exampleRu: Ты не пробовал суши? Попробуй!
exampleUz: Sushi yemaganmisan? Sinab ko'r!
definitionEn: (idiom) to attempt something

exampleEn: How's the new job? So far so good!
exampleRu: Как новая работа? Пока всё хорошо!
exampleUz: Yangi ish qanday? Hozircha yaxshi!
definitionEn: (idiom) used to say that something has been successful up to now

exampleEn: We can go tonight or tomorrow — it's up to you.
exampleRu: Мы можем пойти сегодня или завтра — решать тебе.
exampleUz: Biz bugun yoki ertaga borishimiz mumkin — bu senga bog'liq.
definitionEn: (idiom) used to say that someone else must make the decision

exampleEn: Let's keep in touch after graduation.
exampleRu: Давай оставаться на связи после выпуска.
exampleUz: Bitirgandan keyin aloqada bo'laylik.
definitionEn: (idiom) to continue to communicate with someone

exampleEn: Speak of the devil, here comes Tom now!
exampleRu: Лёгок на помине, вот и Том идёт!
exampleUz: Gapirsang keladi, mana Tom ham keldi!
definitionEn: (idiom) said when a person you were just talking about appears

exampleEn: We go to the cinema once in a while.
exampleRu: Мы ходим в кино время от времени.
exampleUz: Biz vaqti-vaqti bilan kinoga boramiz.
definitionEn: (idiom) sometimes but not often

exampleEn: By the way, did you finish your homework?
exampleRu: Кстати, ты закончил домашнее задание?
exampleUz: Aytgancha, uy vazifangni tugatdingmi?
definitionEn: (idiom) used to introduce something extra you want to say

exampleEn: Sorry, I can't talk now, I'm in a hurry.
exampleRu: Извини, я не могу говорить сейчас, я спешу.
exampleUz: Kechirasiz, hozir gaplasha olmayman, shoshilyapman.
definitionEn: (idiom) needing or wanting to do something quickly

exampleEn: Don't worry about the mistake, it's no big deal.
exampleRu: Не переживай из-за ошибки, это пустяк.
exampleUz: Xato haqida xavotir olma, bu arzimaydi.
definitionEn: (idiom) used to say something is not important or serious

exampleEn: Let's meet at six. — Sounds good!
exampleRu: Давай встретимся в шесть. — Звучит хорошо!
exampleUz: Keling, olti soatda uchrashamiz. — Yaxshi eshitilyapti!
definitionEn: (idiom) used to agree that a plan or suggestion is good

exampleEn: My sister and I get along really well.
exampleRu: Мы с сестрой очень хорошо ладим.
exampleUz: Men va opam juda yaxshi til topishamiz.
definitionEn: (idiom) to have a friendly relationship with someone

exampleEn: She's always on the go, running from work to classes.
exampleRu: Она всегда в движении, бегает с работы на учёбу.
exampleUz: U doim harakatda, ishdan darsga yuguradi.
definitionEn: (idiom) very active and busy, moving from place to place

exampleEn: He moved to Canada for good.
exampleRu: Он переехал в Канаду навсегда.
exampleUz: U Kanadaga butunlay ko'chib ketdi.
definitionEn: (idiom) permanently; forever

exampleEn: The elevator is out of order today.
exampleRu: Сегодня лифт не работает.
exampleUz: Bugun lift ishlamayapti.
definitionEn: (idiom) not working properly, broken

exampleEn: It's getting late, we should hit the road.
exampleRu: Уже поздно, нам пора отправляться в путь.
exampleUz: Kech bo'lyapti, biz yo'lga tushishimiz kerak.
definitionEn: (idiom) to leave, to begin a journey

word: cost an arm and a leg
transcription: kɒst ən ɑːrm ənd ə leɡ
exampleEn: That new laptop cost an arm and a leg.
exampleRu: Этот новый ноутбук стоил очень дорого.
exampleUz: Bu yangi noutbuk juda qimmatga tushdi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to be extremely expensive

exampleEn: He visits his parents once in a blue moon.
exampleRu: Он навещает родителей очень редко.
exampleUz: U ota-onasini juda kamdan-kam ziyorat qiladi.
definitionEn: (idiom) very rarely

exampleEn: It took a while, but I finally got the hang of it.
exampleRu: Потребовалось время, но я наконец освоил это.
exampleUz: Vaqt ketdi, lekin oxiri men buni o'rganib oldim.
definitionEn: (idiom) to learn how to do something after practice

exampleEn: Let's make sure we're on the same page before the meeting.
exampleRu: Давайте убедимся, что мы одного мнения перед встречей.
exampleUz: Yig'ilishdan oldin bir fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilaylik.
definitionEn: (idiom) to have the same understanding or opinion as someone else

word: let the cat out of the bag
transcription: let ðə kæt aʊt əv ðə bæɡ
exampleEn: She let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.
exampleRu: Она проболталась о вечеринке-сюрпризе.
exampleUz: U syurpriz kechasi haqida sirni oshkor qilib qo'ydi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to accidentally reveal a secret

exampleEn: We've worked for eight hours, let's call it a day.
exampleRu: Мы работали восемь часов, давайте закончим на сегодня.
exampleUz: Biz sakkiz soat ishladik, bugungiga yakunlaylik.
definitionEn: (idiom) to decide to stop doing something, especially work

exampleEn: Good teachers always go the extra mile for their students.
exampleRu: Хорошие учителя всегда прилагают дополнительные усилия ради учеников.
exampleUz: Yaxshi o'qituvchilar har doim o'quvchilari uchun ortiqcha harakat qilishadi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to make more effort than is expected

exampleEn: The small company grew successfully, staying under the radar.
exampleRu: Маленькая компания успешно росла, оставаясь незаметной.
exampleUz: Kichik kompaniya e'tibordan chetda qolgan holda muvaffaqiyatli o'sdi.
definitionEn: (idiom) without being noticed

exampleEn: You should take it easy after being sick.
exampleRu: Тебе стоит не напрягаться после болезни.
exampleUz: Kasal bo'lgandan keyin o'zingni bosiq tutishing kerak.
definitionEn: (idiom) to relax and not do too much, or not to worry

exampleEn: The plan failed, so we're back to square one.
exampleRu: План провалился, так что мы вернулись к началу.
exampleUz: Reja muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ldi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
definitionEn: (idiom) back to the beginning, with no progress made

exampleEn: Let's cut to the chase — do you want the job or not?
exampleRu: Давайте перейдём к делу — ты хочешь эту работу или нет?
exampleUz: Gapning po'stmomasini aytamiz — ishni xohlaysanmi yoki yo'q?
definitionEn: (idiom) to get to the point without wasting time

word: the ball is in your court
transcription: ðə bɔːl ɪz ɪn jɔːr kɔːrt
exampleEn: I've done all I can — the ball is in your court now.
exampleRu: Я сделал всё, что мог — теперь решение за тобой.
exampleUz: Men qo'limdan kelganini qildim — endi navbat sizda.
definitionEn: (idiom) it is up to you to make the next decision or step

exampleEn: Pull yourself together, we have work to do.
exampleRu: Возьми себя в руки, у нас есть работа.
exampleUz: O'zingni qo'lga ol, bizda ish bor.
definitionEn: (idiom) to become calm after being upset

exampleEn: Come on, it's not rocket science — just follow the instructions.
exampleRu: Да ладно, это не так уж сложно — просто следуй инструкции.
exampleUz: Qo'ysangchi, bu unchalik qiyin emas — shunchaki ko'rsatmaga amal qil.
definitionEn: (idiom) used to say something is not difficult to understand

word: bite off more than you can chew
transcription: baɪt ɒf mɔːr ðæn juː kæn tʃuː
exampleEn: Taking three jobs at once, he bit off more than he could chew.
exampleRu: Взяв сразу три работы, он взялся за непосильное дело.
exampleUz: Bir vaqtning o'zida uchta ishni olib, u kuchidan ortiq ish qildi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to try to do more than you are able to

exampleEn: I'll keep my fingers crossed for your interview tomorrow.
exampleRu: Я буду держать кулачки за твоё завтрашнее собеседование.
exampleUz: Ertangi suhbating uchun senga omad tilab turaman.
definitionEn: (idiom) to hope that something will happen successfully

exampleEn: She burned the midnight oil to finish her thesis.
exampleRu: Она работала допоздна, чтобы закончить диссертацию.
exampleUz: U dissertatsiyasini tugatish uchun tunni kunduzga ulab ishladi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to work or study late into the night

exampleEn: Many brands jumped on the bandwagon of eco-friendly packaging.
exampleRu: Многие бренды присоединились к тренду экологичной упаковки.
exampleUz: Ko'plab brendlar ekologik qadoqlash trendiga qo'shilishdi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to join others in doing something popular or fashionable

exampleEn: After three failed attempts, he threw in the towel.
exampleRu: После трёх неудачных попыток он сдался.
exampleUz: Uch marta muvaffaqiyatsiz urinishdan keyin u taslim bo'ldi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to admit defeat; to give up

exampleEn: If you read between the lines, you can see she's unhappy.
exampleRu: Если читать между строк, видно, что она несчастна.
exampleUz: Satrlar orasini o'qisangiz, uning baxtsiz ekanini ko'rasiz.
definitionEn: (idiom) to understand a hidden meaning that is not directly stated

exampleEn: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise — I found a better one.
exampleRu: Потеря той работы оказалась скрытым благом — я нашёл лучшую.
exampleUz: O'sha ishni yo'qotish yashirin ne'mat bo'ldi — men yaxshirog'ini topdim.
definitionEn: (idiom) something that seems bad at first but turns out to be good

exampleEn: No one wanted to mention the elephant in the room during the meeting.
exampleRu: Никто не хотел упоминать очевидную проблему во время встречи.
exampleUz: Yig'ilish davomida hech kim hammaga ayon bo'lgan muammoni tilga olishni xohlamadi.
definitionEn: (idiom) an obvious problem that people avoid discussing

exampleEn: Let's get the ball rolling on the new project.
exampleRu: Давайте сдвинем новый проект с места.
exampleUz: Keling, yangi loyihani boshlab yuboraylik.
definitionEn: (idiom) to start something, especially a project or process

exampleEn: The director loves to push the envelope with unusual film techniques.
exampleRu: Режиссёр любит выходить за рамки привычного с необычными приёмами съёмки.
exampleUz: Rejissyor g'ayrioddiy suratga olish usullari bilan chegaralarni kengaytirishni yoqtiradi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to attempt something new or extreme, beyond normal limits

exampleEn: My brother and I don't always see eye to eye on politics.
exampleRu: Мы с братом не всегда сходимся во мнениях по политике.
exampleUz: Men va akam siyosat masalasida har doim ham bir fikrda bo'lavermaymiz.
definitionEn: (idiom) to agree with someone

exampleEn: The startup went down in flames after just one year.
exampleRu: Стартап полностью провалился всего через год.
exampleUz: Startap atigi bir yildan so'ng to'liq muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to fail suddenly and completely

word: hit the nail on the head
transcription: hɪt ðə neɪl ɒn ðə hed
exampleEn: You hit the nail on the head with that comment.
exampleRu: Ты попал в точку этим замечанием.
exampleUz: Bu izohing bilan naq o'ziga tegib turibdi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to describe exactly what is causing a situation or problem

exampleEn: He announced the engagement early and stole her thunder.
exampleRu: Он объявил о помолвке раньше и присвоил её момент славы.
exampleUz: U unashtiruvni erta e'lon qilib, uning shuhrat lahzasini o'zlashtirdi.
synonyms: take credit that belongs to another
definitionEn: (idiom) to take attention or praise away from someone by doing what they planned first

exampleEn: His sarcastic comment just added fuel to the fire.
exampleRu: Его саркастическое замечание только подлило масла в огонь.
exampleUz: Uning kinoyali izohi olovga yog' quygandek bo'ldi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to make an argument or bad situation worse

exampleEn: Everyone agreed, so I didn't want to rock the boat.
