exampleRu: Все были согласны, поэтому я не хотел нарушать спокойствие.
exampleUz: Hammaning fikri bir edi, shuning uchun men vaziyatni izdan chiqarishni xohlamadim.
synonyms: cause trouble, disturb the status quo
definitionEn: (idiom) to do something that upsets a stable situation

exampleEn: I tried to remember his name, but I drew a blank.
exampleRu: Я пытался вспомнить его имя, но не смог.
exampleUz: Uning ismini eslashga harakat qildim, lekin hech narsa esimga tushmadi.
definitionEn: (idiom) to be unable to remember or find something

exampleEn: I'll play devil's advocate — what if the plan fails?
exampleRu: Позволь мне поспорить: а что, если план провалится?
exampleUz: Qarama-qarshi fikr bildiraman — agar reja muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa-chi?
definitionEn: (idiom) to argue against an idea, not because you disagree, but to test it

exampleEn: These complaints are just the tip of the iceberg.
exampleRu: Эти жалобы — лишь верхушка айсберга.
exampleUz: Bu shikoyatlar faqat muzko'hning uchi, xolos.
synonyms: a small visible part of a bigger problem
definitionEn: (idiom) a small, visible part of a much larger problem

exampleEn: I wanna go to the beach this weekend.
exampleRu: Я хочу поехать на пляж в эти выходные.
exampleUz: Men bu dam olish kunlari plyajga bormoqchiman.
definitionEn: (informal, spoken) short way of saying 'want to'

exampleEn: I gotta go now, see you later!
exampleRu: Мне пора идти, увидимся!
exampleUz: Menga hozir ketishim kerak, ko'rishguncha!
definitionEn: (informal, spoken) short way of saying 'got to' or 'have to'

exampleEn: I'm kinda tired today.
exampleRu: Я вроде как устал сегодня.
exampleUz: Bugun bir oz charchaganman.
definitionEn: (informal) somewhat; kind of

exampleEn: Hey, sup? Haven't seen you in a while!
exampleRu: Привет, как дела? Давно не виделись!
exampleUz: Salom, qalesan? Ancha bo'ldi ko'rishmaganimizga!
definitionEn: (informal) a casual greeting, short for "what's up"

exampleEn: Are you coming tonight? — Yep, I'll be there.
exampleRu: Ты придёшь сегодня вечером? — Ага, буду.
exampleUz: Bugun kechqurun kelasanmi? — Ha, boraman.
definitionEn: (informal) an informal way of saying "yes"

exampleEn: Do you want more coffee? — Nope, I'm good.
exampleRu: Хочешь ещё кофе? — Не-а, мне достаточно.
exampleUz: Ko'proq kofe xohlaysizmi? — Yo'q, yetarli.
definitionEn: (informal) an informal way of saying "no"

exampleEn: Dude, you have to see this video!
exampleRu: Чувак, тебе надо посмотреть это видео!
exampleUz: O'rtoq, bu videoni ko'rishing kerak!
definitionEn: (informal) a casual word for a man, or used to address a friend

exampleEn: He's been my buddy since elementary school.
exampleRu: Он мой приятель с начальной школы.
exampleUz: U boshlang'ich sinfdan beri mening o'rtog'im.
definitionEn: (informal) a close friend

exampleEn: Let's take a selfie in front of the tower.
exampleRu: Давай сделаем селфи перед башней.
exampleUz: Keling, minora oldida selfi olamiz.
definitionEn: (informal) a photograph you take of yourself, usually with a phone

exampleEn: Lol, that meme is hilarious!
exampleRu: Ахах, этот мем очень смешной!
exampleUz: Hoy-hoy, bu mem juda kulguli!
definitionEn: (informal, texting) abbreviation for "laughing out loud"

exampleEn: Omg, I can't believe you got the job!
exampleRu: О боже, не могу поверить, что ты получил эту работу!
exampleUz: Voy xudoyim, ishga qabul qilinganingga ishonolmayapman!
definitionEn: (informal, texting) abbreviation for "oh my god", used to show surprise

exampleEn: Me and my bestie do everything together.
exampleRu: Мы с лучшей подругой делаем всё вместе.
exampleUz: Men va eng yaqin do'stim hamma narsani birga qilamiz.
definitionEn: (informal) a person's best friend

exampleEn: That movie was totally amazing!
exampleRu: Этот фильм был просто потрясающим!
exampleUz: Bu film mutlaqo ajoyib edi!
definitionEn: (informal) used to emphasize agreement or strong feeling

exampleEn: You won the lottery? For real?
exampleRu: Ты выиграл в лотерею? Серьёзно?
exampleUz: Lotoreyada yutdingmi? Haqiqatanmi?
definitionEn: (informal) used to ask if something is true, or to emphasize it is true

exampleEn: I bought the expensive ticket — yolo!
exampleRu: Я купил дорогой билет — живём один раз!
exampleUz: Qimmat chipta sotib oldim — faqat bir marta yashaymiz-ku!
definitionEn: (informal) used to justify a risky or fun decision

exampleEn: Sorry for snapping at you, I was just hangry.
exampleRu: Извини, что накричал, я был просто злой от голода.
exampleUz: Kechir, baqirganim uchun, shunchaki och bo'lib jahlim chiqqan edi.
definitionEn: (informal) irritable or bad-tempered because you are hungry

exampleEn: We binged the whole series in one weekend.
exampleRu: Мы посмотрели весь сериал за один уикенд без остановки.
exampleUz: Biz butun serialni bir hafta oxirida to'xtovsiz tomosha qildik.
definitionEn: (informal) to do an activity, especially watching TV or eating, to excess

exampleEn: That guy acting sus near the car looks suspicious.
exampleRu: Тот парень, ведущий себя подозрительно возле машины, выглядит подозрительно.
exampleUz: Mashina yonida shubhali harakat qilayotgan o'sha yigit shubhali ko'rinadi.
definitionEn: (informal) short for "suspicious"; seeming dishonest or wrong

exampleEn: He's always flexing his new car on social media.
exampleRu: Он постоянно хвастается своей новой машиной в соцсетях.
exampleUz: U ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda doim yangi mashinasini ko'z-ko'z qiladi.
definitionEn: (informal) to show off something, like money or possessions

exampleEn: That comeback was absolutely savage!
exampleRu: Этот ответ был просто беспощадным!
exampleUz: Bu javob mutlaqo shafqatsiz edi!
definitionEn: (informal) impressively harsh, blunt, or fierce

exampleEn: I cringe every time I watch my old videos.
exampleRu: Мне становится неловко каждый раз, когда я смотрю свои старые видео.
exampleUz: Eski videolarimni ko'rganimda har safar noqulay bo'laman.
definitionEn: (informal) to feel embarrassed or awkward, or something that causes that feeling

exampleEn: Stop being a simp and just tell her how you feel.
exampleRu: Хватит стараться угодить, просто скажи ей, что чувствуешь.
exampleUz: Haddan tashqari xizmat qilishni bas qil va unga his-tuyg'ularingni ayt.
definitionEn: (informal) someone who does too much to please a person they like

exampleEn: Wearing a suit to a picnic is a bit extra, don't you think?
exampleRu: Надевать костюм на пикник — это немного чересчур, тебе не кажется?
exampleUz: Piknikga kostyum kiyish biroz ortiqcha emasmi?
definitionEn: (informal) excessive or overly dramatic

exampleEn: Rainy days and coffee — that's a mood.
exampleRu: Дождливые дни и кофе — это прямо про меня.
exampleUz: Yomg'irli kunlar va kofe — bu aynan mening holatim.
definitionEn: (informal) used to say something is very relatable

exampleEn: Thanks for the support, fam!
exampleRu: Спасибо за поддержку, свои!
exampleUz: Yordamingiz uchun rahmat, do'stlar!
definitionEn: (informal) close friends treated like family

exampleEn: She slayed that performance on stage.
exampleRu: Она потрясающе выступила на сцене.
exampleUz: U sahnada ajoyib chiqish qildi.
definitionEn: (informal) to do something extremely well or look amazing

exampleEn: The concert last night was lit!
exampleRu: Вчерашний концерт был просто огонь!
exampleUz: Kechagi kontsert juda zo'r edi!
definitionEn: (informal) exciting or excellent, especially about a party or event

exampleEn: Pumpkin spice lattes are so basic in the fall.
exampleRu: Латте с тыквенными специями — это так банально осенью.
exampleUz: Kuzda qovoq maxsulotli lattelar juda oddiy hisoblanadi.
definitionEn: (informal) unoriginal, following predictable trends

exampleEn: She threw some serious shade at her ex online.
exampleRu: Она сильно съязвила в адрес бывшего в сети.
exampleUz: U onlaynda sobiq yigitiga jiddiy kinoya qildi.
definitionEn: (informal) a subtle, indirect insult or criticism

exampleEn: He has a lot of clout on social media.
exampleRu: У него большое влияние в соцсетях.
exampleUz: Uning ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda katta nufuzi bor.
definitionEn: (informal) influence or power, especially in social or media circles

exampleEn: The brand tried to seem woke with its new ad campaign.
exampleRu: Бренд попытался выглядеть социально осознанным в новой рекламной кампании.
exampleUz: Brend yangi reklama kampaniyasida ijtimoiy jihatdan xabardor ko'rinishga harakat qildi.
definitionEn: (informal) aware of and concerned about social justice issues

exampleEn: He kept liking all her photos — a bit thirsty, honestly.
exampleRu: Он лайкал все её фото — если честно, немного отчаянно.
exampleUz: U uning barcha suratlarini layk qilaverdi — rostini aytsam, biroz haddan tashqari.
definitionEn: (informal) showing an obvious, desperate desire for attention

exampleEn: Nice drip, where did you get those sneakers?
exampleRu: Крутой стиль, где ты взял эти кроссовки?
exampleUz: Zo'r uslub, bu krossovkalarni qayerdan olding?
definitionEn: (informal) an impressive or stylish set of clothes

exampleEn: He just ghosted me after our third date.
exampleRu: Он просто перестал отвечать после нашего третьего свидания.
exampleUz: U uchinchi uchrashuvimizdan keyin to'satdan aloqani uzib qo'ydi.
definitionEn: (informal) to suddenly stop all communication with someone without explanation

exampleEn: Paying bills and cooking dinner — adulting is hard.
exampleRu: Оплата счетов и готовка ужина — взрослая жизнь тяжела.
exampleUz: Hisob-kitoblarni to'lash va kechki ovqat tayyorlash — kattalarcha hayot qiyin ekan.
definitionEn: (informal) the act of behaving like a responsible adult, doing ordinary tasks

exampleEn: I get serious FOMO when I see my friends' vacation photos.
exampleRu: У меня возникает сильный страх упустить что-то, когда я вижу фото друзей с отдыха.
exampleUz: Do'stlarimning dam olish suratlarini ko'rganimda kuchli FOMO paydo bo'ladi.
definitionEn: (informal) anxiety that something exciting is happening elsewhere without you

exampleEn: She sells handmade jewelry as a side hustle.
exampleRu: Она продаёт украшения ручной работы в качестве подработки.
exampleUz: U qo'shimcha daromad sifatida qo'lda yasalgan taqinchoqlar sotadi.
definitionEn: (informal) a job or business someone does in addition to their main job

exampleEn: That restaurant is a bit too bougie for my budget.
exampleRu: Этот ресторан слишком понтовый для моего бюджета.
exampleUz: Bu restoran mening byudjetim uchun biroz dabdabali.
definitionEn: (informal) trying to appear fancy or upper-class

exampleEn: She had a huge glow up since high school.
exampleRu: Она сильно преобразилась со времён школы.
exampleUz: U maktabni tugatgandan beri katta o'zgarishga uchradi.
definitionEn: (informal) a noticeable improvement in someone's appearance or confidence

translation: оторваться от экрана, выйти на улицу
exampleEn: You've been gaming all week — go touch grass!
exampleRu: Ты играл всю неделю — иди прогуляйся на улице!
exampleUz: Butun hafta o'yin o'ynading — borib tashqarida yur!
synonyms: go outside, take a break from screens
definitionEn: (informal) used to tell someone to go outside instead of staying online

exampleEn: Coffee at the beach just hits different.
exampleRu: Кофе на пляже воспринимается совсем иначе.
exampleUz: Plyajdagi kofe butunlay boshqacha ta'sir qiladi.
definitionEn: (informal) used to say something feels especially good or unique in a situation

exampleEn: He has so much rizz, he can talk to anyone.
exampleRu: У него столько обаяния, он может разговорить кого угодно.
exampleUz: Uning jozibasi shu qadar kuchliki, u har kim bilan gaplasha oladi.
definitionEn: (informal) charm or skill in attracting a romantic partner

exampleEn: Thinking he'll answer at 3 a.m. is a bit delulu.
exampleRu: Думать, что он ответит в 3 ночи — это немного нереалистично.
exampleUz: Soat uchda javob berishini kutish biroz xayolparastlik.
definitionEn: (informal) unrealistic or delusional, usually used jokingly

translation: уверенность в себе, будто ты главный герой
exampleEn: She walked into the party with total main character energy.
exampleRu: Она вошла на вечеринку с полной уверенностью главной героини.
exampleUz: U ziyofatga xuddi bosh qahramondek ishonch bilan kirib keldi.
definitionEn: (informal) a confident attitude as if you are the star of your own story

exampleEn: This outfit is giving 90s vibes.
exampleRu: Этот образ напоминает атмосферу 90-х.
exampleUz: Bu kiyim 90-yillar uslubini eslatyapti.
synonyms: reminds me of, gives the impression of
definitionEn: (informal) used to describe the vibe or impression something creates

exampleEn: The way he chewed loudly gave her the ick.
exampleRu: То, как он громко жевал, вызвало у неё отвращение.
exampleUz: Uning ovoz chiqarib chaynashi unga jirkanish hissini uyg'otdi.
definitionEn: (informal) a sudden feeling of being turned off or repulsed by someone

exampleEn: He just repeats what everyone else says, like an npc.
exampleRu: Он просто повторяет то, что говорят все, как безликий персонаж.
exampleUz: U hammaning aytganini takrorlayveradi, xuddi o'ylamaydigan personajdek.
definitionEn: (informal, from video games) used jokingly to describe someone acting robotic or unoriginal

exampleEn: Honestly, the new movie was kind of mid.
exampleRu: Честно говоря, новый фильм был так себе.
exampleUz: Rostini aytsam, yangi film unchalik emas edi.
definitionEn: (informal) mediocre; neither good nor bad

exampleEn: That's such a based opinion, I respect it.
exampleRu: Это такое смелое и честное мнение, я его уважаю.
exampleUz: Bu juda dadil fikr, men buni hurmat qilaman.
definitionEn: (informal) approving of someone for confidently expressing their true opinion

exampleEn: That's cap, I know you weren't at home.
exampleRu: Это вранье, я знаю, что тебя не было дома.
exampleUz: Bu yolg'on, uyda bo'lmaganingni bilaman.
definitionEn: (informal) a lie or an exaggeration; "no cap" means "no lie, for real"

exampleEn: Before the meeting, let's do a quick vibe check.
exampleRu: Перед встречей давайте быстро проверим настрой.
exampleUz: Uchrashuvdan oldin tezda kayfiyatni tekshirib olaylik.
definitionEn: (informal) an informal check of someone's mood or attitude

exampleEn: The plan worked, albeit slowly.
exampleRu: План сработал, хотя и медленно.
exampleUz: Reja ishladi, garchi sekin bo'lsa-da.
definitionEn: although; used to introduce a fact that slightly changes what has just been said

exampleEn: It seems counterintuitive, but working less can increase productivity.
exampleRu: Это кажется нелогичным, но меньше работать может повысить продуктивность.
exampleUz: Bu g'ayrioddiy tuyuladi, lekin kamroq ishlash samaradorlikni oshirishi mumkin.
definitionEn: contrary to what intuition or common sense would suggest

exampleEn: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
exampleRu: Между двумя отчётами есть расхождение.
exampleUz: Ikki hisobot o'rtasida nomuvofiqlik bor.
definitionEn: a difference between two things that should be the same

exampleEn: The researchers tested their hypothesis with a large sample.
exampleRu: Исследователи проверили свою гипотезу на большой выборке.
exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar o'z gipotezasini katta namunada sinab ko'rdilar.
definitionEn: an idea or explanation that is proposed and then tested by further study

exampleEn: Some economists say a recession is now inevitable.
exampleRu: Некоторые экономисты говорят, что рецессия теперь неизбежна.
exampleUz: Ba'zi iqtisodchilar retsessiya endi muqarrar deyishmoqda.
definitionEn: certain to happen and impossible to avoid

exampleEn: The new policy aims to mitigate the effects of climate change.
exampleRu: Новая политика направлена на смягчение последствий изменения климата.
exampleUz: Yangi siyosat iqlim o'zgarishi ta'sirini kamaytirishga qaratilgan.
definitionEn: to make something less severe or serious

exampleEn: Notwithstanding the risks, the company decided to expand.
exampleRu: Несмотря на риски, компания решила расширяться.
exampleUz: Xavflarga qaramasdan, kompaniya kengayishga qaror qildi.
definitionEn: in spite of; without being affected by

exampleEn: It's a paradox that richer countries often waste more food.
exampleRu: Это парадокс, что более богатые страны часто выбрасывают больше еды.
exampleUz: Boy davlatlarning ko'proq oziq-ovqat isrof qilishi bir paradoksdir.
definitionEn: a situation that seems contradictory but may contain a truth

exampleEn: Trust underpins every successful relationship.
exampleRu: Доверие лежит в основе любых успешных отношений.
exampleUz: Ishonch har qanday muvaffaqiyatli munosabatning asosini tashkil qiladi.
definitionEn: to form the basis or foundation of a system, argument, or theory

translation: тогда как, в то время как
exampleEn: Some students prefer group work, whereas others work best alone.
exampleRu: Одни студенты предпочитают групповую работу, тогда как другие лучше работают в одиночку.
exampleUz: Ba'zi talabalar guruh bo'lib ishlashni afzal ko'radi, holbuki boshqalari yolg'iz ishlaganda yaxshiroq natija beradi.
definitionEn: used to compare or contrast two facts

exampleEn: The school takes a holistic approach to education.
exampleRu: Школа применяет целостный подход к образованию.
exampleUz: Maktab ta'limga yaxlit yondashuvni qo'llaydi.
definitionEn: considering the whole of something rather than just its parts

exampleEn: The issue has polarized public opinion.
exampleRu: Этот вопрос разделил общественное мнение на два лагеря.
exampleUz: Bu masala jamoatchilik fikrini ikkiga bo'lib yubordi.
definitionEn: to cause people to divide into two sharply opposing groups

exampleEn: The pandemic caused unprecedented disruption to global trade.
exampleRu: Пандемия вызвала беспрецедентные нарушения в мировой торговле.
exampleUz: Pandemiya jahon savdosida misli ko'rilmagan izdan chiqishga sabab bo'ldi.
definitionEn: never having happened or existed before

exampleEn: Solar power is now a viable alternative to fossil fuels.
exampleRu: Солнечная энергия теперь является жизнеспособной альтернативой ископаемому топливу.
exampleUz: Quyosh energiyasi endi fosil yoqilg'iga amalga oshiriladigan muqobil hisoblanadi.
definitionEn: capable of working successfully; practical

exampleEn: This is arguably the best solution available.
exampleRu: Это, по всей видимости, лучшее из доступных решений.
exampleUz: Bu, ehtimol, mavjud eng yaxshi yechimdir.
definitionEn: used to say that a statement can be supported, even if not everyone agrees

exampleEn: She gave a candid answer about her weaknesses.
exampleRu: Она откровенно ответила о своих слабых сторонах.
exampleUz: U o'z kamchiliklari haqida ochiqchasiga javob berdi.
definitionEn: truthful and straightforward; not hiding one's thoughts

exampleEn: He gave an eloquent speech at the graduation ceremony.
exampleRu: Он произнёс красноречивую речь на выпускной церемонии.
exampleUz: U bitiruv marosimida chiroyli notiqlik bilan nutq so'zladi.
definitionEn: fluent and persuasive in speaking or writing

exampleEn: Her spontaneous answer impressed the examiner.
exampleRu: Её спонтанный ответ впечатлил экзаменатора.
exampleUz: Uning to'satdan bergan javobi imtihonchini hayratda qoldirdi.
definitionEn: performed without planning, in a natural and unrehearsed way

exampleEn: She is very articulate when discussing complex ideas.
exampleRu: Она очень чётко излагает мысли, обсуждая сложные идеи.
exampleUz: U murakkab g'oyalarni muhokama qilishda juda aniq fikr bildiradi.
definitionEn: able to express ideas and feelings clearly and effectively

exampleEn: Try to be tactful when giving feedback to classmates.
exampleRu: Старайся быть тактичным, давая отзывы одноклассникам.
exampleUz: Sinfdoshlaringizga fikr bildirganda muloyim bo'lishga harakat qiling.
definitionEn: careful not to say or do anything that could upset other people

exampleEn: He was reluctant to share his opinion in front of the group.
exampleRu: Он неохотно делился своим мнением перед группой.
exampleUz: U guruh oldida o'z fikrini bildirishni istamadi.
definitionEn: unwilling and hesitant; not wanting to do something

exampleEn: He made a persuasive case for changing the policy.
exampleRu: Он привёл убедительные доводы в пользу изменения политики.
exampleUz: U siyosatni o'zgartirish foydasiga ishontiruvchi dalillar keltirdi.
definitionEn: good at making people believe or agree with something

exampleEn: It's important to empathize with people from different backgrounds.
exampleRu: Важно сопереживать людям из разных культур.
exampleUz: Turli madaniyat vakillariga hamdard bo'lish muhim.
definitionEn: to understand and share the feelings of another person

exampleEn: Could you elaborate on your last point?
exampleRu: Не могли бы вы подробнее объяснить свою последнюю мысль?
exampleUz: Oxirgi fikringizni batafsilroq tushuntirib bera olasizmi?
definitionEn: to explain something in greater detail

exampleEn: Sorry to digress, but this reminds me of something important.
exampleRu: Извините, что отклоняюсь от темы, но это напоминает мне о важном.
exampleUz: Mavzudan chetga chiqqanim uchun uzr, lekin bu menga muhim narsani eslatdi.
definitionEn: to move away from the main topic in speaking or writing

exampleEn: She shared a funny anecdote about her first job.
exampleRu: Она поделилась забавным случаем из своей первой работы.
exampleUz: U birinchi ishi haqida qiziqarli voqeani so'zlab berdi.
definitionEn: a short, interesting or amusing story about a real incident or person

exampleEn: A good teacher builds rapport with students quickly.
exampleRu: Хороший учитель быстро выстраивает контакт с учениками.
exampleUz: Yaxshi o'qituvchi o'quvchilar bilan tezda aloqa o'rnatadi.
definitionEn: a close and harmonious relationship in which people understand each other well

exampleEn: Can you paraphrase the question if you don't understand it?
exampleRu: Можете ли вы перефразировать вопрос, если не понимаете его?
exampleUz: Savolni tushunmasangiz, uni boshqacha so'z bilan qayta ayta olasizmi?
definitionEn: to express the meaning of something using different words

exampleEn: The city is investing in sustainable transport options.
exampleRu: Город инвестирует в устойчивые виды транспорта.
exampleUz: Shahar barqaror transport turlariga sarmoya kiritmoqda.
definitionEn: able to continue over time without harming the environment or running out

exampleEn: Rapid urbanization has put pressure on housing prices.
exampleRu: Быстрая урбанизация повысила давление на цены на жильё.
exampleUz: Jadal urbanizatsiya uy-joy narxlariga bosim o'tkazmoqda.
definitionEn: the process by which more people move to live in cities

exampleEn: Globalization has changed the way businesses operate.
exampleRu: Глобализация изменила то, как работают компании.
exampleUz: Globallashuv kompaniyalarning ishlash tarzini o'zgartirdi.
definitionEn: the process by which businesses and cultures become connected worldwide

exampleEn: The new law has proved highly controversial.
exampleRu: Новый закон оказался весьма спорным.
exampleUz: Yangi qonun juda munozarali bo'lib chiqdi.
definitionEn: causing strong disagreement or discussion

exampleEn: Museums must verify the authenticity of every artefact.
exampleRu: Музеи должны проверять подлинность каждого экспоната.
exampleUz: Muzeylar har bir eksponatning haqiqiyligini tekshirishi kerak.
definitionEn: the quality of being genuine or real

exampleEn: The country aims to run entirely on renewable energy by 2040.
exampleRu: Страна планирует полностью перейти на возобновляемую энергию к 2040 году.
exampleUz: Mamlakat 2040-yilga kelib to'liq qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga o'tishni maqsad qilgan.
definitionEn: able to be replaced naturally and not permanently used up

exampleEn: Income inequality has widened in many developed nations.
exampleRu: Неравенство доходов усилилось во многих развитых странах.
exampleUz: Daromad tengsizligi ko'plab rivojlangan davlatlarda kuchaydi.
definitionEn: the unfair difference between groups in society in terms of wealth or opportunity

exampleEn: The government is investing heavily in road infrastructure.
exampleRu: Правительство активно инвестирует в дорожную инфраструктуру.
exampleUz: Hukumat yo'l infratuzilmasiga katta sarmoya kiritmoqda.
definitionEn: the basic physical systems of a country, such as roads and power supplies

exampleEn: The school recently updated its science curriculum.
exampleRu: Школа недавно обновила программу по естественным наукам.
exampleUz: Maktab yaqinda tabiiy fanlar bo'yicha o'quv dasturini yangiladi.
definitionEn: the subjects that make up a course of study in a school or college

exampleEn: The city has a diverse population from many countries.
exampleRu: В городе разнообразное население из многих стран.
exampleUz: Shaharda ko'plab davlatlardan kelgan xilma-xil aholi yashaydi.
definitionEn: showing a great deal of variety; very different from one another

exampleEn: New legislation was passed to reduce plastic waste.
exampleRu: Было принято новое законодательство для сокращения пластиковых отходов.
exampleUz: Plastik chiqindilarni kamaytirish uchun yangi qonunchilik qabul qilindi.
definitionEn: a law or set of laws made by a government

exampleEn: Innovation in medicine has saved millions of lives.
exampleRu: Инновации в медицине спасли миллионы жизней.
exampleUz: Tibbiyotdagi innovatsiyalar millionlab hayotni saqlab qoldi.
definitionEn: a new idea, method, or product

exampleEn: The country reduced its dependency on imported oil.
exampleRu: Страна снизила свою зависимость от импортной нефти.
exampleUz: Mamlakat import qilinadigan neftga bog'liqligini kamaytirdi.
definitionEn: the state of relying on something or someone

exampleEn: The community showed great resilience after the flood.
exampleRu: Община проявила большую стойкость после наводнения.
exampleUz: Jamoat suv toshqinidan keyin katta bardoshlilik ko'rsatdi.
definitionEn: the ability to recover quickly from difficulties

exampleEn: Students value having some autonomy over their study schedule.
exampleRu: Студенты ценят некоторую самостоятельность в планировании учёбы.
exampleUz: Talabalar o'z o'qish jadvalida biroz mustaqillikka ega bo'lishni qadrlashadi.
definitionEn: the ability to make one's own decisions without outside control

exampleEn: I feel ambivalent about moving to a new city.
exampleRu: Я испытываю противоречивые чувства насчёт переезда в новый город.
exampleUz: Yangi shaharga ko'chib o'tish haqida ikkilanib turibman.
definitionEn: having mixed feelings or contradictory ideas about something

exampleEn: Many listeners remained skeptical about his explanation.
exampleRu: Многие слушатели оставались скептически настроены по поводу его объяснения.
exampleUz: Ko'p tinglovchilar uning tushuntirishiga shubha bilan qarashda davom etdi.
definitionEn: having doubts about whether a claim or idea is true

exampleEn: The instructions were ambiguous, so students interpreted them differently.
exampleRu: Инструкции были двусмысленными, поэтому студенты поняли их по-разному.
exampleUz: Ko'rsatmalar ikki ma'noli edi, shu sababli talabalar ularni har xil tushunishdi.
definitionEn: open to more than one interpretation; not clear or precise

exampleEn: A good essay makes its point in a concise way.
exampleRu: Хорошее эссе излагает мысль кратко.
exampleUz: Yaxshi esse fikrini ixcham tarzda bildiradi.
definitionEn: giving information clearly and in few words

exampleEn: A skilled writer captures the nuance of every character's voice.
exampleRu: Умелый писатель улавливает нюансы голоса каждого персонажа.
exampleUz: Mohir yozuvchi har bir personajning ovozidagi nozik farqlarni ushlab oladi.
definitionEn: a subtle difference in meaning, expression, or feeling

exampleEn: Remove any redundant words to tighten your essay.
exampleRu: Уберите все лишние слова, чтобы сделать эссе более сжатым.
exampleUz: Essangizni ixchamlashtirish uchun barcha ortiqcha so'zlarni olib tashlang.
definitionEn: not needed or useful; more than necessary

exampleEn: The candidate's rhetoric appealed strongly to young voters.
exampleRu: Риторика кандидата сильно привлекла молодых избирателей.
exampleUz: Nomzodning notiqlik mahorati yosh saylovchilarga kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
definitionEn: language designed to persuade or influence others

exampleEn: Her succinct answer left no room for confusion.
exampleRu: Её лаконичный ответ не оставил места для путаницы.
exampleUz: Uning lo'nda javobi hech qanday chalkashlikka o'rin qoldirmadi.
definitionEn: expressed clearly and in a few words

exampleEn: You must substantiate your claim with solid evidence.
exampleRu: Вы должны подтвердить своё утверждение убедительными доказательствами.
exampleUz: Siz o'z da'vongizni ishonchli dalillar bilan isbotlashingiz kerak.
definitionEn: to provide evidence to support a claim or statement

exampleEn: The essay synthesizes ideas from three different sources.
exampleRu: Эссе объединяет идеи из трёх разных источников.
exampleUz: Esse uchta turli manbadagi g'oyalarni birlashtiradi.
definitionEn: to combine separate ideas or elements to form a coherent whole

exampleEn: Use a clear transition between your second and third paragraphs.
exampleRu: Используйте чёткий переход между вторым и третьим абзацами.
exampleUz: Ikkinchi va uchinchi paragraflar orasida aniq o'tishdan foydalaning.
definitionEn: a word or phrase that connects ideas and shows how they relate

exampleEn: One weak paragraph can undermine an otherwise strong essay.
exampleRu: Один слабый абзац может подорвать в остальном сильное эссе.
exampleUz: Bitta zaif paragraf boshqa jihatdan kuchli essening ta'sirini zaiflashtirishi mumkin.
definitionEn: to gradually weaken something or make it less effective

exampleEn: The instructions were unnecessarily verbose.
exampleRu: Инструкции были излишне многословными.
exampleUz: Ko'rsatmalar keraksiz darajada cho'zilgan edi.
definitionEn: using more words than needed; overly wordy

exampleEn: A cohesive essay connects each paragraph to a central argument.
exampleRu: Связное эссе соединяет каждый абзац с центральным аргументом.
exampleUz: Izchil esse har bir paragrafni asosiy fikr bilan bog'laydi.
definitionEn: forming a unified whole; well connected

exampleEn: Avoid digressions that distract from your main argument.
exampleRu: Избегайте отступлений, отвлекающих от основного аргумента.
exampleUz: Asosiy fikringizdan chalg'ituvchi mavzudan chetga chiqishlardan saqlaning.
definitionEn: a temporary departure from the main subject in speech or writing

exampleEn: The essay opens with a brief exposition of the topic.
exampleRu: Эссе начинается с краткого изложения темы.
exampleUz: Esse mavzuning qisqa bayoni bilan boshlanadi.
definitionEn: a comprehensive description or explanation of an idea or theory

exampleEn: The author juxtaposes two characters with opposite values.
exampleRu: Автор сопоставляет двух персонажей с противоположными ценностями.
exampleUz: Muallif qarama-qarshi qadriyatlarga ega ikki qahramonni bir-biriga qiyoslaydi.
definitionEn: to place two things side by side for comparison or contrast

exampleEn: She asserted that the results were reliable.
exampleRu: Она утверждала, что результаты были надёжными.
exampleUz: U natijalar ishonchli ekanligini ta'kidladi.
definitionEn: to state something confidently as if it were true

exampleEn: He conceded that his opponent had a valid point.
exampleRu: Он признал, что у его оппонента был весомый аргумент.
exampleUz: U raqibining haqli tomoni borligini tan oldi.
definitionEn: to admit, often reluctantly, that something is true

exampleEn: Critics contend that the policy will do more harm than good.
exampleRu: Критики утверждают, что политика принесёт больше вреда, чем пользы.
exampleUz: Tanqidchilar bu siyosat foydadan ko'ra ko'proq zarar keltirishini ta'kidlashmoqda.
definitionEn: to state as a position in an argument

exampleEn: The scientist refuted the claims with new data.
exampleRu: Учёный опроверг утверждения новыми данными.
exampleUz: Olim yangi ma'lumotlar bilan da'volarni rad etdi.
definitionEn: to prove that a statement or theory is wrong

exampleEn: Several experts dispute the accuracy of the survey.
exampleRu: Несколько экспертов оспаривают точность опроса.
exampleUz: Bir nechta ekspertlar so'rovnoma aniqligini bahslashmoqda.
definitionEn: to question or argue against the truth of something

exampleEn: She rebutted every point her opponent made.
exampleRu: Она опровергла каждый довод своего оппонента.
exampleUz: U raqibining har bir dalilini rad javobi bilan qaytardi.
definitionEn: to argue that a claim or accusation is false

exampleEn: The follow-up study validated the earlier findings.
exampleRu: Последующее исследование подтвердило более ранние выводы.
exampleUz: Keyingi tadqiqot avvalgi xulosalarni tasdiqladi.
definitionEn: to confirm that something is true, accurate, or justified

exampleEn: Could you clarify what you mean by that term?
exampleRu: Не могли бы вы уточнить, что вы имеете в виду под этим термином?
exampleUz: Bu atama bilan nimani nazarda tutayotganingizni aniqlashtira olasizmi?
definitionEn: to make something clearer or easier to understand

exampleEn: He tends to digress whenever he tells a story.
exampleRu: Он часто отклоняется от темы, когда рассказывает историю.
exampleUz: U hikoya qilganda ko'pincha mavzudan chetga chiqib ketadi.
definitionEn: to move away from the main topic when speaking or writing

exampleEn: The coach emphasized the importance of teamwork.
exampleRu: Тренер подчеркнул важность командной работы.
exampleUz: Murabbiy jamoaviy ishning ahamiyatini ta'kidladi.
definitionEn: to give special importance to something in speech or writing

exampleEn: Try to paraphrase the author's argument in your own words.
exampleRu: Постарайтесь перефразировать аргумент автора своими словами.
exampleUz: Muallif dalilini o'z so'zlaringiz bilan qayta ifodalashga harakat qiling.
definitionEn: to express the meaning of something using different words

exampleEn: The interviewer asked her to elaborate on her answer.
exampleRu: Интервьюер попросил её подробнее раскрыть свой ответ.
exampleUz: Intervyuchi undan javobini batafsilroq tushuntirishni so'radi.
definitionEn: to add more detail or explanation to something already said

exampleEn: The jury deliberated for several hours before reaching a verdict.
exampleRu: Присяжные совещались несколько часов, прежде чем вынести вердикт.
exampleUz: Hakamlar hay'ati qaror chiqarishdan oldin bir necha soat muhokama qildi.
definitionEn: to think about or discuss something carefully before deciding

exampleEn: When she forgot her notes, she had to improvise her answer.
exampleRu: Когда она забыла свои заметки, ей пришлось импровизировать ответ.
exampleUz: U yozuvlarini unutib qo'yganda, javobini o'zi topib aytishga to'g'ri keldi.
definitionEn: to create or perform something spontaneously without preparation

exampleEn: The students conversed comfortably with the visiting professor.
exampleRu: Студенты непринуждённо беседовали с приглашённым профессором.
exampleUz: Talabalar taklif etilgan professor bilan erkin suhbatlashishdi.
definitionEn: to have an informal conversation with someone

exampleEn: Social media trends are often ephemeral.
exampleRu: Тренды в социальных сетях часто мимолётны.
exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlardagi trendlar ko'pincha o'tkinchi bo'ladi.
definitionEn: lasting for a very short time

exampleEn: She is meticulous about checking every detail of her work.
exampleRu: Она скрупулёзно проверяет каждую деталь своей работы.
exampleUz: U o'z ishining har bir detalini sinchkovlik bilan tekshiradi.
definitionEn: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise

exampleEn: Coral reefs can be surprisingly resilient to minor disturbances.
exampleRu: Коралловые рифы могут быть удивительно устойчивы к незначительным нарушениям.
exampleUz: Marjon riflari kichik buzilishlarga nisbatan ajablanarli darajada bardoshli bo'lishi mumkin.
definitionEn: able to recover quickly from difficult conditions

exampleEn: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
exampleRu: Смартфоны стали повсеместными в современной жизни.
exampleUz: Smartfonlar zamonaviy hayotda hamma joyda uchraydigan bo'lib qoldi.
definitionEn: present or found everywhere

exampleEn: Olive oil is a versatile ingredient in the kitchen.
exampleRu: Оливковое масло — универсальный ингредиент на кухне.
exampleUz: Zaytun moyi oshxonada ko'p qirrali mahsulot hisoblanadi.
definitionEn: able to be used for many different purposes or skills

exampleEn: The scientists noticed an anomaly in the data set.
exampleRu: Учёные заметили аномалию в наборе данных.
exampleUz: Olimlar ma'lumotlar to'plamida anomaliyani payqashdi.
definitionEn: something that deviates from what is standard or expected

exampleEn: The protest acted as a catalyst for political reform.
exampleRu: Протест послужил катализатором политических реформ.
exampleUz: Norozilik namoyishi siyosiy islohotlar uchun turtki bo'ldi.
definitionEn: something that causes an important change or event to happen

exampleEn: Chess can improve children's cognitive development.
exampleRu: Шахматы могут улучшить когнитивное развитие детей.
exampleUz: Shaxmat bolalarning kognitiv rivojlanishini yaxshilashi mumkin.
definitionEn: relating to mental processes such as thinking and understanding

exampleEn: The theory needs to be tested with empirical evidence.
exampleRu: Теорию необходимо проверить эмпирическими данными.
exampleUz: Nazariya empirik dalillar bilan sinovdan o'tkazilishi kerak.
definitionEn: based on observation or experiment rather than theory

exampleEn: Curiosity is an intrinsic part of human nature.
exampleRu: Любопытство — неотъемлемая часть человеческой природы.
exampleUz: Qiziquvchanlik inson tabiatining ichki bir qismidir.
definitionEn: belonging naturally to something; essential

exampleEn: Taste in art is often highly subjective.
exampleRu: Вкус в искусстве часто весьма субъективен.
exampleUz: San'atdagi did ko'pincha juda subyektiv bo'ladi.
definitionEn: based on personal opinions or feelings rather than facts

exampleEn: Try to give an objective summary of both viewpoints.
exampleRu: Постарайтесь дать объективное изложение обеих точек зрения.
exampleUz: Ikkala nuqtai nazarning obyektiv xulosasini berishga harakat qiling.
definitionEn: not influenced by personal feelings; based on facts

exampleEn: The article gives only a superficial analysis of the crisis.
exampleRu: Статья даёт лишь поверхностный анализ кризиса.
exampleUz: Maqola inqirozning faqat yuzaki tahlilini beradi.
definitionEn: existing or considered only on the surface; not thorough

exampleEn: The deadline seemed completely arbitrary.
exampleRu: Срок казался совершенно произвольным.
exampleUz: Muddat butunlay o'zboshimchalik bilan belgilangandek tuyuldi.
definitionEn: based on random choice rather than reason or system

exampleEn: The book had a profound effect on how she viewed the world.
exampleRu: Книга оказала глубокое влияние на её взгляд на мир.
exampleUz: Kitob uning dunyoqarashiga chuqur ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
definitionEn: very great or intense; showing great insight

exampleEn: The report clearly delineates the causes of the decline.
exampleRu: Отчёт чётко описывает причины спада.
exampleUz: Hisobot pasayish sabablarini aniq tasvirlaydi.
definitionEn: to describe or explain something precisely

exampleEn: The professor elucidated the theory with a simple diagram.
exampleRu: Профессор разъяснил теорию с помощью простой схемы.
exampleUz: Professor nazariyani oddiy sxema yordamida tushuntirdi.
definitionEn: to make something clear by explaining it in detail

exampleEn: This case exemplifies a broader trend in the industry.
exampleRu: Этот случай иллюстрирует более широкую тенденцию в отрасли.
exampleUz: Bu holat sanoatdagi kengroq tendensiyani misol bilan ko'rsatadi.
definitionEn: to be a typical example of something

exampleEn: The committee formulated a new set of guidelines.
exampleRu: Комитет сформулировал новый свод правил.
exampleUz: Qo'mita yangi qoidalar to'plamini shakllantirdi.
definitionEn: to create or express an idea in a precise way

exampleEn: The graph illustrates the rise in global temperatures.
exampleRu: График иллюстрирует рост глобальных температур.
exampleUz: Grafik global harorat ko'tarilishini ko'rgazmali tarzda ko'rsatadi.
definitionEn: to explain or make something clear by using examples

exampleEn: Scientists postulate that the phenomenon has a genetic cause.
exampleRu: Учёные предполагают, что это явление имеет генетическую причину.
exampleUz: Olimlar bu hodisa genetik sababga ega deb taxmin qilishadi.
definitionEn: to suggest a theory or idea as a basis for reasoning

exampleEn: The whole argument rests on a false premise.
exampleRu: Весь аргумент строится на ложной предпосылке.
exampleUz: Butun dalil noto'g'ri asosga qurilgan.
definitionEn: a statement taken as true and used as the basis of an argument

exampleEn: The essay opens with a clear proposition.
exampleRu: Эссе начинается с чёткого тезиса.
exampleUz: Esse aniq tezis bilan boshlanadi.
definitionEn: a statement or idea put forward for consideration

exampleEn: The paper explains the rationale behind the new policy.
exampleRu: В статье объясняется обоснование новой политики.
exampleUz: Maqolada yangi siyosat ortidagi asos-mantiq tushuntiriladi.
definitionEn: a set of reasons that explains a decision or belief

exampleEn: The contract stipulates that payment must be made within 30 days.
exampleRu: Контракт оговаривает, что оплата должна быть произведена в течение 30 дней.
exampleUz: Shartnomada to'lov 30 kun ichida amalga oshirilishi shart qilib qo'yilgan.
definitionEn: to demand or specify a requirement, typically in an agreement

exampleEn: The final chapter offers a synthesis of the earlier arguments.
exampleRu: Заключительная глава предлагает синтез более ранних аргументов.
exampleUz: Yakuniy bob avvalgi dalillarning sintezini taqdim etadi.
definitionEn: the combination of separate ideas to form a coherent whole

exampleEn: Her thesis argues that early education shapes long-term outcomes.
exampleRu: Её тезис утверждает, что раннее образование формирует долгосрочные результаты.
exampleUz: Uning tezisi erta ta'lim uzoq muddatli natijalarni shakllantirishini ta'kidlaydi.
definitionEn: a statement or theory put forward to be supported or proved

exampleEn: Further experiments validated the initial hypothesis.
exampleRu: Дальнейшие эксперименты подтвердили первоначальную гипотезу.
exampleUz: Keyingi tajribalar dastlabki gipotezani tasdiqladi.
definitionEn: to check or prove that something is accurate or well-founded

exampleEn: Two independent studies corroborate these findings.
exampleRu: Два независимых исследования подтверждают эти выводы.
exampleUz: Ikkita mustaqil tadqiqot ushbu xulosalarni tasdiqlaydi.
definitionEn: to provide evidence that confirms a statement or theory

exampleEn: The speaker articulated her argument clearly for the panel.
exampleRu: Докладчица чётко изложила свой аргумент перед комиссией.
exampleUz: Ma'ruzachi o'z dalilini komissiya oldida aniq bayon qildi.
definitionEn: to express ideas or feelings clearly in words

exampleEn: His tone conveyed genuine concern for the students.
exampleRu: Его тон передавал искреннюю заботу о студентах.
exampleUz: Uning ohangi talabalarga bo'lgan chin g'amxo'rlikni yetkazdi.
definitionEn: to make an idea, feeling, or meaning known to someone

exampleEn: The examiner asked him to elaborate on his opinion.
exampleRu: Экзаменатор попросил его подробнее раскрыть своё мнение.
exampleUz: Imtihonchi undan o'z fikrini batafsilroq tushuntirishni so'radi.
definitionEn: to add more detail or explanation when speaking or writing

exampleEn: Let me clarify what I meant by that comment.
exampleRu: Позвольте мне уточнить, что я имел в виду под этим замечанием.
exampleUz: O'sha izohim bilan nimani nazarda tutganimni aniqlashtirib beray.
definitionEn: to make a statement or idea easier to understand

exampleEn: During the interview, she emphasized her leadership experience.
exampleRu: Во время интервью она подчеркнула свой опыт руководства.
exampleUz: Intervyu davomida u o'zining rahbarlik tajribasini ta'kidladi.
definitionEn: to give special importance to a point when speaking

exampleEn: During the speaking test, try to paraphrase the question in your answer.
exampleRu: Во время устного теста старайтесь перефразировать вопрос в своём ответе.
exampleUz: Og'zaki testda savolni javobingizda boshqacha so'z bilan qayta ayting.
definitionEn: to express the meaning of something using different words

exampleEn: He began his answer with a short personal anecdote.
exampleRu: Он начал свой ответ с короткого личного случая из жизни.
exampleUz: U javobini qisqa shaxsiy voqea bilan boshladi.
definitionEn: a short, interesting story about a real event or person

exampleEn: Try not to digress too much when answering timed questions.
exampleRu: Старайтесь не слишком отклоняться от темы, отвечая на вопросы на время.
exampleUz: Vaqt cheklangan savollarga javob berganda mavzudan juda ko'p chetga chiqmaslikka harakat qiling.
definitionEn: to move away from the main topic when speaking

exampleEn: The speaking section requires a fairly spontaneous response.
exampleRu: Секция говорения требует довольно спонтанного ответа.
exampleUz: Gapirish bo'limi ancha tabiiy javobni talab qiladi.
definitionEn: done without preparation, in a natural way

exampleEn: Building rapport with the interviewer can ease your nerves.
exampleRu: Установление контакта с интервьюером может снять напряжение.
exampleUz: Intervyu oluvchi bilan aloqa o'rnatish tashvishni kamaytirishi mumkin.
definitionEn: a friendly relationship in which people understand each other

exampleEn: Give a candid opinion, even if it's unpopular.
exampleRu: Дайте откровенное мнение, даже если оно непопулярно.
exampleUz: Hatto mashhur bo'lmasa ham, samimiy fikringizni bildiring.
definitionEn: truthful and direct in what one says

exampleEn: His eloquent response impressed everyone in the room.
exampleRu: Его красноречивый ответ впечатлил всех присутствующих.
exampleUz: Uning chiroyli notiqlik bilan bergan javobi xonadagi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
definitionEn: fluent and persuasive in speech

exampleEn: Being tactful helps when disagreeing with a classmate.
exampleRu: Тактичность помогает при несогласии с одноклассником.
exampleUz: Sinfdoshingiz bilan kelishmaganda muloyim bo'lish yordam beradi.
definitionEn: careful not to upset others when speaking

exampleEn: A persuasive speaker uses evidence, not just opinion.
exampleRu: Убедительный оратор использует доказательства, а не только мнение.
exampleUz: Ishontiruvchi notiq faqat fikr emas, dalillardan foydalanadi.
definitionEn: good at making people believe or agree with something

exampleEn: Remain skeptical of claims that lack supporting evidence.
exampleRu: Сохраняйте скептицизм по отношению к утверждениям без доказательств.
exampleUz: Dalilsiz da'volarga nisbatan shubha bilan qarashda davom eting.
definitionEn: having doubts about whether something is true

exampleEn: The cumulative effect of small changes can be significant.
exampleRu: Кумулятивный эффект небольших изменений может быть значительным.
exampleUz: Kichik o'zgarishlarning to'planib boruvchi ta'siri sezilarli bo'lishi mumkin.
definitionEn: increasing by successive additions over time

exampleEn: The species has a distinctive call that is easy to identify.
exampleRu: У этого вида есть отличительный крик, который легко распознать.
exampleUz: Bu turning oson aniqlanadigan o'ziga xos ovozi bor.
definitionEn: having a quality or feature that makes something easily recognizable

exampleEn: Demand for the product exceeded expectations.
exampleRu: Спрос на продукт превысил ожидания.
exampleUz: Mahsulotga bo'lgan talab kutilganidan oshib ketdi.
definitionEn: to be greater than a number, amount, or limit

exampleEn: It is not economically feasible to build the bridge there.
exampleRu: Строить мост там экономически нецелесообразно.
exampleUz: Ko'prikni o'sha yerda qurish iqtisodiy jihatdan amalga oshiriladigan emas.
definitionEn: possible to do easily or conveniently

exampleEn: Water is a fundamental requirement for all living organisms.
exampleRu: Вода — фундаментальная потребность всех живых организмов.
exampleUz: Suv barcha tirik organizmlar uchun asosiy ehtiyoj hisoblanadi.
definitionEn: forming a necessary base or core; of central importance

exampleEn: The new curriculum incorporates more practical exercises.
exampleRu: Новая программа включает больше практических упражнений.
exampleUz: Yangi o'quv dasturi ko'proq amaliy mashqlarni o'z ichiga oladi.
definitionEn: to include something as part of a whole

exampleEn: Different scholars interpret the data in different ways.
exampleRu: Разные учёные интерпретируют данные по-разному.
exampleUz: Turli olimlar ma'lumotlarni har xil talqin qilishadi.
definitionEn: to explain the meaning of something

exampleEn: Researchers are trying to find the optimal dosage.
exampleRu: Исследователи пытаются найти оптимальную дозировку.
exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar eng maqbul dozani topishga harakat qilmoqda.
definitionEn: most favorable or desirable under a given set of conditions

exampleEn: The experiment tested several different parameters.
exampleRu: В эксперименте проверялось несколько разных параметров.
exampleUz: Tajribada bir nechta turli parametrlar sinovdan o'tkazildi.
definitionEn: a measurable factor that helps define or limit a system

exampleEn: Migration is a phenomenon studied across many disciplines.
exampleRu: Миграция — явление, изучаемое во многих дисциплинах.
exampleUz: Migratsiya ko'plab fanlarda o'rganiladigan hodisadir.
definitionEn: a fact or event, especially one that is unusual or notable

exampleEn: The experiment demonstrates a basic principle of physics.
exampleRu: Эксперимент демонстрирует основной принцип физики.
exampleUz: Tajriba fizikaning asosiy printsipini namoyish etadi.
definitionEn: a fundamental rule or belief that explains how something works

exampleEn: The results of the study were somewhat ambiguous.
exampleRu: Результаты исследования были несколько неоднозначными.
exampleUz: Tadqiqot natijalari biroz ikki ma'noli edi.
definitionEn: open to more than one interpretation

exampleEn: Their opinions began to diverge as the debate continued.
exampleRu: Их мнения начали расходиться по мере продолжения дебатов.
exampleUz: Bahs davom etar ekan, ularning fikrlari farqlana boshladi.
definitionEn: to develop in different directions from a common point

exampleEn: The report examines every facet of the issue.
exampleRu: Отчёт рассматривает каждую грань этого вопроса.
exampleUz: Hisobot masalaning har bir qirrasini ko'rib chiqadi.
definitionEn: one part or aspect of something with many parts

exampleEn: Surveys help researchers gauge public opinion.
exampleRu: Опросы помогают исследователям оценить общественное мнение.
exampleUz: So'rovnomalar tadqiqotchilarga jamoatchilik fikrini baholashga yordam beradi.
definitionEn: to estimate or measure something accurately

exampleEn: The essay lacks coherence between the second and third paragraphs.
exampleRu: В эссе отсутствует связность между вторым и третьим абзацами.
exampleUz: Essening ikkinchi va uchinchi paragraflari orasida izchillik yetishmaydi.
definitionEn: the quality of being logical and consistent as a whole

exampleEn: The customer asked for a receipt.
exampleRu: Клиент попросил чек.
exampleUz: Mijoz chek so'radi.
definitionEn: a person who buys goods or services from a shop or business

exampleEn: Do you accept cash or only cards?
exampleRu: Вы принимаете наличные или только карты?
exampleUz: Naqd pul qabul qilasizmi yoki faqat kartami?
definitionEn: money in the form of coins and banknotes

exampleEn: We got a 20% discount on the shoes.
exampleRu: Мы получили скидку 20% на обувь.
exampleUz: Poyabzalga 20% chegirma oldik.
definitionEn: a reduction in the usual price of something

exampleEn: She is the owner of a small café.
exampleRu: Она владелица маленького кафе.
exampleUz: U kichik kafening egasi.
definitionEn: a person who owns something, such as a business

exampleEn: The hotel staff were very friendly.
exampleRu: Персонал отеля был очень дружелюбным.
exampleUz: Mehmonxona xodimlari juda mehribon edi.
definitionEn: the group of people who work for an organization

exampleEn: The truck was full of goods for the market.
exampleRu: Грузовик был полон товаров для рынка.
exampleUz: Yuk mashinasi bozor uchun tovarlarga to'la edi.
definitionEn: things that are made or grown to be sold

exampleEn: I need to see a doctor about my cough.
exampleRu: Мне нужно показаться врачу из-за кашля.
exampleUz: Yo'talim uchun shifokorga ko'rinishim kerak.
definitionEn: a person trained to treat sick or injured people

exampleEn: My grandmother is in the hospital.
exampleRu: Моя бабушка в больнице.
exampleUz: Buvim kasalxonada.
definitionEn: a place where sick or injured people receive treatment

exampleEn: Take this medicine twice a day.
exampleRu: Принимай это лекарство два раза в день.
exampleUz: Bu dorini kuniga ikki marta iching.
definitionEn: a substance used to treat or prevent illness

exampleEn: Eating vegetables keeps you healthy.
exampleRu: Овощи помогают оставаться здоровым.
exampleUz: Sabzavot yeyish sizni sog'lom saqlaydi.
definitionEn: in good physical or mental condition

exampleEn: I have a pain in my leg.
exampleRu: У меня болит нога.
exampleUz: Oyog'imda og'riq bor.
definitionEn: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness

exampleEn: Regular exercise is good for your heart.
exampleRu: Регулярные упражнения полезны для сердца.
exampleUz: Muntazam mashqlar yurak uchun foydali.
definitionEn: physical activity done to stay fit and healthy

exampleEn: The lawyer met with a new client this morning.
exampleRu: Адвокат встретился с новым клиентом сегодня утром.
exampleUz: Advokat bugun ertalab yangi mijoz bilan uchrashdi.
definitionEn: a person who receives services from a professional or company

exampleEn: We changed suppliers to reduce costs.
exampleRu: Мы сменили поставщика, чтобы снизить расходы.
exampleUz: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish uchun yetkazib beruvchini almashtirdik.
definitionEn: a company or person that provides goods to a business

exampleEn: Both sides signed the contract yesterday.
exampleRu: Обе стороны подписали контракт вчера.
exampleUz: Ikkala tomon kecha shartnomani imzoladi.
definitionEn: a formal written agreement between two or more parties

exampleEn: The store made a good profit this quarter.
exampleRu: Магазин получил хорошую прибыль в этом квартале.
exampleUz: Do'kon bu chorakda yaxshi foyda oldi.
definitionEn: the money a business gains after paying its costs

exampleEn: They plan to invest in new equipment next year.
exampleRu: Они планируют инвестировать в новое оборудование в следующем году.
exampleUz: Ular kelasi yili yangi jihozlarga sarmoya kiritishni rejalashtirmoqda.
definitionEn: to put money into something to make a profit later

exampleEn: Please send the invoice by email.
exampleRu: Пожалуйста, пришлите счёт по электронной почте.
exampleUz: Iltimos, hisob-fakturani elektron pochta orqali yuboring.
definitionEn: a document listing goods sold and the amount owed

exampleEn: A high fever is a common symptom of the flu.
exampleRu: Высокая температура — распространённый симптом гриппа.
exampleUz: Yuqori harorat gripning keng tarqalgan alomatidir.
definitionEn: a sign of illness felt or noticed by a person

exampleEn: The treatment lasted for three weeks.
exampleRu: Лечение длилось три недели.
exampleUz: Davolash uch hafta davom etdi.
definitionEn: medical care given to a patient for an illness

exampleEn: The doctor wrote a prescription for antibiotics.
exampleRu: Врач выписал рецепт на антибиотики.
exampleUz: Shifokor antibiotiklar uchun retsept yozdi.
definitionEn: a written instruction from a doctor for medicine

exampleEn: Good nutrition helps children grow strong.
exampleRu: Хорошее питание помогает детям расти крепкими.
exampleUz: Yaxshi ovqatlanish bolalarning baquvvat o'sishiga yordam beradi.
definitionEn: the process of eating the right food to stay healthy

exampleEn: Too much stress can affect your sleep.
exampleRu: Слишком сильный стресс может повлиять на сон.
exampleUz: Ortiqcha stress uyqungizga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.
definitionEn: a feeling of mental or emotional pressure

exampleEn: Children receive several vaccines in their first year.
exampleRu: Дети получают несколько вакцин в первый год жизни.
exampleUz: Bolalar hayotining birinchi yilida bir nechta vaksina oladi.
definitionEn: a substance given to protect against a disease

exampleEn: The company's revenue grew by 20% last year.
exampleRu: Выручка компании выросла на 20% в прошлом году.
exampleUz: Kompaniyaning daromadi o'tgan yili 20% ga o'sdi.
definitionEn: the total income a business generates from sales

exampleEn: The acquisition doubled the size of the company.
exampleRu: Приобретение удвоило размер компании.
exampleUz: Sotib olish kompaniya hajmini ikki baravar oshirdi.
definitionEn: the act of buying another company or its assets

exampleEn: The firm decided to outsource its customer support.
exampleRu: Фирма решила передать поддержку клиентов на аутсорс.
exampleUz: Firma mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishni tashqariga topshirishga qaror qildi.
definitionEn: to pay another company to do work instead of doing it in-house

exampleEn: The merger created one of the largest banks in the region.
exampleRu: Слияние создало один из крупнейших банков в регионе.
exampleUz: Birlashish natijasida mintaqadagi eng yirik banklardan biri paydo bo'ldi.
definitionEn: the combination of two companies into one

exampleEn: The company recorded a significant liability on its balance sheet.
exampleRu: Компания отразила значительное обязательство на своём балансе.
exampleUz: Kompaniya balansida sezilarli majburiyatni qayd etdi.
definitionEn: a debt or financial obligation a business must pay

exampleEn: The subsidiary operates independently from the parent company.

definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce the outcome of something

exampleEn: For instance, air pollution has increased significantly in major cities.

exampleEn: To sum up, the advantages clearly outweigh the disadvantages.

definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce an example that clarifies a point

exampleEn: In other words, the policy failed to achieve its main goal.
