definitionEn: to move to a standing position

exampleEn: Let's go out for dinner tonight.
exampleRu: Давай сегодня сходим поужинать.
exampleUz: Bugun kechqurun ovqatlanish uchun chiqamiz.
definitionEn: to leave home for entertainment

exampleEn: He came back from work late.
exampleRu: Он поздно вернулся с работы.
exampleUz: U ishdan kech qaytdi.
definitionEn: to return to a place

exampleEn: Don't give up on your dreams.
exampleRu: Не сдавайся, следуй за мечтой.
exampleUz: Orzularingizdan voz kechmang.
definitionEn: to stop trying to do something

exampleEn: I need to find out the truth.
exampleRu: Мне нужно узнать правду.
exampleUz: Men haqiqatni bilib olishim kerak.
definitionEn: to discover information

exampleEn: We had to put off the meeting until next week.
exampleRu: Нам пришлось отложить встречу до следующей недели.
exampleUz: Uchrashuvni keyingi haftaga kechiktirishga to'g'ri keldi.
definitionEn: to delay or postpone something

exampleEn: Please carry on with your work.
exampleRu: Пожалуйста, продолжайте работу.
exampleUz: Iltimos, ishingizni davom ettiring.
definitionEn: to continue doing something

exampleEn: She was brought up by her grandparents.
exampleRu: Её воспитали бабушка с дедушкой.
exampleUz: U bobo-buvisi tomonidan tarbiyalangan.
definitionEn: to raise a child, or mention a topic

exampleEn: I can't figure out how this works.
exampleRu: Я не могу разобраться, как это работает.
exampleUz: Men bu qanday ishlashini tushuna olmayapman.
definitionEn: to understand or solve something

exampleEn: She came up with a great idea.
exampleRu: Она придумала отличную идею.
exampleUz: U ajoyib g'oya o'ylab topdi.
definitionEn: to think of an idea or plan

exampleEn: He's going through a difficult time.
exampleRu: Он переживает трудное время.
exampleUz: U qiyin davrni boshidan kechiryapti.
definitionEn: to experience something difficult, or to examine something in detail

exampleEn: She takes after her mother.
exampleRu: Она похожа на свою мать.
exampleUz: U onasiga o'xshaydi.
definitionEn: to resemble a parent or relative

exampleEn: They set up a new company last year.
exampleRu: Они основали новую компанию в прошлом году.
exampleUz: Ular o'tgan yili yangi kompaniya tashkil qilishdi.
definitionEn: to establish or arrange something

exampleEn: She pointed out a mistake in the report.
exampleRu: Она указала на ошибку в отчёте.
exampleUz: U hisobotdagi xatoni ko'rsatib o'tdi.
definitionEn: to draw attention to something

exampleEn: Hold on a second, I'll be right back.
exampleRu: Подожди секунду, я скоро вернусь.
exampleUz: Bir soniya kuting, hozir qaytaman.
definitionEn: to wait briefly, or to grip something firmly

exampleEn: I ran into an old friend yesterday.
exampleRu: Вчера я случайно встретил старого друга.
exampleUz: Kecha men eski do'stim bilan tasodifan uchrashib qoldim.
definitionEn: to meet someone unexpectedly, or encounter a problem

exampleEn: The car broke down on the highway.
exampleRu: Машина сломалась на шоссе.
exampleUz: Mashina tosh yo'lda buzildi.
definitionEn: to stop working (machine) or lose emotional control

exampleEn: We need to check in two hours before the flight.
exampleRu: Нам нужно зарегистрироваться за два часа до рейса.
exampleUz: Biz parvozdan ikki soat oldin ro'yxatdan o'tishimiz kerak.
definitionEn: to register at a hotel or airport

exampleEn: Things worked out well in the end.
exampleRu: В итоге всё сложилось хорошо.
exampleUz: Oxir-oqibat hammasi yaxshi chiqdi.
definitionEn: to solve a problem, exercise, or turn out successfully

exampleEn: I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
exampleRu: Я стараюсь сократить потребление сахара.
exampleUz: Men shakar iste'molini kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman.
definitionEn: to reduce the amount of something

exampleEn: He comes across as very confident in interviews.
exampleRu: На собеседованиях он производит впечатление очень уверенного человека.
exampleUz: U suhbatlarda juda o'ziga ishongan taassurot qoldiradi.
definitionEn: to give a particular impression

exampleEn: Rising costs account for the price increase.
exampleRu: Рост издержек объясняет повышение цен.
exampleUz: Xarajatlarning oshishi narxning ko'tarilishini izohlaydi.
definitionEn: to explain the cause of something, or to form a part/proportion of a total

exampleEn: There's no point dwelling on past mistakes.
exampleRu: Нет смысла зацикливаться на прошлых ошибках.
exampleUz: O'tmishdagi xatolarga urg'u berishning ma'nosi yo'q.
definitionEn: to think or talk about something for too long

exampleEn: Her fear of dogs stems from a childhood incident.
exampleRu: Её страх перед собаками происходит из детского случая.
exampleUz: Uning itlardan qo'rqishi bolalikdagi voqeadan kelib chiqadi.
definitionEn: to originate or result from something

exampleEn: The report delves into the causes of the crisis.
exampleRu: Отчёт углубляется в причины кризиса.
exampleUz: Hisobot inqirozning sabablarini chuqur o'rganadi.
definitionEn: to investigate a subject thoroughly

exampleEn: We still need to iron out a few details.
exampleRu: Нам всё ещё нужно устранить пару деталей.
exampleUz: Bizga hali bir necha tafsilotlarni bartaraf etish kerak.
definitionEn: to resolve minor problems or difficulties

exampleEn: The reforms brought about significant changes.
exampleRu: Реформы привели к значительным изменениям.
exampleUz: Islohotlar sezilarli o'zgarishlarga sabab bo'ldi.
definitionEn: to cause something to happen

exampleEn: You should weigh up the pros and cons before deciding.
exampleRu: Тебе стоит взвесить все за и против перед решением.
exampleUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin ijobiy va salbiy tomonlarini solishtirib ko'rishingiz kerak.
definitionEn: to consider something carefully before making a decision

exampleEn: The outcome hinges on the final vote.
exampleRu: Результат зависит от финального голосования.
exampleUz: Natija yakuniy ovoz berishga bog'liq.
definitionEn: to depend entirely on a single factor

exampleEn: The article glosses over the project's failures.
exampleRu: Статья замалчивает провалы проекта.
exampleUz: Maqola loyihaning muvaffaqiyatsizliklarini yashirincha o'tkazib yuboradi.
definitionEn: to avoid discussing something in detail, often to hide a problem

exampleEn: You need to factor in the extra costs.
exampleRu: Тебе нужно учесть дополнительные расходы.
exampleUz: Siz qo'shimcha xarajatlarni hisobga olishingiz kerak.
definitionEn: to include something as a relevant element in a calculation

exampleEn: This loan should tide us over until payday.
exampleRu: Этот кредит должен помочь нам продержаться до зарплаты.
exampleUz: Bu kredit bizga maosh kunigacha yordam berishi kerak.
definitionEn: to help someone survive a difficult period, especially financially

exampleEn: Inflation is chipping away at people's savings.
exampleRu: Инфляция постепенно подрывает сбережения людей.
exampleUz: Inflyatsiya odamlarning jamg'armalarini asta-sekin kamaytirmoqda.
definitionEn: to gradually reduce or destroy something

exampleEn: The company is branching out into new markets.
exampleRu: Компания расширяется на новые рынки.
exampleUz: Kompaniya yangi bozorlar tomon kengaymoqda.
definitionEn: to expand activities into a new area

exampleEn: The movie didn't live up to the hype.
exampleRu: Фильм не оправдал ажиотажа.
exampleUz: Film hype'ga mos kelmadi.
definitionEn: to be as good as expected

exampleEn: Investors wrote off the company as a lost cause.
exampleRu: Инвесторы списали компанию как безнадёжную.
exampleUz: Investorlar kompaniyani umidsiz deb hisobdan chiqarib tashlashdi.
definitionEn: to dismiss someone/something as unimportant or unlikely to succeed

exampleEn: I need to make a decision by tomorrow.
exampleRu: Мне нужно принять решение до завтра.
exampleUz: Ertagacha qaror qabul qilishim kerak.
definitionEn: to choose something after thinking about it

exampleEn: We usually have breakfast at eight.
exampleRu: Мы обычно завтракаем в восемь.
exampleUz: Biz odatda soat sakkizda nonushta qilamiz.
definitionEn: to eat the morning meal

exampleEn: She does her homework right after school.
exampleRu: Она делает уроки сразу после школы.
exampleUz: U maktabdan keyin darhol uy vazifasini bajaradi.
definitionEn: to complete school assignments at home

exampleEn: Let's take a break for ten minutes.
exampleRu: Давай сделаем перерыв на десять минут.
exampleUz: Keling, o'n daqiqaga tanaffus qilaylik.
definitionEn: to stop working for a short time to rest

exampleEn: I need to catch the eight o'clock bus.
exampleRu: Мне нужно успеть на автобус в восемь.
exampleUz: Menga soat sakkizdagi avtobusga ulgurishim kerak.
definitionEn: to get on a bus in time

exampleEn: He made friends quickly at his new school.
exampleRu: Он быстро завёл друзей в новой школе.
exampleUz: U yangi maktabida tez do'st orttirdi.
definitionEn: to become friends with someone

exampleEn: I do the shopping every Saturday.
exampleRu: Я делаю покупки каждую субботу.
exampleUz: Men har shanba kuni xarid qilaman.
definitionEn: to buy groceries or goods

exampleEn: I always have a shower in the morning.
exampleRu: Я всегда принимаю душ по утрам.
exampleUz: Men doim ertalab dush qabul qilaman.
definitionEn: to wash yourself under running water

exampleEn: Please pay attention in class.
exampleRu: Пожалуйста, уделяй внимание на уроке.
exampleUz: Iltimos, darsda e'tiborli bo'ling.
definitionEn: to focus your attention on something

exampleEn: Everyone makes mistakes sometimes.
exampleRu: Все иногда совершают ошибки.
exampleUz: Har kim ba'zan xato qiladi.
definitionEn: to do something incorrectly

exampleEn: Can you take a photo of us?
exampleRu: Можешь нас сфотографировать?
exampleUz: Bizning suratimizni olib bera olasizmi?
definitionEn: to capture a picture with a camera

exampleEn: The kids had a lot of fun at the party.
exampleRu: Дети очень веселились на вечеринке.
exampleUz: Bolalar ziyofatda juda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazishdi.
definitionEn: to enjoy yourself

exampleEn: The two companies finally reached an agreement.
exampleRu: Две компании наконец достигли соглашения.
exampleUz: Ikki kompaniya nihoyat kelishuvga erishdi.
definitionEn: to arrive at a mutual understanding

exampleEn: The campaign aims to raise awareness about climate change.
exampleRu: Кампания направлена на повышение осведомлённости об изменении климата.
exampleUz: Kampaniya iqlim o'zgarishi haqida xabardorlikni oshirishga qaratilgan.
definitionEn: to help more people know about an issue

exampleEn: We managed to meet the deadline despite the delays.
exampleRu: Нам удалось уложиться в срок, несмотря на задержки.
exampleUz: Kechikishlarga qaramay, muddatga ulgurishga muvaffaq bo'ldik.
definitionEn: to finish something before or by the set time

exampleEn: It's too early to draw any conclusions.
exampleRu: Ещё слишком рано делать какие-либо выводы.
exampleUz: Hozircha har qanday xulosa chiqarish erta.
definitionEn: to form an opinion based on evidence

exampleEn: Diet plays a role in overall health.
exampleRu: Питание играет роль в общем состоянии здоровья.
exampleUz: Ovqatlanish umumiy sog'liqda rol o'ynaydi.
definitionEn: to have an influence or function in something

exampleEn: He took full responsibility for the mistake.
exampleRu: Он взял на себя полную ответственность за ошибку.
exampleUz: U xato uchun to'liq mas'uliyatni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
definitionEn: to accept accountability for something

exampleEn: She gained valuable experience during her internship.
exampleRu: Она приобрела ценный опыт во время стажировки.
exampleUz: U amaliyot davomida qimmatli tajriba orttirdi.
definitionEn: to develop skills through practice

exampleEn: It's important to set realistic goals.
exampleRu: Важно ставить реалистичные цели.
exampleUz: Real maqsadlar qo'yish muhim.
definitionEn: to decide on an objective

exampleEn: Every business faces challenges at some point.
exampleRu: Каждый бизнес сталкивается с трудностями в тот или иной момент.
exampleUz: Har qanday biznes qandaydir bosqichda qiyinchiliklarga duch keladi.
definitionEn: to be confronted with a difficult situation

exampleEn: It takes time to build a strong relationship with clients.
exampleRu: Требуется время, чтобы выстроить прочные отношения с клиентами.
exampleUz: Mijozlar bilan mustahkam munosabat qurish vaqt talab qiladi.
definitionEn: to develop a connection with someone over time

exampleEn: It took him months to come to terms with the loss.
exampleRu: Ему потребовались месяцы, чтобы смириться с потерей.
exampleUz: Unga yo'qotish bilan murosaga kelish uchun oylar kerak bo'ldi.
definitionEn: to accept a difficult situation

exampleEn: It's not easy to strike a balance between work and family.
exampleRu: Нелегко найти баланс между работой и семьёй.
exampleUz: Ish va oila o'rtasida muvozanat topish oson emas.
definitionEn: to find a good compromise between two demands

exampleEn: The invention paved the way for modern computing.
exampleRu: Изобретение проложило путь для современных вычислений.
exampleUz: Ixtiro zamonaviy kompyuter texnologiyasi uchun yo'l ochib berdi.
definitionEn: to make future progress or development possible

exampleEn: The company's finances came under scrutiny after the scandal.
exampleRu: Финансы компании оказались под пристальным вниманием после скандала.
exampleUz: Janjaldan so'ng kompaniyaning moliyasi diqqat markaziga tushdi.
definitionEn: to be closely and critically examined

exampleEn: Small businesses bore the brunt of the economic downturn.
exampleRu: Малый бизнес принял на себя основной удар экономического спада.
exampleUz: Kichik bizneslar iqtisodiy pasayishning asosiy zarbasini qabul qildi.
definitionEn: to suffer the worst of a difficult situation

exampleEn: Investors should exercise caution in volatile markets.
exampleRu: Инвесторам следует проявлять осторожность на нестабильных рынках.
exampleUz: Investorlar beqaror bozorlarda ehtiyotkorlik ko'rsatishlari kerak.
definitionEn: to act carefully to avoid risk

exampleEn: The new strategy has yielded significant results.
exampleRu: Новая стратегия дала значительные результаты.
exampleUz: Yangi strategiya muhim natijalar berdi.
definitionEn: to produce important or noticeable outcomes

exampleEn: Diversifying investments can mitigate the risk of loss.
exampleRu: Диверсификация инвестиций может снизить риск потерь.
exampleUz: Investitsiyalarni diversifikatsiya qilish yo'qotish xavfini kamaytirishi mumkin.
definitionEn: to make a risk less severe

exampleEn: Solid data underpins the researcher's argument.
exampleRu: Убедительные данные лежат в основе аргумента исследователя.
exampleUz: Ishonchli ma'lumotlar tadqiqotchining argumentiga asos bo'ladi.
definitionEn: to provide the foundation or support for a claim

exampleEn: The proposal quickly garnered support from local businesses.
exampleRu: Предложение быстро заручилось поддержкой местного бизнеса.
exampleUz: Taklif tez orada mahalliy bizneslarning qo'llab-quvvatlashiga erishdi.
definitionEn: to gather or collect support

exampleEn: The two sides finally reconciled their differences.
exampleRu: Обе стороны наконец примирили свои разногласия.
exampleUz: Ikki taraf nihoyat kelishmovchiliklarni bartaraf etdi.
definitionEn: to settle a disagreement between two parties

exampleEn: She attributes her success to years of hard work.
exampleRu: Она приписывает свой успех годам упорного труда.
exampleUz: U o'z muvaffaqiyatini ko'p yillik mehnatiga bog'laydi.
definitionEn: to say that something is the cause of a result

exampleEn: The new policy will undergo close scrutiny before approval.
exampleRu: Новая политика подвергнется тщательной проверке перед утверждением.
exampleUz: Yangi siyosat tasdiqlanishidan oldin puxta tekshiruvdan o'tadi.
definitionEn: to be examined carefully before a decision

exampleEn: This startup epitomizes the trend toward remote work.
exampleRu: Этот стартап олицетворяет тенденцию к удалённой работе.
exampleUz: Bu startap masofaviy ishlash tendensiyasini mujassam etadi.
definitionEn: to be a perfect example of something

exampleEn: We play football every Sunday.
exampleRu: Мы играем в футбол каждое воскресенье.
exampleUz: Biz har yakshanba futbol o'ynaymiz.
definitionEn: to take part in a game or sport

exampleEn: The match starts at six.
exampleRu: Матч начинается в шесть.
exampleUz: O'yin soat oltida boshlanadi.
definitionEn: an organized game between two teams or players

exampleEn: Our team won the game.
exampleRu: Наша команда выиграла игру.
exampleUz: Bizning jamoamiz o'yinda g'alaba qozondi.
definitionEn: to be the best or first in a competition

exampleEn: I hate to lose.
exampleRu: Я не люблю проигрывать.
exampleUz: Men yutqazishni yomon ko'raman.
definitionEn: to fail to win a game or competition

exampleEn: She can jump very high.
exampleRu: Она умеет очень высоко прыгать.
exampleUz: U juda baland sakray oladi.
definitionEn: to push yourself off the ground using your legs

exampleEn: Pass me the ball, please.
exampleRu: Передай мне мяч, пожалуйста.
exampleUz: Iltimos, to'pni menga uzat.
definitionEn: a round object used in many sports and games

exampleEn: Our coach is very strict.
exampleRu: Наш тренер очень строгий.
exampleUz: Bizning murabbiyimiz juda qattiqqo'l.
definitionEn: a person who trains a sports team or player

exampleEn: He scored the winning goal.
exampleRu: Он забил победный гол.
exampleUz: U g'alaba qozondiruvchi golni urdi.
definitionEn: a point scored in sports like football, or a target you want to reach

exampleEn: She won the 100-metre race.
exampleRu: Она выиграла забег на 100 метров.
exampleUz: U 100 metrga poygada g'alaba qozondi.
definitionEn: a competition to see who is fastest

exampleEn: I learned to swim as a child.
exampleRu: Я научился плавать в детстве.
exampleUz: Men bolaligimda suzishni o'rgandim.
definitionEn: to move through water using arms and legs

exampleEn: Athletes from 50 countries will compete.
exampleRu: Спортсмены из 50 стран будут соревноваться.
exampleUz: 50 mamlakatdan sportchilar musobaqalashadi.
definitionEn: to try to win or be better than others

exampleEn: She won the world championship.
exampleRu: Она выиграла чемпионат мира.
exampleUz: U dunyo chempionatida g'olib chiqdi.
definitionEn: a competition to find the best player or team in a sport

exampleEn: He shook hands with his opponent.
exampleRu: Он пожал руку своему сопернику.
exampleUz: U raqibi bilan qo'l siqishdi.
definitionEn: a person who competes against you

exampleEn: The referee showed him a red card.
exampleRu: Судья показал ему красную карточку.
exampleUz: Hakam unga qizil kartochka ko'rsatdi.
definitionEn: a person who makes sure players follow the rules

exampleEn: The stadium was completely full.
exampleRu: Стадион был полностью заполнен.
exampleUz: Stadion to'liq to'lgan edi.
definitionEn: a large structure with seats where sports events are held

exampleEn: She is a professional athlete.
exampleRu: Она профессиональная спортсменка.
exampleUz: U professional sportchi.
definitionEn: a person who is trained in or good at sports

exampleEn: He goes to training every morning.
exampleRu: Он ходит на тренировку каждое утро.
exampleUz: U har kuni ertalab mashg'ulotga boradi.
definitionEn: the process of preparing for a sport through exercise

exampleEn: They organized a chess tournament.
exampleRu: Они организовали шахматный турнир.
exampleUz: Ular shaxmat turnirini tashkil qilishdi.
definitionEn: a series of games or matches to find an overall winner

exampleEn: What's the score?
exampleRu: Какой счёт?
exampleUz: Hisob qancha?
definitionEn: the number of points a player or team has, or to get a point

exampleEn: Fitness is important for good health.
exampleRu: Физическая форма важна для хорошего здоровья.
exampleUz: Jismoniy tayyorgarlik yaxshi salomatlik uchun muhim.
definitionEn: the condition of being physically healthy and strong

exampleEn: Marathon running requires great endurance.
exampleRu: Марафонский бег требует большой выносливости.
exampleUz: Marafon yugurish katta chidamlilikni talab qiladi.
definitionEn: the ability to keep doing something difficult for a long time

exampleEn: You need stamina to finish an Ironman race.
exampleRu: Тебе нужна выносливость, чтобы финишировать в гонке Ironman.
exampleUz: Ironman poygasini tugatish uchun bardoshlilik kerak.
definitionEn: physical or mental strength to sustain effort over time

exampleEn: The runner was disqualified for a false start.
exampleRu: Бегун был дисквалифицирован за фальстарт.
exampleUz: Yugurchi noto'g'ri start uchun diskvalifikatsiya qilindi.
definitionEn: to officially stop someone from a competition for breaking a rule

exampleEn: The underdog team shocked everyone by winning.
exampleRu: Команда-аутсайдер шокировала всех, победив.
exampleUz: Kutilmagan jamoa hammani hayratga solib g'alaba qozondi.
definitionEn: a competitor thought unlikely to win

exampleEn: He showed great sportsmanship after losing.
exampleRu: Он проявил отличное спортивное поведение после поражения.
exampleUz: U yutqazgandan keyin ajoyib sportchilik odobini ko'rsatdi.
definitionEn: fair and generous behaviour in sport, especially toward opponents

exampleEn: She finished her first marathon in four hours.
exampleRu: Она пробежала свой первый марафон за четыре часа.
exampleUz: U birinchi marafonini to'rt soatda tugatdi.
definitionEn: a long-distance running race of 42.2 kilometres

exampleEn: Thousands of spectators filled the arena.
exampleRu: Тысячи зрителей заполнили арену.
exampleUz: Minglab tomoshabinlar arenani to'ldirdi.
definitionEn: a person who watches an event, especially a sports event

exampleEn: Olympic athletes follow a rigorous training schedule.
exampleRu: Олимпийские спортсмены следуют строгому графику тренировок.
exampleUz: Olimpiya sportchilari qat'iy mashg'ulot jadvaliga amal qilishadi.
definitionEn: extremely thorough, careful, and demanding

exampleEn: The coach made a tactical substitution.
exampleRu: Тренер сделал тактическую замену.
exampleUz: Murabbiy taktik almashtirish qildi.
definitionEn: relating to a planned strategy to achieve a goal

exampleEn: Success in sport takes talent and perseverance.
exampleRu: Успех в спорте требует таланта и упорства.
exampleUz: Sportdagi muvaffaqiyat iste'dod va matonatni talab qiladi.
definitionEn: continued effort despite difficulty or delay in achieving success

exampleEn: She is a good student.
exampleRu: Она хорошая студентка.
exampleUz: U yaxshi talaba.
definitionEn: a person who is studying at a school or university

exampleEn: Our class starts at nine.
exampleRu: Наш урок начинается в девять.
exampleUz: Bizning darsimiz to'qqizda boshlanadi.
definitionEn: a group of students who are taught together, or a lesson

exampleEn: Today's lesson is about verbs.
