definitionEn: a prolonged public disagreement or heated discussion

exampleEn: The company has switched to more sustainable packaging.
exampleRu: Компания перешла на более экологически устойчивую упаковку.
exampleUz: Kompaniya barqarorroq qadoqlashga o'tdi.
definitionEn: able to continue over time without harming the environment

exampleEn: Researchers found a significant increase in air quality after the ban.
exampleRu: Исследователи обнаружили значительное улучшение качества воздуха после запрета.
exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar taqiqdan so'ng havo sifatining sezilarli yaxshilanishini aniqladilar.
definitionEn: large or important enough to be noticed

exampleEn: There is little evidence to support this theory.
exampleRu: Существует мало доказательств в поддержку этой теории.
exampleUz: Bu nazariyani tasdiqlovchi dalillar juda kam.
definitionEn: facts or information indicating whether something is true

exampleEn: The whole argument rests on a questionable assumption.
exampleRu: Весь аргумент строится на сомнительном предположении.
exampleUz: Butun dalil shubhali taxminga asoslanadi.
definitionEn: something accepted as true without proof

exampleEn: Scientists are still trying to explain this unusual phenomenon.
exampleRu: Учёные всё ещё пытаются объяснить это необычное явление.
exampleUz: Olimlar bu g'ayrioddiy hodisani hali ham tushuntirishga harakat qilishmoqda.
definitionEn: a fact or situation that is observed to exist or happen

exampleEn: The new findings directly contradict earlier studies.
exampleRu: Новые данные напрямую противоречат более ранним исследованиям.
exampleUz: Yangi natijalar avvalgi tadqiqotlarga bevosita zid keladi.
definitionEn: to state the opposite of something, or to be inconsistent with it

exampleEn: Given current trends, some economists see a slowdown as inevitable.
exampleRu: Учитывая текущие тенденции, некоторые экономисты считают замедление неизбежным.
exampleUz: Hozirgi tendensiyalarni hisobga olgan holda, ba'zi iqtisodchilar sekinlashuvni muqarrar deb bilishadi.
definitionEn: certain to happen and impossible to avoid

exampleEn: The idea has gained widespread acceptance in recent years.
exampleRu: Эта идея получила широкое распространение в последние годы.
exampleUz: Bu g'oya so'nggi yillarda keng tarqalgan.
definitionEn: existing or happening over a large area or among many people

exampleEn: The author's controversial claims sparked heated debate.
exampleRu: Спорные заявления автора вызвали жаркие дебаты.
exampleUz: Muallifning bahsli fikrlari qizg'in bahs-munozaraga sabab bo'ldi.
definitionEn: causing disagreement or discussion

exampleEn: Regular exercise is beneficial for both body and mind.
exampleRu: Регулярные физические упражнения полезны как для тела, так и для разума.
exampleUz: Muntazam jismoniy mashqlar ham tana, ham aql uchun foydalidir.
definitionEn: producing good or helpful results

exampleEn: The main drawback of the plan is its high cost.
exampleRu: Главный недостаток плана — его высокая стоимость.
exampleUz: Rejaning asosiy kamchiligi uning yuqori narxidir.
definitionEn: a disadvantage or problem associated with something

exampleEn: Few people considered the long-term consequences of the decision.
exampleRu: Мало кто задумался о долгосрочных последствиях этого решения.
exampleUz: Kam odam qarorning uzoq muddatli oqibatlari haqida o'ylagan.
definitionEn: a result or effect of an action or condition

exampleEn: The teacher took a more practical approach to the subject.
exampleRu: Преподаватель применил более практический подход к предмету.
exampleUz: O'qituvchi mavzuga ko'proq amaliy yondashuvni qo'lladi.
definitionEn: a way of dealing with something

exampleEn: It's important to read the quote in its full context.
exampleRu: Важно читать цитату в её полном контексте.
exampleUz: Iqtibosni to'liq kontekstda o'qish muhim.
definitionEn: the circumstances that form the setting for an event or idea

exampleEn: The report gives an accurate picture of current spending.
exampleRu: Отчёт даёт точную картину текущих расходов.
exampleUz: Hisobot hozirgi xarajatlarning aniq manzarasini beradi.
definitionEn: correct in all details, with no errors

exampleEn: It's hard to find reliable sources on this topic.
exampleRu: Трудно найти надёжные источники по этой теме.
exampleUz: Bu mavzu bo'yicha ishonchli manbalarni topish qiyin.
definitionEn: consistently good in quality and able to be trusted

exampleEn: The population has gradually declined over the past decade.
exampleRu: Население постепенно сокращалось на протяжении последнего десятилетия.
exampleUz: Aholi soni so'nggi o'n yil ichida asta-sekin kamayib bordi.
definitionEn: happening slowly over a long period of time

exampleEn: The author emphasizes the need for stricter regulation.
exampleRu: Автор подчёркивает необходимость более строгого регулирования.
exampleUz: Muallif qattiqroq tartibga solish zarurligini ta'kidlaydi.
definitionEn: to give special importance to something

exampleEn: The outcome of the trial surprised many observers.
exampleRu: Итог судебного процесса удивил многих наблюдателей.
exampleUz: Sud jarayonining natijasi ko'plab kuzatuvchilarni hayratda qoldirdi.
definitionEn: the way a thing turns out; a result

exampleEn: The article offers a fresh perspective on an old debate.
exampleRu: Статья предлагает новый взгляд на старый спор.
exampleUz: Maqola eski bahsga yangi nuqtai nazar taklif qiladi.
definitionEn: a particular attitude toward or way of regarding something

exampleEn: The company struggled to justify the price increase to customers.
exampleRu: Компании было трудно обосновать повышение цен перед клиентами.
exampleUz: Kompaniya narx oshishini mijozlarga asoslashda qiynaldi.
definitionEn: to show or prove that something is reasonable

exampleEn: There's a growing tendency to work from home.
exampleRu: Наблюдается растущая тенденция к работе из дома.
exampleUz: Uydan turib ishlashga bo'lgan moyillik kuchayib bormoqda.
definitionEn: a habit or way of behaving that is likely to happen

exampleEn: The proposal was rejected and subsequently revised.
exampleRu: Предложение было отклонено, а впоследствии пересмотрено.
exampleUz: Taklif rad etildi va keyinchalik qayta ko'rib chiqildi.
definitionEn: after something else has happened; later

exampleEn: On the other hand, remote work can make collaboration harder.
exampleRu: С другой стороны, удалённая работа может усложнить сотрудничество.
exampleUz: Boshqa tomondan, masofadan ishlash hamkorlikni qiyinlashtirishi mumkin.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce a contrasting point of view

exampleEn: Many cities, for instance, have introduced bike-sharing schemes.
exampleRu: Многие города, например, ввели программы проката велосипедов.
exampleUz: Ko'plab shaharlar, masalan, velosiped ijarasi dasturlarini joriy qildi.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce a specific example

exampleEn: Prices rose sharply; as a result, sales fell.
exampleRu: Цены резко выросли; в результате продажи упали.
exampleUz: Narxlar keskin oshdi; natijada savdo tushib ketdi.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to show the effect of something just mentioned

exampleEn: In my opinion, the benefits outweigh the risks.
exampleRu: По моему мнению, преимущества перевешивают риски.
exampleUz: Mening fikrimcha, foydalari xavflardan ustun.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce a personal viewpoint

exampleEn: To sum up, both sides make valid points worth considering.
exampleRu: Подводя итог, обе стороны приводят весомые аргументы, заслуживающие внимания.
exampleUz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, ikkala tomon ham e'tiborga loyiq dalillar keltiradi.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce a brief summary of what has been said

exampleEn: Despite this, many people still prefer printed books.
exampleRu: Несмотря на это, многие люди по-прежнему предпочитают печатные книги.
exampleUz: Shunga qaramay, ko'p odamlar hali ham bosma kitoblarni afzal ko'rishadi.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce a contrast with what was just said

exampleEn: It is worth noting that the survey only included adults.
exampleRu: Стоит отметить, что в опросе участвовали только взрослые.
exampleUz: Shuni ta'kidlash joizki, so'rovda faqat kattalar qatnashgan.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to draw attention to an important detail

exampleEn: With regard to funding, the committee has not yet reached a decision.
exampleRu: Что касается финансирования, комитет ещё не принял решение.
exampleUz: Moliyalashtirishga nisbatan, qo'mita hali qaror qabul qilmadi.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce the subject being discussed

exampleEn: As far as I know, the store closes at nine.
exampleRu: Насколько мне известно, магазин закрывается в девять.
exampleUz: Bilishimcha, do'kon soat to'qqizda yopiladi.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to say what you believe is true, without being completely sure

exampleEn: I couldn't agree more — that's exactly how I feel about it too.
exampleRu: Полностью согласен — именно так я и думаю по этому поводу.
exampleUz: Butunlay qo'shilaman — men ham xuddi shunday fikrdaman.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to express strong agreement

exampleEn: That reminds me of a trip I took a few years ago.
exampleRu: Это напоминает мне о поездке, которую я совершил несколько лет назад.
exampleUz: Bu menga bir necha yil oldingi sayohatimni eslatadi.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce a related memory or association

word: let me put it this way
transcription: let miː pʊt ɪt ðɪs weɪ
exampleEn: Let me put it this way: without practice, fluency is impossible.
exampleRu: Позвольте выразить это так: без практики беглость речи невозможна.
exampleUz: Shunday deyman: mashqsiz erkin gapirish mumkin emas.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce a clearer or simpler explanation

exampleEn: Whether I go depends on the weather forecast.
exampleRu: Пойду ли я, зависит от прогноза погоды.
exampleUz: Boraman-bormasligim ob-havo bashoratiga bog'liq.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to say that something is decided by a particular factor

exampleEn: To be fair, he did warn us that the road was closed.
exampleRu: Если быть справедливым, он действительно предупредил нас, что дорога закрыта.
exampleUz: Insofan aytganda, u yo'l yopiqligi haqida bizni ogohlantirgan edi.
synonyms: to give credit where it's due
definitionEn: (phrase) used to introduce a balanced or fair point

translation: я понимаю, что вы имеете в виду
exampleEn: I see what you mean, but I still think we should wait.
exampleRu: Я понимаю, что вы имеете в виду, но всё же считаю, что нам стоит подождать.
exampleUz: Nimani nazarda tutayotganingizni tushunaman, lekin baribir kutishimiz kerak deb o'ylayman.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to show you understand someone's point, even if you disagree

word: off the top of my head
transcription: ɒf ðə tɒp ɒv maɪ hed
exampleEn: Off the top of my head, I can think of at least three examples.
exampleRu: Навскидку я могу вспомнить как минимум три примера.
exampleUz: Darrov esimga kelgani, kamida uchta misolni aytib bera olaman.
definitionEn: (phrase) used to say something is said from memory, without checking facts

exampleEn: The scientist tested her hypothesis in the lab.
exampleRu: Учёная проверила свою гипотезу в лаборатории.
exampleUz: Olima o'z gipotezasini laboratoriyada tekshirdi.
definitionEn: an idea suggested as an explanation, to be tested by further evidence

exampleEn: They conducted an experiment to test the reaction.
exampleRu: Они провели эксперимент, чтобы проверить реакцию.
exampleUz: Ular reaksiyani tekshirish uchun tajriba o'tkazdilar.
definitionEn: a scientific procedure carried out to test a hypothesis

exampleEn: There is strong evidence supporting the theory.
exampleRu: Есть веские доказательства в поддержку теории.
exampleUz: Nazariyani qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan kuchli dalillar bor.
definitionEn: facts or information that show whether something is true

exampleEn: Medical innovation has saved millions of lives.
exampleRu: Медицинские инновации спасли миллионы жизней.
exampleUz: Tibbiy innovatsiya millionlab hayotlarni saqlab qoldi.
definitionEn: a new idea, method, or device

exampleEn: Genetic research has advanced rapidly this decade.
exampleRu: Генетические исследования быстро развивались в этом десятилетии.
exampleUz: Genetik tadqiqotlar bu o'n yillikda tez rivojlandi.
definitionEn: relating to genes or heredity

exampleEn: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work.
exampleRu: Искусственный интеллект меняет то, как мы работаем.
exampleUz: Sun'iy intellekt biz ishlash usulimizni o'zgartirmoqda.
definitionEn: computer systems able to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence

exampleEn: The researchers analyzed the data carefully.
exampleRu: Исследователи тщательно проанализировали данные.
exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar ma'lumotlarni diqqat bilan tahlil qildilar.
definitionEn: facts and statistics collected for reference or analysis

exampleEn: Scientists announced a major breakthrough in cancer treatment.
exampleRu: Учёные объявили о крупном прорыве в лечении рака.
exampleUz: Olimlar saraton davolashda katta yutuqni e'lon qildilar.
definitionEn: a sudden important discovery or development

exampleEn: The theory of evolution is widely accepted by scientists.
exampleRu: Теория эволюции широко признана учёными.
exampleUz: Evolyutsiya nazariyasi olimlar tomonidan keng qabul qilingan.
definitionEn: a system of ideas explaining something, based on general principles

exampleEn: The samples were sent to a laboratory for analysis.
exampleRu: Образцы были отправлены в лабораторию для анализа.
exampleUz: Namunalar tahlil uchun laboratoriyaga yuborildi.
definitionEn: a room or building for scientific research or experiments

exampleEn: The company invested in sustainable energy sources.
exampleRu: Компания инвестировала в устойчивые источники энергии.
exampleUz: Kompaniya barqaror energiya manbalariga sarmoya kiritdi.
definitionEn: able to continue over time without depleting resources or harming the environment

exampleEn: The app uses an algorithm to recommend videos.
exampleRu: Приложение использует алгоритм для рекомендации видео.
exampleUz: Ilova videolarni tavsiya qilish uchun algoritmdan foydalanadi.
definitionEn: a set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem

exampleEn: Scientists successfully cloned the sheep named Dolly.
exampleRu: Учёные успешно клонировали овцу по имени Долли.
exampleUz: Olimlar Dolli ismli qo'yni muvaffaqiyatli klonladilar.
definitionEn: to produce an identical copy of a living organism

exampleEn: Solar and wind are renewable sources of energy.
exampleRu: Солнце и ветер — возобновляемые источники энергии.
exampleUz: Quyosh va shamol qayta tiklanadigan energiya manbalaridir.
definitionEn: a natural resource that is not depleted when used

exampleEn: She examined the cells under a microscope.
exampleRu: Она рассмотрела клетки под микроскопом.
exampleUz: U hujayralarni mikroskop ostida ko'rib chiqdi.
definitionEn: an instrument used to view very small objects

exampleEn: The outcome of the trial surprised everyone.
exampleRu: Результат испытания удивил всех.
exampleUz: Sinov natijasi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
definitionEn: the way a thing turns out; a result

exampleEn: Climate change is a global phenomenon.
exampleRu: Изменение климата — глобальное явление.
exampleUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi global hodisadir.
definitionEn: a fact or situation observed to exist or happen

exampleEn: The rate of crime has decreased in the city.
exampleRu: Уровень преступности в городе снизился.
exampleUz: Shaharda jinoyatchilik darajasi pasaydi.
definitionEn: an action that is against the law

exampleEn: The police found no evidence at the crime scene.
exampleRu: Полиция не нашла улик на месте преступления.
exampleUz: Politsiya jinoyat sodir bo'lgan joyda dalil topmadi.
definitionEn: information used in court to prove or disprove a fact

exampleEn: The witness described exactly what she saw.
exampleRu: Свидетель точно описала то, что видела.
exampleUz: Guvoh o'zi ko'rgan narsani aniq tasvirlab berdi.
definitionEn: a person who sees an event happen, especially a crime

exampleEn: The jury reached a verdict after six hours.
exampleRu: Присяжные вынесли вердикт через шесть часов.
exampleUz: Hakamlar hay'ati olti soatdan so'ng qaror chiqardi.
definitionEn: a decision on a disputed issue in a legal case

exampleEn: The company faced a lawsuit over unpaid wages.
exampleRu: Компания столкнулась с иском из-за невыплаченной зарплаты.
exampleUz: Kompaniya to'lanmagan ish haqi uchun sud da'vosiga duch keldi.
definitionEn: a claim brought to a court of law

exampleEn: He was arrested for theft of a bicycle.
exampleRu: Его арестовали за кражу велосипеда.
exampleUz: U velosiped o'g'irlagani uchun hibsga olindi.
definitionEn: the act of stealing something

exampleEn: She was found guilty of financial fraud.
exampleRu: Её признали виновной в финансовом мошенничестве.
exampleUz: U moliyaviy firibgarlikda aybdor deb topildi.
definitionEn: wrongful or criminal deception intended to result in gain

exampleEn: New regulations require companies to reduce emissions.
exampleRu: Новые правила требуют от компаний сократить выбросы.
exampleUz: Yangi qoidalar kompaniyalardan chiqindilarni kamaytirishni talab qiladi.
definitionEn: an official rule or directive made by an authority

exampleEn: The victims demanded justice for the crime.
exampleRu: Жертвы требовали правосудия за преступление.
exampleUz: Jabrlanuvchilar jinoyat uchun adolat talab qilishdi.
definitionEn: fair treatment or the administration of the law

exampleEn: The suspect was questioned for several hours.
exampleRu: Подозреваемого допрашивали несколько часов.
exampleUz: Gumon qilinuvchi bir necha soat davomida so'roq qilindi.
definitionEn: a person thought to be guilty of a crime

exampleEn: Parliament passed new legislation to protect workers.
exampleRu: Парламент принял новое законодательство для защиты рабочих.
exampleUz: Parlament ishchilarni himoya qilish uchun yangi qonun qabul qildi.
definitionEn: laws considered collectively

exampleEn: There is a heavy penalty for tax evasion.
exampleRu: За уклонение от уплаты налогов предусмотрено суровое наказание.
exampleUz: Soliqdan bo'yin tovlash uchun og'ir jazo bor.
definitionEn: a punishment for breaking a law or rule

exampleEn: The victim was taken to hospital immediately.
exampleRu: Жертву немедленно доставили в больницу.
exampleUz: Qurbon zudlik bilan kasalxonaga olib borildi.
definitionEn: a person harmed by a crime or event

exampleEn: The man was arrested at the airport.
exampleRu: Мужчину арестовали в аэропорту.
exampleUz: Erkak aeroportda hibsga olindi.
definitionEn: to take someone into custody by legal authority

exampleEn: The case will go to court next month.
exampleRu: Дело будет рассматриваться в суде в следующем месяце.
exampleUz: Ish keyingi oyda sudda ko'rib chiqiladi.
definitionEn: a place where legal cases are heard and decided

exampleEn: The company was prosecuted for pollution violations.
exampleRu: Компанию привлекли к суду за нарушение экологических норм.
exampleUz: Kompaniya ifloslanish qoidabuzarliklari uchun sudga berildi.
definitionEn: to institute legal proceedings against someone

exampleEn: The juvenile justice system focuses on rehabilitation.
exampleRu: Система правосудия для несовершеннолетних сосредоточена на реабилитации.
exampleUz: Voyaga yetmaganlar uchun sud tizimi reabilitatsiyaga qaratilgan.
definitionEn: relating to young people who are not yet adults

exampleEn: The official was charged with bribery.
exampleRu: Чиновника обвинили во взяточничестве.
exampleUz: Amaldor poraxo'rlikda ayblandi.
definitionEn: the act of offering money to influence someone illegally

exampleEn: The media covered the election closely.
exampleRu: СМИ пристально освещали выборы.
exampleUz: OAV saylovni diqqat bilan yoritdi.
definitionEn: the main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, internet)

exampleEn: The film faced censorship in several countries.
exampleRu: Фильм столкнулся с цензурой в нескольких странах.
exampleUz: Film bir qancha davlatlarda senzuraga duch keldi.
definitionEn: the suppression of speech or public communication seen as objectionable

exampleEn: The match will be broadcast live tonight.
exampleRu: Матч будет транслироваться в прямом эфире сегодня вечером.
exampleUz: O'yin bugun kechqurun jonli efirda ko'rsatiladi.
definitionEn: to transmit a program on television or radio

exampleEn: The story made headlines around the world.
exampleRu: Эта история попала в заголовки по всему миру.
exampleUz: Bu voqea butun dunyo bo'ylab sarlavhalarga chiqdi.
definitionEn: the title given to a newspaper article, printed in large letters

exampleEn: The brand hired an influencer to promote its products.
exampleRu: Бренд нанял инфлюенсера для продвижения своих товаров.
exampleUz: Brend o'z mahsulotlarini reklama qilish uchun influenser yolladi.
definitionEn: a person who has the power to affect others' buying habits via social media

exampleEn: Misinformation spread quickly on social media.
exampleRu: Дезинформация быстро распространилась в социальных сетях.
exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda noto'g'ri ma'lumot tez tarqaldi.
definitionEn: false or inaccurate information spread regardless of intent to deceive

exampleEn: The old town is protected as cultural heritage.
exampleRu: Старый город охраняется как культурное наследие.
exampleUz: Eski shahar madaniy meros sifatida himoya qilinadi.
definitionEn: features belonging to the culture of a particular society, handed down from the past

exampleEn: The government censored parts of the report.
exampleRu: Правительство подвергло цензуре части доклада.
exampleUz: Hukumat hisobotning bir qismini senzura qildi.
definitionEn: to examine and remove unacceptable parts of a publication or broadcast

exampleEn: It's a tradition to gather with family during the holidays.
exampleRu: Это традиция — собираться с семьёй на праздники.
exampleUz: Bayramlarda oila bilan yig'ilish an'anaviy hisoblanadi.
definitionEn: a belief or custom passed down within a society

exampleEn: The movie challenges common stereotypes.
exampleRu: Фильм бросает вызов распространённым стереотипам.
exampleUz: Film keng tarqalgan stereotiplarga qarshi chiqadi.
definitionEn: a widely held but oversimplified idea of a type of person or thing

exampleEn: Globalization has connected economies around the world.
exampleRu: Глобализация связала экономики по всему миру.
exampleUz: Globallashuv butun dunyo iqtisodiyotlarini bog'lab qo'ydi.
definitionEn: the process by which businesses and cultures become interconnected worldwide

exampleEn: The critic's censorious review upset the director.
exampleRu: Придирчивая рецензия критика расстроила режиссёра.
exampleUz: Tanqidchining ayblovchi sharhi rejissyorni xafa qildi.
definitionEn: harshly critical of others

exampleEn: The channel gained a million subscribers this year.
exampleRu: Канал набрал миллион подписчиков в этом году.
exampleUz: Kanal bu yil million obunachi to'pladi.
definitionEn: a person who has agreed to receive or view a publication or service regularly

exampleEn: The video went viral within hours.
exampleRu: Видео стало вирусным за несколько часов.
exampleUz: Video bir necha soat ichida virusli tarzda tarqaldi.
definitionEn: circulated rapidly and widely on the internet

exampleEn: The regime used propaganda to control public opinion.
exampleRu: Режим использовал пропаганду для контроля общественного мнения.
exampleUz: Rejim jamoatchilik fikrini nazorat qilish uchun targ'ibotdan foydalandi.
definitionEn: information, especially biased, used to promote a political cause or viewpoint

exampleEn: We watched a documentary about ocean life.
exampleRu: Мы посмотрели документальный фильм об океанской жизни.
exampleUz: Biz okean hayoti haqida hujjatli film ko'rdik.
definitionEn: a non-fiction film presenting factual information

exampleEn: She had a strict upbringing in a small village.
exampleRu: Она получила строгое воспитание в маленькой деревне.
exampleUz: U kichik qishloqda qattiq tarbiya oldi.
definitionEn: the treatment and instruction received by a child from their parents

exampleEn: She has three siblings, all younger than her.
exampleRu: У неё трое братьев и сестёр, все младше неё.
exampleUz: Uning uchta aka-ukasi bor, hammasi undan yosh.
definitionEn: a brother or sister

exampleEn: They formed a close bond during childhood.
exampleRu: Они образовали тесную связь в детстве.
exampleUz: Ular bolalikda yaqin aloqa o'rnatishdi.
definitionEn: a close connection joining two or more people

exampleEn: Parents should nurture their children's confidence.
exampleRu: Родители должны взращивать уверенность своих детей.
exampleUz: Ota-onalar farzandlarining o'ziga ishonchini tarbiyalashi kerak.
definitionEn: to care for and encourage the growth or development of someone

exampleEn: His extended family gathers every summer.
exampleRu: Его расширенная семья собирается каждое лето.
exampleUz: Uning katta oilasi har yozda yig'iladi.
definitionEn: a family that extends beyond the immediate one to include relatives

exampleEn: There's a generation gap between grandparents and grandchildren.
exampleRu: Между бабушками/дедушками и внуками существует разрыв поколений.
exampleUz: Bobo-buvi va nabiralar o'rtasida avlodlar tafovuti bor.
definitionEn: a difference in attitudes between people of different generations

exampleEn: The average household spends more on rent than food.
exampleRu: В среднем домохозяйство тратит на аренду больше, чем на еду.
exampleUz: O'rtacha xonadon ijaraga oziq-ovqatdan ko'proq sarflaydi.
definitionEn: a house and its occupants regarded as a unit

exampleEn: She is financially dependent on her parents.
exampleRu: Она финансово зависит от родителей.
exampleUz: U moliyaviy jihatdan ota-onasiga qaram.
definitionEn: relying on someone else for financial or emotional support

exampleEn: He has been estranged from his father for years.
exampleRu: Он много лет отчуждён от отца.
exampleUz: U yillar davomida otasidan begonalashgan.
definitionEn: no longer close or connected to someone, especially a family member

exampleEn: She gets along well with her in-laws.
exampleRu: Она хорошо ладит со своими родственниками со стороны мужа.
exampleUz: U qaynona-qaynotasi bilan yaxshi til topishadi.
definitionEn: the relatives of one's husband or wife

exampleEn: The parents shared custody of their children.
exampleRu: Родители делили опеку над детьми.
exampleUz: Ota-onalar farzandlari ustidan vasiylikni bo'lishdi.
definitionEn: the right or duty to care for someone, especially a child

exampleEn: There's a strong resemblance between the brothers.
exampleRu: Между братьями сильное сходство.
exampleUz: Aka-ukalar o'rtasida kuchli o'xshashlik bor.
definitionEn: the state of looking or being similar to someone or something

exampleEn: Her family has always been supportive of her career.
exampleRu: Её семья всегда поддерживала её карьеру.
exampleUz: Uning oilasi doim uning kasbini qo'llab-quvvatlab kelgan.
definitionEn: providing encouragement or emotional help to someone

exampleEn: The nuclear family consists of parents and their children.
exampleRu: Нуклеарная семья состоит из родителей и их детей.
exampleUz: Yadroviy oila ota-ona va ularning farzandlaridan iborat.
definitionEn: a family unit consisting of parents and their children only

exampleEn: They bonded over their shared love of music.
exampleRu: Они сблизились на почве общей любви к музыке.
exampleUz: Ular musiqaga bo'lgan umumiy ishq asosida yaqinlashishdi.
definitionEn: to develop a close relationship because of a shared interest or experience

exampleEn: They took out a mortgage to buy their first house.
exampleRu: Они взяли ипотеку, чтобы купить свой первый дом.
exampleUz: Ular birinchi uylarini sotib olish uchun ipoteka oldilar.
definitionEn: a loan used to buy a house or property, repaid over time

exampleEn: The tenant paid rent on the first of every month.
exampleRu: Арендатор платил арендную плату первого числа каждого месяца.
exampleUz: Ijarachi har oyning birinchi kunida ijara haqini to'lardi.
definitionEn: a person who rents land or property from a landlord

exampleEn: The landlord refused to fix the leaking roof.
exampleRu: Арендодатель отказался чинить протекающую крышу.
exampleUz: Uy egasi tomdagi oqishni tuzatishdan bosh tortdi.
definitionEn: a person who owns and rents out land or property

exampleEn: They moved to a quiet suburb outside the city.
exampleRu: Они переехали в тихий пригород за пределами города.
exampleUz: Ular shahar tashqarisidagi tinch bir hududga ko'chib o'tishdi.
definitionEn: a residential district on the outskirts of a city

exampleEn: Affordable housing is scarce in big cities.
exampleRu: Доступное жильё — редкость в больших городах.
exampleUz: Katta shaharlarda hamyonbop uy-joy kamyob.
definitionEn: not expensive; able to be bought without financial difficulty

exampleEn: Property prices have risen sharply this year.
exampleRu: Цены на недвижимость резко выросли в этом году.
exampleUz: Bu yil mulk narxlari keskin oshdi.
definitionEn: a building or land, usually owned by someone

exampleEn: They renovated the old kitchen last spring.
exampleRu: Прошлой весной они отремонтировали старую кухню.
exampleUz: O'tgan bahorda ular eski oshxonani ta'mirlashdi.
definitionEn: to restore or improve a building by repairing or updating it

exampleEn: The family faced eviction after missing rent payments.
exampleRu: Семья столкнулась с выселением после пропущенных платежей за аренду.
exampleUz: Oila ijara to'lovlarini o'tkazib yuborgani uchun ko'chirilish xavfiga duch keldi.
definitionEn: the process of officially forcing someone to leave a property

exampleEn: The area is mostly residential, with few shops.
exampleRu: Район преимущественно жилой, с небольшим количеством магазинов.
exampleUz: Hudud asosan turar-joy, do'konlar kam.
definitionEn: designed for people to live in, rather than for offices or shops

exampleEn: Many families live in overcrowded apartments.
exampleRu: Многие семьи живут в переполненных квартирах.
exampleUz: Ko'pgina oilalar haddan tashqari to'lgan kvartiralarda yashaydi.
definitionEn: having too many people or things in a space

exampleEn: The city opened a new shelter for homeless people.
exampleRu: Город открыл новый приют для бездомных.
exampleUz: Shahar uysizlar uchun yangi boshpana ochdi.
definitionEn: having no home, especially due to poverty

exampleEn: It's a friendly neighborhood with lots of parks.
exampleRu: Это дружелюбный район с множеством парков.
exampleUz: Bu ko'plab bog'lari bo'lgan do'stona mahalla.
definitionEn: a district within a town or city

exampleEn: Utility bills increased after the cold winter.
exampleRu: Коммунальные платежи выросли после холодной зимы.
exampleUz: Sovuq qishdan keyin kommunal to'lovlar oshdi.
definitionEn: regular payments for services like water, electricity, and gas

exampleEn: They signed a two-year lease on the apartment.
exampleRu: Они подписали двухлетний договор аренды квартиры.
exampleUz: Ular kvartira uchun ikki yillik ijara shartnomasini imzoladilar.
definitionEn: a legal agreement to rent property for a fixed period

exampleEn: They rented a fully furnished apartment near the university.
exampleRu: Они сняли полностью меблированную квартиру рядом с университетом.
exampleUz: Ular universitet yaqinida to'liq jihozlangan kvartira ijaraga oldilar.
definitionEn: provided with furniture

exampleEn: The graph shows a dramatic increase in oil prices between 2010 and 2015.
exampleRu: График показывает резкий рост цен на нефть в период с 2010 по 2015 год.
exampleUz: Grafik 2010–2015-yillar oralig'ida neft narxining keskin o'sishini ko'rsatadi.
synonyms: a sharp rise, a significant surge, a steep growth
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: a sharp rise, a significant surge, a steep growth.

exampleEn: Sales plunged sharply after the new tax policy was introduced.
exampleRu: Продажи резко упали после введения новой налоговой политики.
exampleUz: Yangi soliq siyosati joriy etilgandan so'ng savdo keskin pasayib ketdi.
synonyms: to plummet, to nosedive, to fall sharply
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to plummet, to nosedive, to fall sharply.

exampleEn: After a period of rapid growth, the population plateaued at around ten million.
exampleRu: После периода быстрого роста численность населения стабилизировалась на уровне около десяти миллионов.
exampleUz: Tez o'sish davridan so'ng aholi soni taxminan o'n millionda barqarorlashdi.
synonyms: to level off, to stabilize, to remain steady
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to level off, to stabilize, to remain steady.

exampleEn: Consumer spending reached a peak in December before declining sharply.
exampleRu: Потребительские расходы достигли пика в декабре, прежде чем резко снизиться.
exampleUz: Iste'molchilar xarajatlari dekabr oyida eng yuqori nuqtaga yetdi, so'ngra keskin pasaydi.
synonyms: to hit a high point, to peak at, to top out
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to hit a high point, to peak at, to top out.

exampleEn: China's exports surpassed those of the United States for the first time in 2007.
exampleRu: Экспорт Китая впервые превзошёл экспорт США в 2007 году.
exampleUz: 2007-yilda Xitoy eksporti birinchi marta AQSh eksportidan oshib ketdi.
synonyms: to exceed, to overtake, to outstrip
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to exceed, to overtake, to outstrip.

exampleEn: Carbon emissions in the region exceeded the national average by 15%.
exampleRu: Выбросы углерода в регионе превысили средний по стране показатель на 15%.
exampleUz: Mintaqadagi uglerod chiqindilari milliy o'rtacha ko'rsatkichdan 15% ga oshib ketdi.
synonyms: to surpass, to go beyond, to overshoot
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to surpass, to go beyond, to overshoot.

exampleEn: There was a steady rise in university enrolments over the given period.
exampleRu: За указанный период наблюдался устойчивый рост числа поступающих в университеты.
exampleUz: Berilgan davr ichida universitetga qabul qilinganlar sonining barqaror o'sishi kuzatildi.
synonyms: a gradual increase, a consistent growth, an upward trend
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: a gradual increase, a consistent growth, an upward trend.

exampleEn: There was a slight decline in birth rates between 2018 and 2019.
exampleRu: В период с 2018 по 2019 год наблюдалось незначительное снижение рождаемости.
exampleUz: 2018–2019-yillar oralig'ida tug'ilish darajasining sezilarsiz pasayishi kuzatildi.
synonyms: a marginal drop, a slight dip, a minor decrease
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: a marginal drop, a slight dip, a minor decrease.

exampleEn: The literacy rate remained constant at approximately 98% throughout the period shown.
exampleRu: Уровень грамотности оставался неизменным на уровне примерно 98% на протяжении всего показанного периода.
exampleUz: Savodxonlik darajasi ko'rsatilgan davr davomida taxminan 98% da o'zgarishsiz qoldi.
synonyms: to stay stable, to hold steady, to show no change
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to stay stable, to hold steady, to show no change.

exampleEn: Climate change remains a pressing issue that governments can no longer afford to ignore.
exampleRu: Изменение климата остаётся насущной проблемой, которую правительства больше не могут игнорировать.
exampleUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi hukumatlar endi e'tiborsiz qoldira olmaydigan dolzarb muammo bo'lib qolmoqda.
synonyms: an urgent matter, a critical concern, a burning issue
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: an urgent matter, a critical concern, a burning issue.

exampleEn: Excessive screen time can have a detrimental effect on children's social development.
exampleRu: Чрезмерное время у экрана может оказывать пагубное воздействие на социальное развитие детей.
exampleUz: Ekran vaqtining haddan tashqari ko'pligi bolalarning ijtimoiy rivojlanishiga zararli ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.
synonyms: a harmful impact, an adverse effect, a damaging consequence
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: a harmful impact, an adverse effect, a damaging consequence.

exampleEn: Education plays a pivotal role in reducing income inequality across generations.
exampleRu: Образование играет ключевую роль в снижении неравенства доходов между поколениями.
exampleUz: Ta'lim avlodlar o'rtasidagi daromad tengsizligini kamaytirishda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynaydi.
synonyms: is instrumental in, is central to, plays a crucial part
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: is instrumental in, is central to, plays a crucial part.

exampleEn: Public transport usage has substantially increased since the new subway line opened.
exampleRu: Использование общественного транспорта существенно возросло после открытия новой линии метро.
exampleUz: Yangi metro liniyasi ochilgandan so'ng jamoat transportidan foydalanish sezilarli darajada oshdi.
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: considerably, significantly, markedly.

exampleEn: Corruption undermines public trust in democratic institutions.
exampleRu: Коррупция подрывает общественное доверие к демократическим институтам.
exampleUz: Korrupsiya demokratik institutlarga bo'lgan ijtimoiy ishonchga putur yetkazadi.
synonyms: to erode, to weaken, to jeopardize
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: to erode, to weaken, to jeopardize.

exampleEn: It is widely acknowledged that early childhood education has lasting cognitive benefits.
exampleRu: Широко признано, что образование в раннем детстве даёт долгосрочные когнитивные преимущества.
exampleUz: Erta bolalik ta'limi uzoq muddatli kognitiv foyda berishi keng tan olingan.
synonyms: it is generally accepted, it is a well-established fact, there is broad consensus that
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: it is generally accepted, it is a well-established fact, there is broad consensus that.

exampleEn: Social media is a double-edged sword: it connects people but also spreads misinformation.
exampleRu: Социальные сети — это палка о двух концах: они объединяют людей, но также распространяют дезинформацию.
exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ikki tomonlama pichoq kabidir: odamlarni bog'laydi, lekin noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarni ham tarqatadi.
synonyms: a mixed blessing, a two-sided phenomenon, a paradox
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: a mixed blessing, a two-sided phenomenon, a paradox.

exampleEn: The passage explores whether truly autonomous decision-making is possible for artificial intelligence.
exampleRu: В тексте рассматривается, возможно ли по-настоящему автономное принятие решений для искусственного интеллекта.
exampleUz: Matnda sun'iy intellekt uchun haqiqiy avtonom qaror qabul qilish mumkinmi degan masala tahlil qilinadi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: self-governing, independent, self-directed.

exampleEn: The researchers conducted a meticulous analysis of the archaeological data before drawing any conclusions.
exampleRu: Исследователи провели скрупулёзный анализ археологических данных, прежде чем сделать какие-либо выводы.
exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar biror xulosaga kelishdan oldin arxeologik ma'lumotlarni puxta tahlil qilishdi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: thorough, painstaking, rigorous.

exampleEn: The article attributes the conflict to the growing scarcity of freshwater resources.
exampleRu: В статье конфликт объясняется растущим дефицитом ресурсов пресной воды.
exampleUz: Maqolada mojaro chuchuk suv resurslarining tobora tanqisligi bilan izohlanadi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: shortage, deficiency, dearth.

exampleEn: Rather than adhering to ideology, the policymakers adopted a pragmatic approach to reform.
exampleRu: Вместо того чтобы следовать идеологии, политики выбрали прагматичный подход к реформе.
exampleUz: Siyosatchilar mafkuraga sodiq qolish o'rniga islohotga pragmatik yondashuvni tanladilar.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: practical, realistic, sensible.

exampleEn: Many argue that traditional manufacturing jobs will soon become obsolete due to automation.
exampleRu: Многие утверждают, что традиционные рабочие места в производстве вскоре станут устаревшими из-за автоматизации.
exampleUz: Ko'pchilik an'anaviy ishlab chiqarish ish o'rinlari avtomatlashtirish tufayli tez orada eskirib qolishini ta'kidlaydi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: outdated, outmoded, defunct.

exampleEn: The influence of consumer culture is so pervasive that it shapes even our sense of identity.
exampleRu: Влияние потребительской культуры настолько повсеместно, что формирует даже наше чувство идентичности.
exampleUz: Iste'mol madaniyatining ta'siri shu qadar keng tarqalganki, hatto bizning o'zlikni his qilishimizni ham shakllantiradi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: widespread, ubiquitous, prevalent.

exampleEn: The debate centres on whether language acquisition is an innate ability or a learned skill.
exampleRu: Дискуссия сосредоточена на том, является ли овладение языком врождённой способностью или приобретённым навыком.
exampleUz: Munozara tilni egallash tug'ma qobiliyatmi yoki o'rganilgan ko'nikmami degan masalaga qaratilgan.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: inborn, inherent, instinctive.

exampleEn: To wrap up, I'd say that while remote work has its challenges, the benefits generally outweigh them.
exampleRu: Подводя итог, я бы сказал, что, хотя удалённая работа имеет свои трудности, преимущества в целом их перевешивают.
exampleUz: Yakunlab aytganda, masofaviy ishning qiyinchiliklari bo'lsa-da, uning foydalari ularni umuman qoplaydi deb aytgan bo'lardim.
synonyms: to sum up, in conclusion, to bring it all together
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: to sum up, in conclusion, to bring it all together.

exampleEn: To put it simply, people today value experiences more than material possessions.
exampleRu: Проще говоря, сегодня люди ценят впечатления больше, чем материальные вещи.
exampleUz: Sodda qilib aytganda, bugungi odamlar tajribalarni moddiy narsalardan ko'ra ko'proq qadrlashadi.
synonyms: in simple terms, basically, in a nutshell
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: in simple terms, basically, in a nutshell.

exampleEn: The rapid growth of remote work speaks volumes about how priorities have shifted since the pandemic.
exampleRu: Стремительный рост удалённой работы говорит о многом относительно того, как изменились приоритеты после пандемии.
exampleUz: Masofaviy ishning tez o'sishi pandemiyadan keyin ustuvorliklar qanday o'zgarganini ko'p narsada anglatadi.
synonyms: says a lot about, is very telling, reveals a great deal
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: says a lot about, is very telling, reveals a great deal.

exampleEn: It's important to strike a balance between academic pressure and personal well-being.
exampleRu: Важно найти баланс между академическим давлением и личным благополучием.
exampleUz: Akademik bosim va shaxsiy farovonlik o'rtasida muvozanat topish muhimdir.
synonyms: find a middle ground, achieve equilibrium, reach a compromise
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: find a middle ground, achieve equilibrium, reach a compromise.

exampleEn: As a rule of thumb, I'd say the more diverse a city is, the more resilient its economy tends to be.
exampleRu: Как эмпирическое правило, я бы сказал, что чем разнообразнее город, тем устойчивее, как правило, его экономика.
exampleUz: Amaliy qoida sifatida aytadigan bo'lsam, shahar qanchalik xilma-xil bo'lsa, uning iqtisodiyoti shunchalik barqaror bo'ladi.
synonyms: a general guideline, a common principle, a practical standard
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: a general guideline, a common principle, a practical standard.

exampleEn: By and large, I believe governments should invest more heavily in renewable energy.
exampleRu: В целом, я считаю, что правительствам следует активнее инвестировать в возобновляемую энергетику.
exampleUz: Umuman olganda, hukumatlar qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga ko'proq mablag' sarflashi kerak deb hisoblayman.
synonyms: on the whole, generally speaking, for the most part
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: on the whole, generally speaking, for the most part.

exampleEn: That statistic really gives me food for thought about how we consume energy at home.
exampleRu: Эта статистика действительно даёт мне пищу для размышлений о том, как мы потребляем энергию дома.
exampleUz: Bu statistik ma'lumot menga uyimizda energiyani qanday iste'mol qilishimiz haqida chindan ham o'ylantiradigan narsa beradi.
synonyms: something to reflect on, a thought-provoking point, material to consider
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: something to reflect on, a thought-provoking point, material to consider.

exampleEn: On the flip side, working from home can blur the boundaries between personal and professional life.
exampleRu: С другой стороны, работа из дома может размывать границы между личной и профессиональной жизнью.
exampleUz: Boshqa tomondan, uydan ishlash shaxsiy va kasbiy hayot o'rtasidagi chegaralarni xiralashtirishi mumkin.
synonyms: on the other hand, conversely, that said
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: on the other hand, conversely, that said.

exampleEn: Renewable sources constituted just 12% of total energy production in 2005.
exampleRu: Возобновляемые источники составляли лишь 12% от общего объёма производства энергии в 2005 году.
exampleUz: 2005-yilda qayta tiklanadigan manbalar umumiy energiya ishlab chiqarishning atigi 12 foizini tashkil etdi.
synonyms: to make up, to comprise, to form
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to make up, to comprise, to form.

exampleEn: Manufacturing accounted for nearly a third of the country's GDP in that year.
exampleRu: Обрабатывающая промышленность составляла почти треть ВВП страны в тот год.
exampleUz: O'sha yili ishlab chiqarish sanoati mamlakat YaIMning deyarli uchdan bir qismini tashkil etdi.
synonyms: to represent, to make up, to comprise
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to represent, to make up, to comprise.

exampleEn: Public transport accounted for only a negligible fraction of daily commutes in the city.
exampleRu: Общественный транспорт составлял лишь незначительную долю ежедневных поездок в городе.
exampleUz: Jamoat transporti shahardagi kundalik qatnovlarning faqat ahamiyatsiz qismini tashkil etdi.
synonyms: a tiny proportion, an insignificant share, a minimal percentage
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: a tiny proportion, an insignificant share, a minimal percentage.

exampleEn: A significant majority of respondents reported spending more than four hours online daily.
exampleRu: Значительное большинство респондентов сообщили, что проводят в сети более четырёх часов в день.
exampleUz: So'rov qatnashchilarining sezilarli ko'pchiligi kuniga to'rt soatdan ortiq internetda vaqt o'tkazishini ma'lum qildi.
synonyms: the vast majority, an overwhelming proportion, the bulk of
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: the vast majority, an overwhelming proportion, the bulk of.

exampleEn: There was a sharp dip in tourist arrivals during the winter months.
exampleRu: Наблюдался резкий спад числа туристов в зимние месяцы.
exampleUz: Qish oylarida turistlar sonining keskin pasayishi kuzatildi.
synonyms: a steep drop, a sudden decline, a marked fall
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: a steep drop, a sudden decline, a marked fall.

exampleEn: Average wages remained static despite a sharp rise in the cost of living.
exampleRu: Средняя заработная плата оставалась неизменной, несмотря на резкий рост стоимости жизни.
exampleUz: Turmush narxining keskin oshishiga qaramay, o'rtacha ish haqi o'zgarmay qoldi.
synonyms: to stagnate, to stay flat, to show no movement
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to stagnate, to stay flat, to show no movement.

exampleEn: The data reveals only a marginal increase in household savings over the five-year period.
exampleRu: Данные показывают лишь незначительный рост сбережений домохозяйств за пятилетний период.
exampleUz: Ma'lumotlar besh yillik davrda uy xo'jaliklari jamg'armalarining faqat sezilarsiz o'sganini ko'rsatadi.
synonyms: a slight rise, a modest growth, a minimal uptick
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: a slight rise, a modest growth, a minimal uptick.

exampleEn: By 2018, solar power had overtaken coal as the leading source of new electricity capacity.
exampleRu: К 2018 году солнечная энергия обогнала уголь как ведущий источник новых электрических мощностей.
exampleUz: 2018-yilga kelib quyosh energiyasi yangi elektr quvvatining yetakchi manbai sifatida ko'mirni o'zib ketdi.
synonyms: to surpass, to overhaul, to outpace
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: to surpass, to overhaul, to outpace.

translation: быть в два раза выше, чем
exampleEn: Youth unemployment was twice as high as the national average in that region.
exampleRu: Уровень безработицы среди молодёжи был в два раза выше среднего по стране в этом регионе.
exampleUz: Ushbu mintaqada yoshlar orasida ishsizlik darajasi milliy o'rtachadan ikki barobar yuqori edi.
synonyms: double the rate of, twofold higher than, twice the amount of
definitionEn: (Task 1 vocabulary, used to describe trends and data in charts/graphs); similar in meaning to: double the rate of, twofold higher than, twice the amount of.

exampleEn: In light of recent evidence, many scientists have revised their earlier predictions.
exampleRu: В свете последних данных многие учёные пересмотрели свои прежние прогнозы.
exampleUz: So'nggi dalillarni hisobga olgan holda, ko'pgina olimlar avvalgi bashoratlarini qayta ko'rib chiqishdi.
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: given, considering, in view of.

exampleEn: The policy is designed on the premise that individuals respond rationally to financial incentives.
exampleRu: Политика разработана исходя из предположения, что люди рационально реагируют на финансовые стимулы.
exampleUz: Ushbu siyosat shaxslar moliyaviy rag'batlantirishlarga oqilona javob beradi, degan taxmin asosida ishlab chiqilgan.
synonyms: based on the assumption that, on the grounds that, operating under the belief that
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: based on the assumption that, on the grounds that, operating under the belief that.

exampleEn: Overreliance on fossil fuels will only exacerbate the environmental crisis in the coming decades.
exampleRu: Чрезмерная зависимость от ископаемого топлива лишь усугубит экологический кризис в ближайшие десятилетия.
exampleUz: Fosil yoqilg'iga ortiqcha bog'liqlik kelgusi o'n yilliklarda ekologik inqirozni yanada og'irlashtiradi.
synonyms: to aggravate, to worsen, to intensify
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: to aggravate, to worsen, to intensify.

exampleEn: This data underscores the fact that inequality is widening even in wealthy nations.
exampleRu: Эти данные подчёркивают тот факт, что неравенство усиливается даже в богатых странах.
exampleUz: Ushbu ma'lumotlar boy davlatlarda ham tengsizlik kengayib borayotganini ta'kidlaydi.
synonyms: highlights the fact that, reinforces the notion that, confirms that
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: highlights the fact that, reinforces the notion that, confirms that.

exampleEn: Insofar as economic growth improves living standards, it should remain a policy priority.
exampleRu: В той мере, в какой экономический рост улучшает уровень жизни, он должен оставаться приоритетом политики.
exampleUz: Iqtisodiy o'sish turmush darajasini yaxshilar ekan, u siyosiy ustuvorlik bo'lib qolishi kerak.
synonyms: to the extent that, in so much as, provided that
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: to the extent that, in so much as, provided that.

exampleEn: The 2008 financial crisis is a case in point, illustrating how deregulation can backfire.
exampleRu: Финансовый кризис 2008 года — яркий пример того, как дерегулирование может привести к обратным последствиям.
exampleUz: 2008-yilgi moliyaviy inqiroz tartibga solishni bekor qilish qanday teskari natijaga olib kelishini ko'rsatuvchi yorqin misoldir.
synonyms: a clear example, an illustrative instance, a prime example
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: a clear example, an illustrative instance, a prime example.

exampleEn: It could be argued that technological progress creates as many jobs as it destroys.
exampleRu: Можно утверждать, что технологический прогресс создаёт столько же рабочих мест, сколько и уничтожает.
exampleUz: Texnologik taraqqiyot yo'qotgan ish o'rinlaricha yangi ish o'rinlarini ham yaratadi, deb aytish mumkin.
synonyms: one might contend that, it can be maintained that, a case can be made that
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: one might contend that, it can be maintained that, a case can be made that.

word: this is not to say that
transcription: ðɪs ɪz nɒt tuː seɪ ðæt
exampleEn: This is not to say that regulation is unnecessary, but rather that it must be carefully calibrated.
exampleRu: Это не значит, что регулирование не нужно, скорее оно должно быть тщательно выверено.
exampleUz: Bu tartibga solish shart emas degani emas, aksincha u ehtiyotkorlik bilan moslashtirilishi kerak.
synonyms: this does not imply that, it should not be assumed that, however, this does not mean
definitionEn: (Task 2 vocabulary, used to build and support arguments in essays); similar in meaning to: this does not imply that, it should not be assumed that, however, this does not mean.

exampleEn: The passage draws a subtle distinction between correlation and causation.
exampleRu: В тексте проводится тонкое различие между корреляцией и причинностью.
exampleUz: Matnda korrelyatsiya va sabab-oqibat o'rtasidagi nozik farq ko'rsatib o'tiladi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: nuanced, delicate, understated.

exampleEn: The study offers a comprehensive overview of migration patterns across the continent.
exampleRu: Исследование предлагает всесторонний обзор миграционных моделей на континенте.
exampleUz: Tadqiqot qit'a bo'ylab migratsiya modellarining keng qamrovli sharhini taqdim etadi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: thorough, exhaustive, all-encompassing.

exampleEn: The programme was designed to foster critical thinking among secondary school students.
exampleRu: Программа была разработана, чтобы способствовать развитию критического мышления у школьников старших классов.
exampleUz: Dastur o'rta maktab o'quvchilarida tanqidiy fikrlashni rivojlantirish uchun ishlab chiqilgan.
synonyms: to nurture, to cultivate, to promote
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: to nurture, to cultivate, to promote.

exampleEn: Limited access to funding continues to constrain scientific research in the region.
exampleRu: Ограниченный доступ к финансированию продолжает сдерживать научные исследования в регионе.
exampleUz: Mablag'ga cheklangan kirish mintaqadagi ilmiy tadqiqotlarni cheklashda davom etmoqda.
synonyms: to restrict, to limit, to hamper
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: to restrict, to limit, to hamper.

exampleEn: Paradoxically, increased wealth in the region did not translate into greater life satisfaction.
exampleRu: Как ни парадоксально, рост благосостояния в регионе не привёл к повышению удовлетворённости жизнью.
exampleUz: Ajablanarlisi shundaki, mintaqadagi boylikning ortishi hayotdan qoniqish darajasining oshishiga olib kelmadi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: ironically, counterintuitively, surprisingly.

exampleEn: The essay examines the intricate relationship between language and cultural identity.
exampleRu: В эссе рассматривается сложная взаимосвязь между языком и культурной идентичностью.
exampleUz: Insho til va madaniy o'ziga xoslik o'rtasidagi murakkab bog'liqlikni tahlil qiladi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: complex, elaborate, convoluted.

exampleEn: The writer's central assertion is that economic growth alone cannot guarantee well-being.
exampleRu: Главное утверждение автора состоит в том, что один только экономический рост не может гарантировать благополучие.
exampleUz: Muallifning asosiy da'vosi shuki, faqat iqtisodiy o'sish farovonlikni kafolatlay olmaydi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: claim, statement, contention.

exampleEn: Readers must discern the author's underlying assumptions to fully grasp the argument.
exampleRu: Читателям необходимо распознать скрытые предположения автора, чтобы полностью понять аргументацию.
exampleUz: O'quvchilar mulohazani to'liq tushunish uchun muallifning yashirin taxminlarini ilg'ab olishlari kerak.
synonyms: to perceive, to identify, to detect
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: to perceive, to identify, to detect.

exampleEn: Subsequent studies corroborated the initial findings on the drug's side effects.
exampleRu: Последующие исследования подтвердили первоначальные выводы о побочных эффектах препарата.
exampleUz: Keyingi tadqiqotlar dorining yon ta'sirlari haqidagi dastlabki xulosalarni tasdiqladi.
synonyms: to confirm, to substantiate, to validate
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: to confirm, to substantiate, to validate.

exampleEn: The second paragraph attempts to refute the claim made earlier in the passage.
exampleRu: Во втором абзаце предпринимается попытка опровергнуть утверждение, сделанное ранее в тексте.
exampleUz: Ikkinchi paragraf matnda ilgari aytilgan da'voni rad etishga harakat qiladi.
synonyms: to disprove, to rebut, to contradict
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: to disprove, to rebut, to contradict.

exampleEn: Critics argue that the link between the two variables is tenuous at best.
exampleRu: Критики утверждают, что связь между этими двумя переменными в лучшем случае весьма шаткая.
exampleUz: Tanqidchilar ikki o'zgaruvchi orasidagi bog'liqlik yaxshi holatda ham juda zaif ekanligini ta'kidlaydi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: weak, flimsy, shaky.

exampleEn: The report is based on empirical evidence gathered from over 50 field studies.
exampleRu: Отчёт основан на эмпирических данных, собранных в ходе более чем 50 полевых исследований.
exampleUz: Hisobot 50 dan ortiq dala tadqiqotlaridan to'plangan tajribaviy dalillarga asoslanadi.
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: evidence-based, observational, experimental.

exampleEn: The passage challenges the simple dichotomy between nature and nurture.
exampleRu: В тексте оспаривается простое противопоставление природы и воспитания.
exampleUz: Matn tabiat va tarbiya o'rtasidagi soddalashtirilgan ikki qutblilikka shubha bildiradi.
synonyms: a division, a contrast, a binary opposition
definitionEn: (academic vocabulary commonly found in IELTS Reading passages); similar in meaning to: a division, a contrast, a binary opposition.

translation: что касается меня, по моему мнению
exampleEn: As far as I'm concerned, public libraries are more relevant today than ever before.
exampleRu: Что касается меня, публичные библиотеки актуальны сегодня как никогда прежде.
exampleUz: Menimcha, jamoat kutubxonalari bugungi kunda avvalgidan ham dolzarbroq.
synonyms: in my view, personally, from my perspective
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: in my view, personally, from my perspective.

exampleEn: To be completely frank, I don't think the current exam system measures real ability.
exampleRu: Если совсем откровенно, я не думаю, что нынешняя система экзаменов измеряет реальные способности.
exampleUz: To'g'risini aytganda, hozirgi imtihon tizimi haqiqiy qobiliyatni o'lchaydi deb o'ylamayman.
synonyms: quite honestly, to be blunt, candidly speaking
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: quite honestly, to be blunt, candidly speaking.

exampleEn: That brings me to my next point — the role of parents in shaping children's habits.
exampleRu: Это подводит меня к следующему пункту — роли родителей в формировании привычек детей.
exampleUz: Bu meni keyingi fikrimga — ota-onalarning bolalar odatlarini shakllantirishdagi roliga olib keladi.
synonyms: which leads me to, this brings us to, moving on to
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: which leads me to, this brings us to, moving on to.

exampleEn: It goes without saying that access to clean water should be a basic human right.
exampleRu: Само собой разумеется, что доступ к чистой воде должен быть базовым правом человека.
exampleUz: Toza suvga ega bo'lish asosiy inson huquqi bo'lishi kerakligi aytmasa ham tushunarli.
synonyms: needless to say, obviously, it's a given that
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: needless to say, obviously, it's a given that.

word: hit the nail on the head
transcription: hɪt ðə neɪl ɒn ðə hed
exampleEn: I think you've hit the nail on the head — cost really is the main barrier here.
exampleRu: Думаю, ты попал в самую точку — стоимость действительно является основным препятствием здесь.
exampleUz: Menimcha, siz aynan nishonga tegdingiz — narx haqiqatan ham bu yerdagi asosiy to'siqdir.
synonyms: to get it exactly right, to be spot on, to pinpoint the issue precisely
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: to get it exactly right, to be spot on, to pinpoint the issue precisely.

exampleEn: The ethics of using AI in hiring decisions is still very much a grey area.
exampleRu: Этика использования ИИ при принятии решений о найме до сих пор является весьма неоднозначной областью.
exampleUz: Ish yollashda sun'iy intellektdan foydalanish etikasi hali ham juda noaniq masaladir.
synonyms: an ambiguous issue, an unclear matter, a contentious area
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: an ambiguous issue, an unclear matter, a contentious area.

exampleEn: Let me get straight to the point: the current housing policy simply isn't working.
exampleRu: Позвольте сразу перейти к делу: нынешняя жилищная политика просто не работает.
exampleUz: Keling, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapga o'taman: hozirgi uy-joy siyosati oddiygina samara bermayapti.
synonyms: to cut to the chase, to be direct, to come straight out with it
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: to cut to the chase, to be direct, to come straight out with it.

exampleEn: More often than not, students who study abroad return with a broader worldview.
exampleRu: Чаще всего студенты, которые учились за рубежом, возвращаются с более широким мировоззрением.
exampleUz: Ko'pincha chet elda o'qigan talabalar kengroq dunyoqarash bilan qaytishadi.
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: usually, typically, in most cases.

word: take something with a grain of salt
transcription: teɪk ˈsʌmθɪŋ wɪð ə ɡreɪn ɒv sɔːlt
exampleEn: I'd take those survey results with a grain of salt, since the sample size was so small.
exampleRu: Я бы отнёсся к результатам этого опроса скептически, поскольку размер выборки был очень маленьким.
exampleUz: Namuna hajmi juda kichik bo'lgani uchun men bu so'rov natijalariga shubha bilan qaragan bo'lardim.
synonyms: to be sceptical of, to not take at face value, to doubt the accuracy of
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: to be sceptical of, to not take at face value, to doubt the accuracy of.

exampleEn: When it comes to childcare, flexible working hours matter more than salary for many parents.
exampleRu: Когда речь идёт об уходе за детьми, гибкий график для многих родителей важнее зарплаты.
exampleUz: Gap bolalarga qarash haqida ketganda, ko'plab ota-onalar uchun moslashuvchan ish grafigi maoshdan muhimroq.
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: regarding, with respect to, concerning.

exampleEn: Needless to say, the pandemic completely transformed how universities deliver education.
exampleRu: Само собой разумеется, пандемия полностью изменила то, как университеты предоставляют образование.
exampleUz: Aytish shart ham emas, pandemiya universitetlarning ta'lim berish usulini butunlay o'zgartirib yubordi.
synonyms: obviously, it goes without saying, clearly
definitionEn: (advanced spoken expression, useful for sounding natural and fluent); similar in meaning to: obviously, it goes without saying, clearly.
